articleTitle: The Advance of Reinforcement Learning and Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Reinforcement learning is one of the leading research fields of artificial intelligence. Unlike other machine learning methods, reinforcement learning is learning from the environment to action mappings. Thus, the chosen action could maximize the accumulated reward value from the environment and develop an optimal strategy via trial-and-error. In recent years, the achievements of deep reinforcement learning represented by AlphaGo have attracted wide attention from researchers. This paper first introduces the development of reinforcement learning, including classic reinforcement learning methods and deep reinforcement learning methods. Then, this paper discusses the advanced reinforcement learning work at present, including distributed deep reinforcement learning algorithms, deep reinforcement learning methods based on fuzzy theory, Large-Scale Study of Curiosity-Driven Learning, and so on. Finally, this essay discusses the challenges faced by reinforcement learning.

articleTitle: Research on application of article recommendation algorithm based on Word2Vec and Tfidf
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid expansion of the amount of information in social media such as various news and information software, people urgently need to realize the automatic classification of this information to help users quickly find the information they need and filter spam. Aiming at the curse of feature dimension and non-semantic features in traditional text classification models, this paper studies the classification of article text based on the Word2vec model. One of the shortcomings of the Word2vec model is that the essentiality of words in diverse texts is not the same, so this paper introduces the TFIDF model, which can weight Word2vec word vectors to achieve a weighted Word2vec classification model. At last, the weighted Word2vec and TFIDF models are combined.

articleTitle: Drone-View Object Detection Based on the Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer vision and machine vision, deep learning-based methods have achieved good results in the fields of object detection, identification, and tracking. However, for the detection and identification of vehicles and pedestrians under drone views, the drone-view object detection algorithm detects poorly because the features of small size targets are difficult to be extracted and identified. In order to improve the accuracy and performance of drone view object detection, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv5 algorithm that adds a feature extraction layer to the network model and an image segmentation layer to the detection network. Specifically, a feature map for collecting small target features is formed by adding one upsampling to the neck portion of the network, and a new feature extraction layer is formed by concat. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves the detection effect of the YOLOV5 algorithm on small targets.

articleTitle: Research on surface defect intelligent detection technology of non-woven fabric based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to realize the on-line detection of non-woven fabric defects in the industrial environment, this paper first designs a set of stable non-woven fabric defect image acquisition system according to the requirements of the industrial site, and selects the linear array with linear light source, the camera adopts backside lighting system to collect cloth image. In this paper, a defect detection method based on support vector machine (SVM) is proposed for non-woven fabric turning mesh defect detection. Four eigenvalues of gray co-occurrence matrix describing texture parameters are extracted. The training is carried out in the classifier of kernel function backward guide support vector machine, and the abnormal area is located by SVM. Experimental results show that this algorithm can correctly identify the network turning defects, and can take into account high accuracy and real-time; At the same time, it can effectively solve the problem that it is difficult to obtain defect training samples in production practice, and has good promotion for unknown samples to be tested, which can meet the requirements of industrial testing.

articleTitle: Human Body Pose Intelligent Estimation Based on BlazePose
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Intelligent physical fitness testing has always been the focus of researchers' attention, because of the large number of people participating in physical fitness testing and each physical fitness testing needs a lot of manpower and time, so the market has a strong demand for automated physical fitness testing equipment. In this paper, computer vision and deep learning methods are combined to extract key pose points from video information obtained by the camera using BlazePose. Then, filtering and feature extraction are carried out on these key points of attitude data and three machine learning methods are used to classify these data. The experimental results show that the action recognition rate obtained by ANN algorithm is 97.5%, and the accuracy of counting algorithm is 97.9%, which has great practical application value.

articleTitle: UV detection technology of insulator discharge based on UAV platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Under the action of long-term electrical, thermal and mechanical stress, insulators in transmission lines may have insulation deterioration, aging and even defects, which seriously endangers the stable operation of power system. Corona discharge of insulator will radiate light wave, electric pulse and other signals, which represents the operation state of insulator string to a certain extent. However, it is difficult to judge the discharge phenomenon of insulator through manual detection. With the development of transmission line inspection in recent years, multi rotor UAV has great advantages as a non-contact detection platform. In this paper, the UV detection system of UAV degraded insulator is designed based on the sun blind UV sensor. A large number of experimental studies are carried out on the inspection mode of UAV and the characteristics of UV detection system on the actual live line. The results show that the UV detection system of UAV is divided into two parts: airborne detection terminal and ground display terminal, The airborne terminal and ground terminal cooperate in real time to adjust the angle of UAV and UV detector, which can detect the insulator in different directions, collect the UV photon information of three target points on the insulator surface, and then evaluate the insulation performance of insulator string in combination with the position information; The M600 six rotor UAV is equipped with a deteriorated insulator UV detection device, which can accurately detect the corona discharge of the deteriorated insulator, accurately master the insulator performance, improve the safety, efficiency and automation of power inspection, and have practical significance for the non-contact operation and maintenance of power grid.

articleTitle: Data Analysis on the Computer Intelligent Stock Prediction Model Based on LSTM RNN and Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The stock market has always been the focus of public attention, and its high-risk, high-profit nature has attracted many people who want to speculate for profit. However, the stock market is unpredictable, and there are many factors that influence the stock market, so it is difficult for stockholders to predict the future price increase or decrease accurately. Previously, there are some methods such as ANN and SVM-based algorithms to predict stock prices, but the accuracy is not guaranteed. This article introduces the LSTM RNN based stock price prediction model, which can make relatively accurate prediction of stock price after accuracy check, so that stock speculators can have a macro concept of stock market direction and can buy or sell in time to achieve the goal of maximizing profit.

articleTitle: Garbage Detection Algorithm Based on YOLO v3
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, garbage classification has become the focus of the world. YOLOv3 has good real-time performance and accurate detection accuracy, which can meet the requirements of garbage sorting equipment. In this paper, we introduce a lightweight cross-channel interaction Attention mechanism in the residual unit of YOLOv3, and propose a new target detection algorithm, namely Efficient Channel Attention YOLO (ECA-YOLO) detection algorithm. So the target detection algorithm can get more complete and more effective feature information. Experimental results show that the improved model performs better than YOLOv3 in the garbage image data set of “Huawei Garbage Classification Challenge Cup”. The improved model has a high accuracy and recall rate, and the detection mAP is improved by 1.07%, while the detection speed is kept unchanged and the number of parameters is introduced.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on the Monte Carlo Localization and the Odometry Localization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Positioning is the primary problem that mobile robots need to solve in order to achieve autonomous mobility in practical applications, and accurate positioning results are a prerequisite for various tasks such as path planning for mobile robots. Monte Carlo localization is one of the more cutting-edge mobile robot localization methods and is more commonly used for the indoor positioning of mobile robots. The whole simulation through the Matlab. By simulating and comparing the Monte Carlo localization method and the odometry localization, to compare the accuracy of the two-localization method on positioning and trajectory in the known map.

articleTitle: Underwater attached organisms intelligent detection based on an enhanced YOLO
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In today's shipping, various organisms attached to the bottom of the ship do great harm to the ship, including increasing fuel loss, hindering the operation of electronic instruments and accelerating bottom corrosion. In the process of removing the organisms attached to the bottom of the ship plays a vital role in the operation. The underwater image recognition system will carry out the visual detection of underwater attachments based on the underwater robot and assist the robot in cleaning. In this paper, we propose a underwater attached organism detection method based on an Enhanced YOLOv4. We apply the Retinex theory to enhance the underwater images to overcome the influence from turbidity and illumination. We deploy our proposed method and do experiments in the underwater attachments, e.g., starfish, barnacle, shell, sea urchin, sea rainbow, coral, etc. The experiment results show that our enhanced YOLO method achieve much better performance than the original YOLOv4 method.

articleTitle: Research Status of High Temperature Superconducting Power Cable
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: High temperature superconducting (HTS) power cable has the merits of low transmission loss, massive power capacity, small site corridor, and environmental friendliness. And it has the unique ability to transmit large currents at low voltage, which makes it an alternative competitor to high voltage transmission. After about three decades, HTS power cable has moved from the laboratory to practical applications, which may reshape the traditional electrical energy transmission methods and even the power grid architecture. The paper reviews the current research status of HTS cable technology throughout the world over the past decade and representative demonstration projects are introduced. From the R&D activities we can conclude that HTS power cable can be characterized by a marked increase in maturity, more focused application scenarios, and greater reduction on system costs. Technical breakthroughs under applications such as power supply in urban area and interconnection of substations have been made. We believe that the important works ahead are to improve the long-term operational flexibility, reliability, and simplicity.

articleTitle: Background analysis of digital transformation of automobile enterprises based on SWOT analysis method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The advantages, disadvantages, opportunities and threats of the development of automobile enterprises in digital transformation are discussed through the analysis of the macro and internal environment of automobile enterprises at home and abroad by SWOT analysis method. SWOT analysis is a competitive intelligence analysis method with a wide range of applications. SWOT model is widely used in industry background analysis. With the advent of globalization, information and knowledge economy era, digital technology is developing rapidly and new products are constantly introduced, which have a profound impact on the digital transformation of automobile enterprises. Through the analysis of the automobile enterprise digital transition background, at present, our country automobile enterprise should actively apply related digital transformation digital technology, overcome economic problems at home and abroad and the new champions league with the influence on national economy and industry, take advantage of scientific and technological progress to reduce the threat of epidemic for automotive enterprise supply chain, our country automobile enterprise to go smoothly, Stand out in the digital transformation of the world.

articleTitle: A quantum computing simulator scheme using MPI technology on cloud platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the deeply studied of quantum computing by research fellows, the computational complexity and time complexity of quantum algorithms gradually increase. The quantum computing simulator provides an effective platform for the development and verification of quantum algorithms. However, the running time and memory overhead during calculation will increase exponentially with the number of qubits. Therefore, the difficulty of high-speed quantum computing on classical computers will gradually increase. At present, a single node has been unable to meet the resource requirements of the algorithm in the quantum computing process, and it is necessary to expand the memory resources in the multi-node computing cluster. Message passing interface has high performance inter-process communication capabilities, which can balance the data transmission between different hosts. Quantum computing tasks can be distributed on several servers to work together to solve the same problem. Therefore, this paper designs an advanced scheme of deploying quantum computing programs on cloud computing platform to support message exchanging between servers using message passing interface to accelerate quantum computing.

articleTitle: Short-term mathematical prediction model of air quality based on CEEMD-ELM-PSO
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: After entering the new era, people's living standard has been significantly improved, the concept of environmental protection has been deeply rooted. People pursue a greener and healthier lifestyle, and the concern for air quality has become more and more intense. People need to continuously analyze relevant mechanisms to help people predict air environment quality effectively and prevent relevant hazards in time. It is difficult to obtain a better prediction effect under different AQI fluctuation trends in the traditional single machine learning model for air quality prediction. In order to solve the problem, the prediction method is improved, and the ELM-PSO algorithm is used to predict the future AQI, which helps to analyze the future air change trends from a macro perspective. This bit combines Beijing's short-term air quality data and proposes an air quality short-term prediction model based on complementary ensemble empirical modal decomposition and an optimal limit learning machine. Firstly, the data are decomposed by CEEMD to reduce the non-smoothness of the data, thus reducing the impact of non-smoothness on the prediction accuracy; then ELM model prediction is performed for each decomposed series obtained; the output weights of the limit learning machine are used to PSO optimization search, and then construct the prediction model based on the limit learning machine; finally, all the prediction components are superimposed to obtain the final results. The results surface that the prediction model proposed in this paper has high accuracy in short-term air quality prediction.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of the Number of Split Wires on the UHV Electromagnetic Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Traditional high-voltage power transmission can no longer meet the dependence of China's rapid economic development on electricity, so it has become an inevitable trend to vigorously build and develop UHV power transmission systems. UHV transmission can greatly increase the transmission power and reduce the transmission loss while also causing the increase of the electromagnetic field and the electromagnetic environment. Splitting the wire is one of the effective methods to solve the electromagnetic environment problem. Based on Maxwell's simulation of two-dimensional electric field, this paper explores the influence of different number of split wires on electric field strength, corona dissipation, radio interference and audible noise, and gives the optimal wire splitting parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Mobile Police Application Based on 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Mobile and wireless networks have made remarkable development in the last few years, the rapidly increasing number of smart devices, voluminous mobile internet data, and higher data rate are promoting the birth and development of the 5th generation of mobile communication technology, by providing faster service, very low delay and very wide range of connection through mobile devices, the new technology is expected to revolutionize change the problems faced by traditional mobile wireless communication. With the application of 5G technology, the safety of the public will be significantly improved, especially for some scenes with zero delay tolerance requirements and large population density, such as mega events security and high real-time mobile police service. This paper explorers how the integration of 5G technology, big-data analysis, artificial intelligence and intelligent monitoring equipment can penetrate into the daily police management of urban space and the security of mega events protection. It analyzes these police applications from two interrelated perspectives, focusing on how to use 5G technology to help large-scale event security and use 5G to build three-dimensional prevention and control mode of mobile police. It is hoped that the joint progress of 5G technology and police application will enable us to move towards a safer, smarter and more automated society in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Big Data and Mobile Communication Technology in Intelligent Nursing Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The current Chinese medical and health information system has developed into the “people-oriented” regional medical information field. The traditional medical industry is facing increasing pressure. The existing medical environment inevitably produces many health needs that cannot meet the health needs of the Chinese people. Mobile health system refers to the provision of health service information through the use of mobile communication technologies, such as mobile phones, PDAs or satellite communications. In the field of mobile Internet, medical and health applications based on mobile terminal systems such as Android, iOS and Windows Phone are the mainstay. This paper designs a smart outpatient nursing service platform based on Java Web technology, and verifies the feasibility of the system through system construction and actual testing.

articleTitle: Bi-Level Control Strategy for EV Charging in Active Distribution Network Based on Wavelet Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Considering the increasing integration of distributed renewable energies (DREs), the active distribution network (ADN) is facing challenges to maintain generation-load balance. Meanwhile, since the electric vehicles (EVs) are usually charged together in time and space, the EV charging is typical impulsive load and may further aggravate power imbalance. A bi-level EV charging strategy is proposed to reduce the adverse impacts of DRE power fluctuation and EV power impulse on ADN. In the outer level, a multi-objective optimization model is provided based on the predicted DRE power. With the objectives of minimizing net power fluctuations and EV charging power changes, the optimal Pareto solution set is obtained through the multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm, on which a basic EV charging scheme in the large time scale is determined. Then, in the inner level, the wavelet decomposition is utilized to extract the high-frequency power prediction errors. According to the high-frequency components and the state of charge of EVs, the charging scheme is adjusted in a small-time scale.

articleTitle: The Insulation Aging State Assessment of High Voltage Cable Based on the Isothermal Relaxation Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Cross-linked polyethylene(XLPE) cable is widely used in power grid of various countries due to its excellent performance. However, it will be aging due to electric and thermal effects in operation, which will reduce its insulation performance and life, and greatly affect the safety and reliability of power grid. For the realization of the insulation state assessment, this paper introduces the related theory of dielectric response such as the isothermal relaxation current. Combined with the cable aging equivalent model, the isothermal relaxation current peak-split fitting method to represent the different process of relaxation according to the attenuation characteristics of isothermal relaxation current is provided. And its feasibility is verified by using the known data. The results show that the measurement method of isothermal relaxation current can evaluate the aging state of cable insulation effectively.

articleTitle: Optimizing 3D Virtual Fitting Mirror Using Augmented Reality Technology under Internet Plus
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At present, with the ups and downs of the “Internet Plus” era, all things realize intelligent interconnection. Internet technologies such as big data and artificial intelligence have exploded, playing an important role as a bridge in the era of “Internet Plus” and bringing a profound revolution to human life. In order to solve the personalized and diversified dressing needs of consumers in the new retail mode, enhance the reality of 3D clothing model, and make up for the shortcomings of the user experience in the clothing e-commerce industry, this paper studies the 3D fitting mirror based on Kinect, and proposes the use of Random Sample Consensus algorithm to optimize the virtual fitting mirror and improve the user's fitting experience.

articleTitle: A Dim-small Target Real-time Detection Method Based on Enhanced YOLO
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The identification of dim-small targets has been employed in various industries, including transportation, medical, and military, thanks to the rapid development of artificial intelligence and remote sensing drone technology. Meanwhile, the UAV has become one of the major ways to locate and detect ground remote sensing sensitive targets due to its characteristics of low cost, high flexibility, excellent vision in the air and wide detection range. Although deep learning-based target identification algorithms like Yolo (you only watch once) and SSD (single-lens multi-box detector) have achieved good target detection results, it is still challenging to detect weak targets in real time and effectively. To address this issue, this paper proposes a pre-processing method for processing data sets to increase feature diversity and invariance, as well as to improve the performance of the YOLO model when dealing with dim-small targets. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the original Yolo algorithm in terms of detection accuracy and robustness in remote sensing target detection. This method still has the characteristics of real-time in low configuration hardware environment, so it is of practical significance for the popularization and application of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Identification and Detection for Plant Disease Based on Image Segmentation and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The technology of object detection based on deep learning and computer vision have been widely used in many fields. Its ingenious feature extraction makes target detection more accurate. It can actively extract features to avoid complicated manual feature selection and extraction. However, in the detection of agricultural diseases, the existing algorithms are not satisfactory for the detection of small lesions in complex backgrounds. In response to the problem, this paper proposes an end-to-end target detection method combining image segmentation and deep learning. First, LM (local maximum) filter and k-means are used to segment the size of the anchor box and the cluster of targets which is imported in the deep learning training phase and the prediction phase. Second, YOLOv4 (you only look once) is applied with the data information obtained in the segmentation stage to detect lesions. Finally, the experimental analysis and comparison of the two data sets would be considered to prove the effectiveness of the model for small target detection.

articleTitle: Geographic information system and climate big data applied in the research of bird migration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Climate change and habitat losses are the two most threatening factors for migratory birds and even the global ecosystem. This study analyzes the relationship between habitat loss and climate change and discusses their impacts on migratory birds. Results show that climate change causes migratory birds to advance their arrival and departure time in spring and change their egg-laying time due to prey phenology change. While habitat loss causes increase competition in winter habitat and stopovers. This will cause high winter mortality due to lack of food, and impact some species' reproduction success due to the time shift caused by habitat loss. Both climate change and habitat loss cause an impact on migratory birds, while these two factors also have impacts on each other. Climate change can not only exacerbate habitat loss but also cause habitat loss like ice habitat melting.

articleTitle: A review of cabin fire and numerical simulation technology and intelligent fire protection technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In view of cabin fire, one of the most common types of ship damage, the experimental research progress of temperature distribution, smoke flow and other characteristics of cabin fire under different conditions and the research of fire safety risk assessment model are reviewed. Then the application of various fire numerical simulation techniques is analyzed. Finally, the development of intelligent technology of cabin fire is analyzed and the future direction of intelligent development is forecasted.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of ZYNQ Based Incremental PID-PWM Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of digital control techniques, there have been a great rise for using digital processors due to their adaptability, reduced cost, size and reliability. This paper presents a designed IP core of an incremental PID (Proportion, Integration, Differentiation) and PWM (Pulse Power Modulation) on Xilinx Zynq7035, aiming at simplifying the close-loop control of motor position, which driven by pulse powers. Firstly, PWM block is designed in Vivado2017 with Verilog Hardware Description Language (VHDL). Secondly, an incremental PID is built in Vivado High Level Synthesis (HLS) in C++, after C simulation, C synthesis and Co-simulation, it is packaged as intellectual property (IP) core for further applications. Thirdly, to demonstrate the effectiveness of our strategy, testbench is designed in HLS for the PID IP core, simulations are designed for both the PWM IP and the combined two IPs. All the results have shown our designed IP core is not only simple but precise in the close-loop position control of motor driven by pulse power. Moreover, usage of HLS leads to lower development time and rational allocation of hardware resources, which can be a powerful tool for realization of more complicated algorithms.

articleTitle: Multi-agent Collaborative Fire Rescue Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Multi-agent systems have become an important research branch of artificial intelligence. There are many problems in fire rescue, such as difficulties and dangers of rescuers, so it is worth studying to use multi-agents to cooperate to complete fire rescue tasks. Firstly, a complete multi-agent system for fire rescue is designed. Secondly, a deep reinforcement learning algorithm is proposed for the most important components of fire rescue: fire detection and fire map construction module, using yolo v5 network structure and Q-learning algorithm framework. Finally, computer simulation experiments are carried out, and the experimental results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of our algorithm.

articleTitle: A Solution of Driving Computer Peripherals without Adapter Drivers Based on Device Redirection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article proposes a solution of driving computer peripherals lacking of adapter drivers. In this system, the USB device can be drived by remote host based on USB/IP. The solution can be applied to different operating systems and cpu architectrues.

articleTitle: Earthquake disaster collection system based on mobile terminal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this article, an earthquake disaster collection system is established based on mobile terminals, and the post-earthquake disaster information is transmitted to the field headquarters or the rear processing platform in real time through mobile terminals. Through the screening, classification and management of the reported disaster information, which combined with the basic geographic data, the professional data such as earthquake influence range and earthquake disaster degree are obtained. It can quickly obtain earthquake disaster information, establish a multi-level and multi-directional earthquake disaster investigation and collection system, realize the rapid acquisition and processing of earthquake disaster area information and related information.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Power Angle Stability of Power System Based on Eigenvalues of Trajectory Section
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: For a long time, the performance of transient stability evaluation has been influenced by time-varying factors. The TSE method considers both model and trajectory information, and extends the traditional eigenvalue technology, which was originally only applicable to the original point, to any section on the disturbed response. For the purpose of exploring the effect of trajectory section eigenvalue method on the transient stability evaluation, this paper clarifies the theory of the trajectory section eigenvalue, and establishes an online assessment framework for mid- and long-term transient stability based on the WSCC three-machine nine-node system. Through this framework, dispatch agency can make stability judgments in advance, and realize oscillation positioning control before instability happen, which can greatly reduce the predictive time for online stability assessment.

articleTitle: A cross-chain technology based on a licensed public chain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of blockchain technology, various kinds of blockchain projects with different characteristics and adapting to different application scenarios have emerged. However, different chains cannot be interconnected, forming many value islands, restricting the promotion and ecological development of blockchain. Cross-chain technology is an important technical means to achieve interconnection between different chains, improve performance, and expand the scope of application; combined with the advantages of nodes and state control in the licensing environment, this article mainly studies the cross-chain technology of licensed public chains.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Monitoring Technology Based on the Influencing Factors of Line Loss in the Power Consumption Area in the Power Consumption Information Collection System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The main idea of the article is to reduce the loss rate of the power consumption area and improve the efficiency of power distribution. Conduct overall research on electricity consumption information collection system; integrate system collection data and theoretical data, and propose a circuit based on multi-source data complementary technology. Loss intelligence analysis technology. The wide application of intelligent electric energy meters and electricity consumption information collection systems provides a favorable channel for low-voltage stations to distinguish phase-line loss calculations. The current status and existing problems of line loss management in the current power supply area are analyzed. Based on the power consumption information collection system, the station area line loss related data is obtained in real time and the data characteristics are analyzed to construct the judgment of the influence factors of the station area line loss management. At the same time, this article takes Web server, database server and computing server as the framework. The technical route of the platform includes three parts: data access, data analysis and data presentation. It has been verified that the rules are efficient, which improves the timeliness and pertinence of line loss management, and improves the efficiency of line loss management.

articleTitle: Research Review of Object Detection Algorithms in Vehicle Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Target detection technology is an important part of computer vision technology, and current target detection algorithms have been significantly applied in various fields. As an important research content in the field of intelligent transportation, the research on vehicle detection and recognition based on target detection algorithms has gradually become a research hotspot. This paper summarizes the research on vehicle target detection based on deep learning target detection algorithms, hoping to provide assistance for related research.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Energy Efficiency Control and Optimization Technology for the Internet of Things for Three-Dimensional “Common Intelligence” Visualization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article uses digital twins and edge computing technologies to design virtual models in the digital space and establish the mapping relationship between digital virtual and physical entities to achieve interconnected and interactive digital “twin mirroring” physical models, building multi-source integration, autonomous comprehensive perception, and globalization An integrated small and micro park integrated energy IoT system architecture with optimal coordination, virtualized management and control of physical resources, and deep decoupling of software and hardware. Finally, the typical design of edge computing and edge cloud collaboration of actual power distribution business is listed.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Big Data and Convolutional Neural Network Technology in Guiding the Training Standardization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of detecting multi-scale sports student training actions in sports videos, an automatic detection method based on convolutional neural network is proposed. First, obtain the athlete images from the video frames, and combine the non-athlete images to construct a training set, and use Bootstrapping algorithm to train the convolutional neural network classifier. On the basis of general human detection, the multi-instance learning module is introduced, based on image-level annotation, the feature mapping matrix is automatically learned through weak supervision, and the human body features are mapped to the athlete feature space. Finally, by measuring the relationship between the human body features and the athlete features Similarity, to realize the distinction between athletes and non-athletes. The experimental results found that the method in this paper makes full use of the general human detection framework, and achieves the accuracy of the specially trained athlete detection model with a very small amount of labeled data.

articleTitle: Intelligent Value Added Service Platform of Smart Library Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of smart Library in collecting resources, storing data and disseminating information, this paper proposes an intelligent value-added service platform of smart Library Based on blockchain technology. The smart value-added service platform makes full use of the advantages of blockchain technology, such as decentralization, non tampering, traceability and consensus mechanism, which makes the traditional way of resource acquisition and user communication fundamentally changed in time and space. The research results show that the smart value-added service platform can overcome the security problems of smart library in the aspects of resource collection, data storage and information dissemination, and improve the user experience.

articleTitle: Design of a space dual-arm robot and its ground microgravity simulation platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As The Chinese space station is put into use, the operation and maintenance of the space station inside and outside the cabin is a lot of work. In order to make astronauts have more time for scientific research experiments, a lot of routine maintenance and operation need to be replaced by space robots. Because of its human-like structure, the dual-arm robot is most suitable for the spatial structure environment. Based on this requirement, this paper proposes a space robot with 7 degrees of freedom in each arm, and designs its arm configuration and mechanical structure. In order to adapt to the characteristics of space microgravity environment, a dynamic calculation method of robot floating in space is presented. Finally, a passive suspension microgravity environment simulation platform with five lifting points was designed for the microgravity simulation test.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Analysis Technology of Electricity Stealing Behavior Characteristics in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: High-value theft of electricity not only seriously damages the economic benefits of power companies, but also has a great impact on Chinese economic development and the normal order of electricity consumption of the people. Therefore, power companies must use advanced anti-theft technology, improve the inspection system, strengthen power management, improve the level of anti-theft, and protect the economic benefits of the company. In order to improve the efficiency of anti-stealing power, an analysis method of power-stealing behavior is proposed on the basis of the electricity consumption information collection system. That is, for the high-supply low-meter metering method, an analysis model of electricity theft behavior is established, and the correctness of the model is verified through software simulation. When a high value of electricity theft occurs in the power grid, it not only severely damages the economic benefits of power companies, but also has a great impact on my country's economic development and the normal order of electricity consumption of the people. Therefore, power companies must use advanced anti-theft technology, improve the inspection system, strengthen power management, improve the level of anti-theft, and protect the economic benefits of the company. In order to improve the efficiency of anti-electricity theft, an analysis method of electric theft behavior is proposed based on the electricity consumption information collection system. That is, for the high-supply low-meter metering method, an analysis model of electricity theft behavior is established, and the correctness of the model is verified through software simulation. Especially in the process of rapid development of smart grid, prevention of electricity theft is particularly important.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Image Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Neural network is a popular and significant research direction in machine learning, which is widely used in classification. regression, pattern recognition and other fields. Based on the current direction of academic research, the application of neural network in image classification has great research value. However, due to a large number of such articles, involving too wide a range of aspects, it is difficult to grasp the main idea quickly when quoting. We have selected and sorted out some representative basic articles and innovative cutting-edge articles. After systematic analysis and integration, we give each a better algorithm for some of the previous algorithms. This upgrade is reflected in performance, efficiency and other aspects.

articleTitle: An Decentralized Anonymous Payment Confidential Transactions with Efficient Proofs and Scalability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the popularity of blockchain application scenarios, the blockchain's privacy preserving is still a challenging job without sacrificing scalability. To address this problem, this paper proposes a Decentralized Anonymous Payment Scheme Via Confidential Transactions with Efficient Proofs and Scalability, DAPCT, which is short for “queue masquerade”. The core insight of DAPCT is that a new decentralization anonymous payment scheme reconstructed on the mini blockchain model and a proving system. In this work, mini blockchain enables us to have better scalability and this proving system enables us to have better anonymity by proving knowledge what uses a single set and a verifiable random function assessed. With soundness depending on a novel discre-logarithm, we use data from the Bitcoin to test DAPCT. The results show that it provide faster verification time than other confidential transaction models. The results demonstrate that DAPCT creates a great new privacy protection model.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient and Safe Operation of Substation Automation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous development of society, people's electricity consumption is also increasing. How to better realize safe and reliable power supply and ensure qualified power quality and good economy is the basic requirement of power system in operation. In order to better realize the substation automation system and improve the effectiveness of power supply, it is necessary to strengthen the application of power grid management and dispatching automation system on the basis of continuously improving the quality of operators, so that it can better promote the effective realization of substation automation system.

articleTitle: Research on parallel mean flow technology of high-voltage vacuum circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The impact generator is equivalent to a generator operating in an accident condition, carrying an extremely high short circuit current, and must be protected with an exit protection circuit breaker that can open the large current.At the present stage, the exit protection circuit breaker has insufficient disconnection capacity to effectively average the flow. In this regard, this paper first puts forward a large capacity parallel vacuum circuit breaker with 160kA short circuit current, then analyzes its basic working principle, and finally calculates its parallel mean flow characteristics, which verifies that the parallel operation of large capacity vacuum circuit breaker and has the ability to open off large capacity short circuit current.

articleTitle: Coarse-to-Fine Network for Crowd Counting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Crowd counting task aims at predicting the count of people in images or videos. Although recent methods perform well by using CNN, most methods only use the information contained in deep layers to predict the final number. To utilize the rich information existed in layers of different level, we propose a simple framework, i.e., Coarse-to-Fine Network (C2FNet), which stacks a set of blocks. In our method, we predict the density maps not only by the final extracted features, but using the features extracted by middle blocks as well. Therefore, we adopt a coarse-to-fine loss (C2F loss) to supervise the learning progress of coarse density maps so that our network can predict the final density map from coarse to fine. Moreover, there is a multi-scale perception module (MSPM) in each block, which extracts multi-scale features by using convolutional layers with kernels of multiple sizes and different dilation rates. Experimental results demonstrate that C2FNet has achieved great performances on ShanghaiTech Part A, ShanghaiTech Part B, UCF-QNRF and UCF-CC-50 datasets.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Yolo on Garbage Classification Task
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of society, more and more waste is produced, which is in urgent need of waste classification treatment. In view of this, this paper proposes a target detection model Yolov3 ++ for 10 types of recyclable garbage, which is suitable for garbage classification. First in this paper, the backbone of YOLOv3 is optimized, the input image size from 608 to 618 to increase the scale of characteristics, change the RELU activation function to Leaky RELU prevent data explosion phenomenon, to reduce the Darknet 52 layer model on branch processing optimization for 43 layer, so as to reduce the amount of calculation and the number, use the K - mean average clustering algorithm is introduced to improve accuracy of the model, the output characteristics of figure size from 38 * 38 and 76 x 76 optimization for 19 lines and the characteristics of the 38 * 38 figure scale to further improve the suitability of the model. Then the transfer learning method is used to introduce the parameters of Image Net after the pre-training model to further improve the accuracy of the detection model. Therefore, the target detection model Yolov3 ++ proposed in this paper is suitable for the garbage detection task.

articleTitle: Adaptive Quantization Control for Multi-machine Power System with SVC and Unknown Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, a control method combined with dynamic surface and sliding mode based on input quantization is proposed for multi-machine power system with SVC. The quantization of state variables solves the signal transmission problem of multi-machine power system in network control environment. In this paper, the error terms and unknown disturbances of multi-machine power system modeling are estimated by neural network. The boundedness of quantization errors and estimated parameters in closed-loop system is analyzed by some lemmas. Finally, the effectiveness of the tracking scheme is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Research progress of automatic dismantling technology of new energy vehicle traction battery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As a key pre-process link of comprehensive utilization of traction battery - traction battery dismantling, which is related to the efficiency and value of comprehensive utilization. At present, the industry has carried out automatic, intelligent and refined disassembly process and research and construction of production line, but with the application of complex battery pack structure design such as gluing, the disassembly difficulty is also significantly increased. And in the face of how to control the robot screw removal machine automatically identify the location of the battery pack cover screws, how to ensure automatic screw removal yield, how to alarm the screw removal abnormalities, how to automatically identify and locate the battery module long screws and nuts, how to successfully remove the screws and nuts at different angles, how to successfully remove the copper row on the module when the battery pack positioning accuracy deviations and other key technical problems, the industry has also explored different technical routes. Based on the current situation of the comprehensive utilization industry of new energy vehicle traction battery, this paper compares the traction battery technology profile and its key technology development in the disassembly process, and proposes development suggestions to deal with the disassembly technology bottleneck by analyzing the development of enterprise technology and development of production line equipment, so as to point out the direction for the industry to improve the traction battery disassembly technology level and help the new energy vehicle and traction battery recycling industry to develop healthily and sustainably.

articleTitle: A real time intelligent detection and counting method of cells based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Blood cell count plays an important role in the diagnosis and treatment of many diseases. This paper proposes and implements a blood cell detection and count method based on YOLOv5. On the basis of YOLOv5, 346 blood cell images screened by BCCD dataset were used for 300 epochs of training. The mAP of 46 samples in the verification set was as high as 0.96, and the actual counting accuracy of red blood cells, white blood cells and platelets was close to 100%. The detection accuracy of untrained new data is also close to 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the recall rate is slightly weaker than the verification set data. The inferencing time of single sample in batch detection is only 16 ms, which has the ability of real-time detection and counting. However, in the SSD blood cell detection and counting control model with MobileNet as the backbone, the verification set mAP is only 0.62, and the platelets can hardly be detected and counted. Experiments show that the blood cell detection and counting method based on YOLOv5 has the ability to replace and assist artificial cell counting in clinic.

articleTitle: A Personalized Privacy-Preserving Scheme for Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Federated learning (FL), which is a state-of-the-art distributed machine learning (DML) model, brings the spare resources of mobile devices into full play and provides strong security guarantee to local sensitive data by local differential privacy. However, the introduction of noise data leads to an unignored reduction of model utility. In this paper, we consider the heterogeneity of privacy requirement for various participants in FL and propose a novel federated learning scheme (PGC-LDP) that lets users personally choose their privacy level based on federated stochastic gradient descent algorithm with local differential privacy. In the scheme, we design a new algorithm based on Nguyên's solution in client side and optimize aggregation method in server side. Moreover, we theoretically analyze the privacy guarantee and verify the utility of PGC-LDP on real-world dataset.

articleTitle: Optimization of Deep-Learning Network Using Resnet50 Based Model for Corona Virus Disease (COVID-19) Histopathological Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: There is enormous attention surrounding COVID-19 these years. Artificial Intelligence are rising in the medical field. However, the next revolutionary steps lie in the upsurge of deep learning methodology. In this study, we propose a optimal Resnet50 based deep learning network for proper CT diagnosis of the COVID-19. The learning model was then adopted on the CT scan images with COVID-19 dataset (provided by Zhuhai HuiYu Medical Technology) and eventually achieves the autonomous diagnosis of new images by reading and analyzing more than 5000 CT pictures. The preliminary results of the core system show that the detecting sensitivity of the algorithm is 98.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the accuracy of the COVID-19 case detection is up to 97.4%. The CT detection for one COVID-19 case is expected to take 5.3 seconds, which greatly reduces the working intensity of doctors and the number of misdiagnoses significantly. In addition, the system can be extended to other more extensive medical image perception in the future.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Health System Using Big Data and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the current socio-economic level, people's health awareness has also been effectively improved, and more and more attention is paid to self-personal health management[1]. The application of personal health management systems can achieve ideal results in health management, and thus can Make people's health better protected. Based on big data technology, the personal health management system is analyzed and researched, so that the functions of the personal health management system can be better played, the role of personal health management can be better realized, and the system can be more ideally applied[2]. Since 2020, the epidemic situation has developed rapidly and more and more information about the epidemic situation. This project is based on big data technology to analyze and research the personal health management system, so that the functions of the personal health management system can be better played and realized. The role of personal health management promotes the ideal application of the system. The Android personal health system mainly implements the functions of the administrator and the user, and realizes the functions of querying epidemic-related information and personal health information management; the system uses database, JSP and Android research methods to design a personal health system. Mobile users can view epidemic information anytime and anywhere for personal health management, which is both practical and convenient. Experiments show that the system runs stably, with comprehensive functions, strong practicability, high security, high scalability and good maintainability.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of Matlab-based nonlinear data fitting for infrared sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Infrared range measurement has important applications in industrial robotics and automation, but the accuracy needs to be improved in the traditional design scheme. Therefore, in this design, the function methods such as polynomial least squares fitting and nonlinear least squares fitting are written based on Matlab platform to solve the transfer function of the experimentally measured data, and the data conversion and processing in the microcontroller improves the measurement accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: Personalized Reader System Based on the Characteristic Information of the Recommended Object of the Resource
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The current personalized recommendation technology is user-centric and can meet the individual needs of users to a certain extent. However, the traditional personalized reader system does not fully consider the user's personalized needs, resulting in many problems such as inconsistent with user needs and insignificant learning effects. This article first introduces the current development of personalized recommendation and personalized reader systems at home and abroad, and expounds the theoretical basis used in the personalized recommendation subsystem; then, it conducts a detailed demand analysis and design of the personalized recommendation subsystem. When a user logs in to the personalized recommendation personalized reader system, the system can obtain the user's personalized case information from the user case library, and then obtain the result through a comprehensive weighted analysis of multiple case information such as user cases, model cases, and similar user cases A recommendation result that meets the needs of the user.

articleTitle: Structural response analysis of composite fiber blade of small wind power generator turbine blades
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the vibration response characteristics of small laminated composite wind turbine blades under prestress are studied. By using the simulation software structural mechanics module and modal analysis module, the variation trend of vibration mode and natural frequency of fan blade in standby state and different speed coupling state was explored. The stress distribution law of the composite layer of the blade under multiple prestressing forces is studied. The research in this paper can provide the simulation basis for the structural design of small fan blade vibration response.

articleTitle: Active Distribution Network Reconfiguration Method Based on Photovoltaic Generation Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Network reconfiguration is an important method to optimize the operation of the active distribution system. It can achieve the goal of reducing network loss and improving power quality by changing the state of network switch without requiring additional equipment investment. The randomness of photovoltaic power generation makes the network reconfiguration of the distribution network need to consider the characteristics of photovoltaic power generation for dynamic optimization. In this paper, a photovoltaic power generation prediction method based on the combination of similar day BP neural network is proposed. The dynamic reconfiguration of distribution network is carried out with the minimum network loss and minimum voltage offset as the objective function, which is optimized by genetic algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by taking the improved IEEE 33 bus system as an example.

articleTitle: Radiator design of micro heat pipe array inverter in high altitude area
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the core components of photovoltaic inverter, which will produce a lot of heat during operation. This part of heat will heat the power device die integrated in the inverter, increase the junction temperature and reduce the reliability. By using the micro heat pipe array technology and coupling the phase change heat dissipation on the basis of the physical heat dissipation of the existing inverter radiator, the micro heat pipe array inverter radiator in high altitude area is studied.

articleTitle: Fracture Data Analysis and Calculation of Drilling Tools in Gravel Formation in Dabei/Bozi Block
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the process of drilling operation, the stress of drilling tools is complex and changeable, and the fracture of drilling tools is one of the serious failure forms. The second opening interval in Dabei/Bozi block in Tarim basin is a typical gravel layer. Drilling tool fracture accidents have occurred frequently in the operation of this well section in recent two years. Taking well Dabei X as an example, this paper analyzes the process and external characteristics of drilling tool fracture accident, and explores the causes and mechanism of this type of accident.

articleTitle: Application Research of WSN Key Distribution Scheme Based on SBH
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Building on the q-composite random key pre-distribution solution, a single-group hash function-based key pre-distribution solution for wireless sensor networks is proposed. The key pre-distribution phase utilises the one-way feature of the Hash function to preload the keys, effectively hiding partial key messages of the nodes, and an assailant is only able to break the partial keys in the network by the backtracking mechanism through the key messages of the captured nodes. Both the results of theoretical and simulation analysis show that the scheme is more efficient than the q-composite scheme, obtaining higher resistance to capture attacks and reduced computational overhead, while guaranteeing the same network security connectivity, storage and communication capabilities.

articleTitle: Fine-grained Emotional Analysis and Intelligent Identification of Electric Power Public Opinion Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the Internet age, information explodes exponentially. As an electric power industry closely related to national life, network public opinion in the electric power field also spreads rapidly. How to fully tap the public opinion information of electric power to promote the improvement of electric power service is an important research topic. According to the research status of power public opinion, this paper defines the problem in fine-grained emotion analysis, collects the corresponding data, and defines the evaluation aspects and evaluation levels. In terms of solution strategy, according to the dimension of the problem, this paper adopts a two-way LSTM model integrating attention mechanism. The experimental results show that this method is effective in the fine-grained emotion analysis task of power public opinion samples.

articleTitle: Computer aided design and performance analysis of permanent magnet planetary gear
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Compared with the traditional mechanical gear, the new magnetic gear has the advantages of no friction, low noise and small vibration. It is suitable for occasions without lubrication, reduced maintenance, high reliability and difficult maintenance; Non contact gear transmission is suitable for occasions with high sealing, high toxicity, high pollution and high corrosion; It can accurately determine the maximum torque that can be transmitted without return difference. It has the function of overload protection. A permanent magnet planetary gear is designed in this paper. Firstly, the transmission principle is analyzed, the spatial structure of magnetic gear and the magnetization mode of magnetic materials are described, then the magnetic field distribution in the coupling area is analyzed, the calculation formula is deduced and simplified, the three-dimensional model is constructed, and the relevant simulation analysis is completed.

articleTitle: An Analysis on the Weibo Topic Detection Based on K-means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Sina Weibo, as a platform for netizens to express their opinions, generates a large amount of public opinion data and constantly generates new topics. How to detect new and hot topics on Weibo is a meaningful studied issue. Document Clustering is a widely studied problem in Text Categorization. K-means is one of the most famous unsupervised learning algorithms, partitions a given dataset into disjoint clusters following a simple and easy way. But the traditional K-means algorithm assigns initial centroids randomly, which cannot guarantee to choose the maximum dissimilar documents as the centroids for the clusters. A modified K-means algorithm is proposed, which uses Jaccard distance measure for assigning the most dissimilar k documents as centroids, and uses Word2vec as the Chinese text vectorization model. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed K-means algorithm improves the clustering performance, and is able to detect new and hot topics based on Weibo COVID-19 data.

articleTitle: The Design of Current Sensor Based on Diamond Magnetometer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Current sensors are widely used in industrial, for example, they play an important role in electricity billing and protect. Traditional current sensors have the problems of huge size and weight, high risk of insulation breakdown, poor response for high-frequency harmonics, ferromagnetic resonance and eddy current effects, and they lead to potential dangers in application. Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) color center is a kind of point defect in diamond, which emits fluorescence under laser irradiation, while microwave frequency and magnetic field strength will influence the intensity of fluorescence from NV color center. We can realize magnetic field measurement with high precision based on this feature. This article applies the NV color center magnetic sensor to the current sensor design, we proposes the design of the current sensor, and discusses the approach to application. We achieve ±0.3% accuracy in current measurement, which leads to a new degree of freedom for the design of current sensor.

articleTitle: Study on Fit Degree of the Short-circuit Calculation Based on BPA and National Standard
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The national standard GB/T15544.1-2013 “Short-circuit Current Calculation of Three-phase AC System”, and the calculation method of short-circuit current commonly used in enterprises are briefly introduced. The fitting degree between the national standard and BPA program is analyzed, and it is considered that the BPA program can be consistent with the national standard by setting the calculation conditions of BPA and modifying component parameters, and the results are verified by an example. Finally, suggestions for setting up BPA procedures in enterprises are given in order to conform to national standard.

articleTitle: Collaborative delivery of information flow in big data supply chain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Starting from the supply chain tactical collaboration, this paper considers the supply chain tactical collaboration from the perspective of information collaboration. The simultaneous interpreting mode of information flow in Supply Chain Based on big data platform is discussed, and the transfer process is analyzed in detail to realize the coordinated control of supply chain information flow in big data environment. This paper will also compare and analyze the traditional supply chain information transmission model with the information transmission model based on big data platform, and simulate and analyze the model through MATLAB to get the corresponding conclusions.

articleTitle: Airport Taxi Decision Algorithm Based on Queuing Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: After seeing off passengers to the airport, taxis face two decisions: directly returning to the urban area or waiting for passengers to return to the urban area. In order to study which decision is more beneficial to drivers, this paper analyzes the mechanism of taxi drivers' time cost and profit after adopting two different decisions at the first place. Secondly, this paper determines the expected waiting time of taxi drivers under different conditions through queuing theory. After comprehensively considering the waiting time to determine the total time cost, this paper finally selects the scheme with the highest income per unit time

articleTitle: Safe and Effective Elliptic Curve Cryptography Algorithm against Energy Attack
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Elliptic curve cryptosystem (ECC) has high security and calculation efficiency. Energy attack is a powerful crypto attack method, which attacks the chip cryptography algorithm by using the information leaked by the crypto chip during its operation. Aiming at the situation that the side channel attacks of ECC mainly focus on scalar multiplication, The FWNAF is proposed. It uses the fragment window technology to improve the use ratio for storage resources, reduce the “jitter” caused by rapid change of system resources.

articleTitle: Application of Industrial Robot and Internet of Things in Intelligent Manufacturing System Supported by Software and Hardware
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article explains the current situation and research significance of intelligent manufacturing, and studies the necessary resources required for the composition of the intelligent manufacturing system from the three levels of the basic layer, the platform layer, and the application layer. Finally, it explores and proposes a three-layer framework for the intelligent manufacturing system.

articleTitle: Research on Characteristics of Electricity Theft Behavior and Risk Early Warning Technology Based on Big Data Information of the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the results of online loss calculations, we comprehensively utilize the existing massive data of power grid companies, and conduct in-depth mining of abnormal line loss rate lines or stations by using big data technologies such as Hadoop offline distributed computing and Spark memory computing to identify possible occurrences. Electricity stealing, providing electricity theft warning and data support services for power supply companies' anti-electricity theft inspections. The data collected on the spot proves the effectiveness of the structured anti-theft model, and provides an effective method for solving the problem of monitoring the behavior of electricity theft under the condition of big data.

articleTitle: A Model Sharing Technology Between Smart Substations and Dispatching Master Stations and Its Engineering Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At present, the control systems of dispatching master stations mainly adopt the IEC61970 protocol to create the models of substations. It is very different from the IEC61850 model of substations. This causes the systems of master stations and substations to be modeled according to their respective protocols. The amount of information collected by the substations is huge, but only part of the key information is needed for dispatching and monitoring. It is necessary to filter the information collected by the substations to form an information point table, and then manually check the information after the configuration of the master stations and substations. The existing traditional modeling and information checking methods require a significant amount of time. Based on fully comparing the differences between the two protocols, combined with the actual production flow, this paper proposes a method of automatic generation for models of dispatching master stations based on substations' SCD(Substation Configuration Description) files. RCD(Remote Configuration Description) files are generated according to the needs of monitoring business and automatically written into the SCADA(Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition) system and the database of the gateway of substations' data communication network, so as to realize one-time maintenance of models' information points of master stations and substations. The test systems are built in new substations, and the simulation terminals are used to automatically compare the information, which verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Food Safety Remote Online Course Using Intelligent Mobile Terminal and Network Technology during COVID 19 Lockdown
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Several problems were found in the attempt and practice of bilingual teaching in Food safety, mainly including inconsistent foreign language quality of students, messy textbooks and teaching content, inadequate bilingual ability of teachers and lack of supervision of English auxiliary teachers, lack of online network construction, and single teaching methods and other issues. Through summing up experience, it is found that a series of methods, such as combining social hot spots and conducting scientific research hot spots introduction teaching, rationally using English textbooks and correspondingly constructing teaching content, can solve the above problems and promote English teaching of Food safety. During pandemic (COVID-19/Corona Virus Disease 2019) period, we boldly carried out bilingual and online teaching attempts, this time also carried out a summary, hoping to provide some guidance for the teaching reform of Food safety

articleTitle: Research on Application of BIM Technology in Building Carbon Emission Intelligent Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The article calculates and analyzes the energy consumption and carbon emissions of the BIM life cycle of decoration materials by establishing a calculation model for energy consumption and carbon emissions. At the same time, we proposed a real-time monitoring system framework for construction site carbon emissions based on cyber-physical system (CPS) technology. At the same time, we have realized the development of a real-time carbon emission monitoring system from two parts: hardware system and software system. The study found that the optimization of the decision-making system through the integration of global information technology has further improved the informatization level of operation management.
