articleTitle: Routing of vehicles by intelligent algorithms in the matter of transporting goods
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The task of route planning for a mobile robot or vehicle has attracted the attention of many research papers. In these writings, it is mostly assumed that the robot has a complete and accurate model of its surroundings before moving. Less attention has been paid to the issue of unknown environments. This is the case for a crawler or robot that has to move towards a target without a map of the area, such as vehicle route planning. Traditional intelligent Hard-NP optimization algorithms occur because this has been proven to be of the type they have not had much success in it. As a result, various innovative methods have been used to solve these problems. In the meantime, evolutionary methods are used as a population-based method with an increasing trend. On the other hand, for routing mobile robots, when the working space of the robot is clear, routing for the mobile robot is done in a global mode and offline. If the specifications of the environment are not known, routing is done locally and on the line by taking information from the sensors. In this research, the problem of routing a mobile robot in an unknown environment with two-dimensional dynamic barriers is addressed. Used off-line. Comparison and evaluation of the simulation results of the proposed evolutionary algorithms indicate that the robot guidance from the obtained path has the optimal criteria, in other words, the selected path length has the lowest cost and is much closer to the shortest possible path length.

articleTitle: Smart Guide Trolley Mango: Smart Blind Guide Device Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Nowadays, life support equipment for the visually impaired is not perfect, and the current blind guide equipment cannot meet the needs of the blind in the face of emergencies. Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent traction guidance trolley “Mango”, With good portability and accurate positioning, it is more suitable for the needs of blind people than traditional guidance tools. Mode 1 is the traction and obstacle avoidance mode. This mode firstly plays the current temperature, humidity, location and weather informa2tion to the blind. If the human body infrared sensor detects that the blind person is following, the voice will then broadcast “Blind person is following” and activa.go automatically advances and executes the tracing algorithm to guide blind along the blind path. Meanwhile, the best way to avoid obstacles is selected according to the ultrasonic obstacle avoidance algorithm, and information about the identified obstacles ahead is broadcast by voice to guide the blind person around the blind path or other obstacles in the walking path. Mode 2 is the remote monitoring mode. This means that by observing the view of the real-time camera, the family or friends of the blind can remotely control the trolley to find them or guide them with the trolley movements by opening the designated website on any computer or mobile phone and entering commands to control the movement of the Mango. In summary, the smart trolley Mango in this paper is a smart guided trolley that can help the blind to travel safely, and provides a new social direction for improving the quality of life of the visually impaired.

articleTitle: Analysis of Learning Behaviors Based on Learner Portraits
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: in this paper, by constructing learners portrait label system, integrating and screening out four dimensions of teaching interactive features, course completion features, learning engagement features, score features, it provides the measurement index for the labeling system of learners' portraits. Through data mining technologies such as clustering analysis and regression analysis, etc. it divides course learners into four groups, also explains the learning features and behavior features of each type of learners in detail, and identifies the factors that have the greatest influence on learning performance in learners' learning behaviors.

articleTitle: An Optimal Adaptive under Frequency Load Shedding Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Different short circuits, load growth, generation shortage, and other faults which disturb the voltage and frequency stability are serious threats to the system security. The frequency and voltage instability causes dispersal of a power system into sub-systems, and leads to blackout as well as heavy damages of the system equipment. This paper presents a fast and optimal adaptive load shedding method, for isolated power system using Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). The proposed method is able to determine the necessary load shedding in all steps simultaneously and is much faster than conventional methods. This method has been tested on the 10machine 39 node power system based on PSASP and MATLAB. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is fast, robust and optimal values of load shedding in different loading scenarios are obtained in comparison with conventional method.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of CT Saturation Caused by Aperiodic Components
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The intrusion of rail transit stray current into the power grid will cause the DC biasing phenomenon of electromagnetic power equipment such as transformers, which will affect the reliability of the relay protection judgment and the accuracy of the electric energy measurement. The equivalent circuit models is used to derive the mathematical models of the magnetic flux density, the parallel error and the phase error of CT under aperiodic components,and the influence of CT transfer characteristics on the instantaneous over-current protection under aperiodic components is analyzed. The PSCAD/EMTDC is used for simulation research. Analysis and simulation indicate that the aperiodic component of the line current will change the excitation characteristics by changing the bias of the core flux, which will adversely affect the transfer characteristics of CT and the correct operation of the protection. The research results provide a reference for the research on the influence of stray current on the accuracy of relay protection and electric energy measurement.

articleTitle: Research on License Plate Character Recognition Technology Based on Image Processing and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Character recognition methods are applied in many fields, greatly improving work efficiency in daily life[1], such as license plate retrieval, invoice printing recognition, lottery betting codes, tax reports, etc. Digital recognition has been widely used in the field of computer vision and image recognition, and deep learning algorithms are currently popular image recognition algorithms. Deep learning has been widely studied and applied in target recognition and speech content recognition. With the rapid increase in production requirements and computer data processing speed, the application of character recognition in actual production and life is becoming more and more common[2]. It is also extremely important for automatic retrieval and real-time, fast and accurate character input. However, traditional pattern recognition and feature extraction algorithms cannot well meet the requirements of real-time and correctness in production. At the same time, due to the vigorous development of deep learning, character recognition technology based on deep learning has advantages that traditional recognition algorithms cannot match. This paper proposes a barcode recognition algorithm based on a deep neural network combined with a global optimization method. It uses a convolutional recurrent network to extract the characteristics of each character in the barcode and classify it. Compared with the traditional method, it has stronger adaptability and generalization. Chemical energy.

articleTitle: Study on the Discoloration Mechanism of Cavity Type Microfluidic Camouflage Film
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this work, we propose a cavity type microfluidic camouflage discoloration film, which changes the pressure in the liquid cavity by controlling the contraction of the gas cavity, so that the colored liquid enters and exits the liquid cavity and camouflages the surface of the object. This manuscript describes microfluidic camouflage film that can change the color, contrast, pattern of object surface for camouflage and display. The discoloration principle and manufacturing process of the film are described. Using ANSYS Workbench, the fluid-structure interaction simulation and analysis of the film was carried out to study the discoloration mechanism of the film. The results show that the design of the cavity-type microfluidic camouflage film is reasonable and the flow characteristics of the film are good.

articleTitle: Multi-scale network traffic anomaly detection based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the transmission control ability of deep-loop multi-scale network communication, it is necessary to detect the anomaly of deep-loop multi-scale network communication flow. This paper proposes an anomaly detection method of deep-loop multi-scale network communication flow based on improved genetic algorithm, which uses genetic multi-scale variation feature detection method to collect the anomaly features of multi-scale network communication flow, and extracts the spectrum features of abnormal state distribution of multi-scale network communication flow. The output steady-state power spectral density analysis method is used to detect the spectral characteristics of multi-scale network communication traffic, and the balanced spectral characteristics of multi-scale network communication channels are constructed. The system inertia center feature analysis method is used to calculate the maximum power response of multi-scale network communication channels and adjust the output adaptively. The genetic evolution optimization detection method is used to detect the anomaly of multi-scale network communication traffic. The simulation results show that this method has high accuracy, strong output side stability control ability and good output oscillation suppression performance of multi-scale network traffic.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Unmanned Combat System under the Background of “Network Cloud Enabling”
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: “Unmanned combat, as the key direction of army transformation, has put forward high requirements for equipment information networking, and “network cloud enabling” is a collection of network communication technologies under the new situation, covering distributed computing technology, cloud technology and load balancing technology, etc. It can be effectively applied in the macro battlefield to provide effective, flexible, dynamic and highly reliable data services and information support for each unmanned combat unit. This paper analyzes the essence of “network cloud enabling” technology from the perspective of its connotation, and analyzes the system construction of “network cloud enabling” in unmanned combat battlefield application according to the framework of resource layer, capability layer, platform layer, application layer and management layer.

articleTitle: Application exploration of Daqing smart tourism big data based on association rule mining and machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper expounds the application and exploration of smart tourism in Daqing under the development of big data technology and the situation of COVID-19. Through the association rules mining, we build Daqing's global tourism data platform and realize intelligent tourism. Combined with the epidemic situation, the digital anti epidemic exploration of Daqing cultural and tourism scenic spot is carried out. Under the guidance of association rule mining and learning, the integration support of each association system is carried out to improve the confidence, so as to establish an all-round, integrated and intelligent smart tourism pattern.

articleTitle: An Efficient and Real-Time Emergency Exit Detection Technology for the Visually Impaired People Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Obtaining information from the surroundings has always been a great difficulty problem for visually impaired people. One of the most important problem is when facing an emergency, their security cannot be guaranteed. Whereas, there are no efficient assistant tools to help them recognize the emergency exit, which bring them great sense of fear. To get out this predicament, we adopt mature IFLYTEK voice recognition API and self-trained YOLOv5 object detection technology to purpose a emergency exit detection mini-program based on WeChat platform which can recognize the emergency exit signs by just acquiring a picture from the mobile phone camera. With the assistance of this mini-program, the safety of the visually impaired can be greatly improved.

articleTitle: Word Normalization Information Systems and Improved Learning Representation for Ontology Matching
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Biomedical ontology matching can find similar corresponds between biomedical ontologies to enable data integration. There are many ontology matching methods. Featurebased methods mainly focus on concept features to find mappings, ignoring semantic information and domain-specific morphology. On the other hand, learning representation methods think about the semantic information for hidden mappings but don't make full use of ontology structure. In this research, we propose a strategy for increasing performance by integrating the representation learning method with the feature-based method of additional word normalization. Our experiment is based on AgreementMakerLight (AML) and shows promising results.

articleTitle: Research on Cold Chain Logistics Credit Mechanism Based on Blockchain under Computer Big Data and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Blockchain technology has gradually been applied to various industries, and its own characteristics such as decentralization, immutability, and traceability have brought new development opportunities to various industries. Based on the concept and characteristics of blockchain technology, this article expounds the feasibility of applying blockchain technology in rural cold chain logistics credit mechanisms, the status quo of the industry and the challenges it faces. This article combines blockchain, edge computing, and the Internet of Things, starting from an engineering perspective, to build a blockchain-based end-to-end cold chain logistics credit mechanism demonstration and verification system. Verified how the blockchain prevents data tampering.

articleTitle: Safety traceability application of electrical equipment based on Internet of Things identification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The electric power industry is one of the most important energy basic industries in the development of the national economy. It involves a wide range of industries and has a long industrial chain. It is closely related to national security, social stability and people's life, and is also one of the key layout areas of China's industrial Internet construction. At the same time, the production, manufacturing, operation and service of the electric power industry are particularly important and special. Among them, the electrical equipment manufacturing industry has the characteristics of rich products, diverse production lines and testing lines, multi-source complex information system and complex control mode. The application of traceability management of important products of electrical equipment has become the focus of safe and efficient whole life cycle management. The informatization and automation of electrical equipment manufacturing industry are low, process standards are not unified, network infrastructure conditions are poor, equipment production quality and cost can not be effectively controlled. The assembly process of most electrical equipment products is still dominated by a lot of human labor. It is the only way to build a shared service application of electrical equipment manufacturing based on identification technology to meet the business development needs of enterprises, meet the national smart energy policy, meet the technical requirements of industrial Internet, and meet the needs of users. Through the safety traceability of power equipment marked by the Internet of things, it can not only realize the main body of safety traceability of enterprise electrical equipment industrial Internet identification system, but also transform and upgrade from manufacturing enterprises to service enterprises. Realizing industrial Internet automation is a reliable way out of intelligent manufacturing innovation. Fast and effective integration of existing industrial chain resources, weighing the maximum rights and interests between enterprises and users, the application of safety traceability can further achieve electrical equipment to lay a foundation for automated production.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Evaluation Index System of Digital Maturity of Automotive Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Digital transformation has become a compulsory topic for enterprise development. The digital transformation of the supply chain has aroused widespread concern in the society in the ongoing digitization process. As an important manufacturing industry, the automotive industry has a large number of upstream and downstream companies in the supply chain. In the process of digitization, in order to avoid shortcomings and seek more appropriate methods and paths to achieve coordinated transformation and upgrading, scientifically analyze and evaluate the digitization of the entire supply chain. The maturity level becomes especially important. Based on the analysis of the connotation and essence of digitization and the digital transformation of the supply chain, this article combines the actual needs of the digitization of the automotive supply chain, and establishes an evaluation index system for the digital maturity of the automotive supply chain through literature research and the use of expert interview methods. The system includes 5 key process areas (Strategy and organization, infrastructure construction, business innovation and transformation, supply chain ecological construction, supply chain performance), 12 first-level indicators and 39 second-level indicators. This evaluation index system can better reflect the changes in the overall operation mode of the supply chain under the digital business ecosystem and the comprehensive integration and system application of digital technology. It provides the industry with methods and tools to evaluate the comprehensive level of digitization, and helps to understand its own digital supply chain construction. To further effectively plan the construction path of the digital supply chain.

articleTitle: Discussion on Difficulties in Online Monitoring of Substation Boundary Noise
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The noise problem of substation boundary is attracting more and more attention. Traditional manual monitoring is more and more inadaptable to the needs, and the demand for online monitoring is overgrowing. However, the existing relevant standards are not entirely applicable, so there are no unified norms. This article discusses the necessity of online monitoring of noise at the station boundary, the interference of environmental noise on the measurement, the installation of measuring points, and the choices of equipment power supply and data transmission. The discussion has a reference value for the implementation of online noise monitoring in substation boundaries.

articleTitle: A Glimpse of Research on Underwater Target Intelligent Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Accurate detection and recognition technology of underwater targets is essential for accelerating the construction of our country's underwater offensive and defensive system and enhancing underwater combat capabilities. This article will focus on the development context and research status of target detection based on feature extraction, target detection based on matching field processing (MFP), and intelligent target detection technology. It compares the characteristics of different methods, clarifies the problems in the technology, and analyzes the trends to provides a reference for further research on underwater target detection technology.

articleTitle: Computer Assisted Design and Implementation of Diagnostic Evaluation Model in Online Test
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper preliminarily completes the design of English diagnostic evaluation scheme and related algorithms, and puts forward a new evaluation model to evaluate learners' learning status, infer learners' knowledge barriers, and adjust learners' learning strategies for College English Test. After using the diagnostic test system, learners can obtain the corresponding diagnostic report. At the same time, the system will analyze the learners' scores and recommend targeted test questions. Through more accumulation of learners' practice information on the diagnostic test system, it will provide a basis for the further improvement and perfection of the evaluation scheme, so as to improve the effect of diagnostic evaluation.

articleTitle: A Review of Improved CMOS Dynamic Comparators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper reviews some CMOS dynamic comparators that achieving high performances on different features. Based on conventional structures, a comparator with a dynamic floating inverter amplifier optimize their circuit by a floating reservoir capacitor, which achieves the best energy efficiency while is insensitive to common-mode voltage. The optimization of the Elzakker's comparators increases the pre-amplifier stage's structures by adding a tail capacitor and a tail transistor. And three-stage comparator with extra parallel feedback is discussed, decreasing delay significantly. The classic comparator comprises a differential input stage, two regenerative flip-flops, and an S-R latch is also mentioned.

articleTitle: Study the operation process of factory greenhouse robot based on intelligent dispatching method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The working environment of agricultural robots is farmland or greenhouse, and there are relatively many uncontrollable natural factors, and the growth of crops themselves is also constantly changing. Agricultural robots in such a complex environment to achieve mobile operation, but also to accurately control fertilization and spraying and other actions, which have put forward higher technical requirements for the development of agricultural robots. At present, with the popularization of robot scheduling system, more and more applications are used in industrial scenarios. However, the research of the factory greenhouse robot is in its initial stage. Therefore, this paper analyzes the operation process based on the intelligent scheduling method.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Used in Industrial Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Releasing human beings from hand working has always been an target of science and technology. With the booming of Computer Vision, how to combine it with automation Artificial Intelligence better becomes a valuable topic nowadays. This thesis is written to promote the realization of automated industrial robots by means of Computer Vision and Deep Learning. And in the area of Computer Vision, Object Detection is a core issue that cannot be circumvented. How to recognize specific targets such as small elements in the vision of robots and how to distinguish their features drove the birth of Edge Detection Algorithm, which is wildly used in the area of Computer Vision out of its ability to lessen work load by efficiently sieving out irrelevant information and accurately saving those valuable information to process with. The method for Edge Detection Algorithm to work more efficiently and better has been an study heat spot. Structured Forest is used to accelerate Edge Detection Algorithm and increase the precision of it to reduce the delay time to and satisfy the industrial standard in this thesis. Besides, graphical user interface development and design is a basic skill of a computer practitioner. In order to display the whole operation result more conveniently and apply it to all kinds of platforms, the user interface named demo system was created by the prospering development tool QT. The develop process and experience of QT will be attached to this thesis.

articleTitle: Research on cross-domain recommendation algorithm based on quadratic collaborative filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Among the existing recommendation algorithms, the single domain recommendation algorithm has serious defects, and the cross-domain recommendation algorithm becomes a new development direction. To solve the problem of data missing in collaborative filtering algorithm, a cross-domain recommendation algorithm for quadratic collaborative filtering is proposed. The accuracy of the recommendation system can be improved by predicting the missing data with two similarity matrices. Through empirical study, experimental results show that the quadratic collaborative filtering cross-domain recommendation algorithm can achieve the purpose of cross-domain recommendation, and the performance comparison with the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm shows that the quadratic collaborative filtering cross-domain recommendation algorithm can improve the accuracy of prediction.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Frequency Meter Based on Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The frequency meter is widely used in the electronic equipment measured with respect to. As researchers continue to improve and upgrade frequency counters, the commonly used digital frequency counters now generally use digital circuits to measure the frequency of periodic signals. The frequency output value of the measured signal is converted by the internal algorithm of the digital cymometer, and the final measurement result will be converted into a decimal number and displayed on the display screen, which can make the measurement result more intuitive and improve the frequency measurement efficiency. In this design, the frequency of the measured signal is collected by the STC89C52 single-chip microcomputer. After the signal is collected, the internal of the single-chip microcomputer will analyze and convert the collected signal, and the final analysis and conversion result will be displayed on the LCD 1602 LCD screen.

articleTitle: Image Aesthetic Computer Assessment Model Based on Score Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The quantification of image aesthetic quality has always been a hot topic in the field of computer vision. Aesthetic quality assessment is a very challenging task because of its subjectivity. This paper regarded image aesthetics assessment as an aesthetic score distribution task by fine-tuning the traditional convolutional neural network VGG16. We replaced the fully connected layer with a convolutional layer and added an adaptive spatial pooling layer at the end of the network to circumvent the traditional network's limitations of the input size. In addition, we proposed the cross-entropy loss function for sample reliability. On the aesthetic dataset AVA, our improved model achieved a better performance.

articleTitle: Image Deblurring Analysis Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Nowadays, people take pictures more and more in daily life. However, since the objects they photograph are not always static, they will produce blur and impair image quality. In most cases, people are unlikely to get another opportunity to take pictures, so in order to solve the problem of deblurring blurred images, this article uses an algorithm based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) to achieve this goal, mainly using DeblurGANv2 Code. By comparing the effects of using the Resnet, FPN-Mobile-net and FRN-Inception structures in the Generator, this article shows a relatively effective method of defuzzification, that is, using FPN-Mobile-net in the Generator, and in the generator Use Double-GAN discriminator.

articleTitle: Suggestions and Effect Evaluation Model for Automobile Manufacturers' Deployment of Power Battery Recycling and Utilization under the Dual-Carbon Target
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The market of power battery recycling is gradually rising, which has attracted great attention from government departments and all walks of life. The proposal of “3060” double carbon target has promoted the strategic layout and blueprint planning of power battery recycling of related enterprises. There are many opportunities and challenges for automobile manufacturers to enter the power battery recycling market. This paper analyzes the current situation and future trend of the power battery recycling market from the aspects of policy environment, market opportunities, economy and risk, and puts forward strategic suggestions for automobile manufacturers on how to enter the field of power battery recycling more efficiently and steadily.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation System Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of evolutionary learning of user preferences and high-dimensional sparse data processing in personalized recommendation systems. Inspired by the structural features of Hidden Markov Model, a personalized recommendation algorithm considering context-aware two-stage user preference set reasoning strategy) is proposed. By processing the historical scoring information of the system, the extraction process of user preferences is abstracted into a hidden Markov model to perform the first stage of user preference set learning and reasoning. Then, the occurrence probability of these scoring objects is weighted with the traditional item similarity calculation method to obtain the new similarity, and finally the recommendation result is generated. In the simulation experiment, the important parameters of the algorithm are trained, and compared with other algorithms, it is proved that the improved algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Multi-view Road Disease Detection Based on Attention Fusion and Distillation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The radar dataset collected by the three-dimensional ground-penetrating radar is presented as multiple views, which is difficult to analyze manually. Disease detection based on multi-view radar maps extremely requires expert experience and knowledge. The high cost of labeling results in a small number of samples, which makes the task more difficult. One solution to this problem is to create a deeper network to extract disease features, but this is not conducive to practical use. Therefore, we propose a two-stage attention fusion and distillation model for multi-view road disease detection, which enables us to make full use of multi-view datasets and improve their practical application in road detection. Experiments show that our model can use fewer parameters and calculations to achieve high accuracy on both original and enhanced datasets.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Library Digital Resources Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Featured resources are a valuable asset of a library, and are the embodiment of its distinctiveness and individualization. These resources depend on the existence of a variety of different media. As an effective method of resource display and disclosure, visualization technology can make it easier for users to understand and use the various media characteristic resources of the library. This article comprehensively uses social network visualization and knowledge measurement methods to construct a visualization model for the knowledge aggregation of digital library resources from knowledge unit mining, knowledge domain development, knowledge network construction, knowledge graph presentation and knowledge visualization applications, with a view to building a digital library The fine-grained aggregate object mining of resources, the disclosure of multi-dimensional knowledge structure, the visual display of static and dynamic interactive knowledge, and the application of precise knowledge analysis provide reference for reference.

articleTitle: A blind source separation sorting algorithm for sonar echo signal based on frequency-point amplitude correlation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Due to reflection, delay and other factors, sonar echo signal usually has convolution mixing form. Frequency domain blind source separation can effectively solve the convolution mixed signal. But blind source separation must solve the sorting problem. According to the characteristics of large amplitude correlation of adjacent frequency points of echo signal. In this paper, proposing a frequency domain blind source separation sorting algorithm, which calculates and arranges the amplitude correlation of adjacent frequency points. Finally sorted the separated signals in frequency domain. And conducting blind source separation experiments on simulated target echo signals and sonar collected data. Experimental results showed the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

Author Keywords: amplitude correlation of adjacent frequency points

articleTitle: Application of Training Simulation Software and Virtual Reality Technology in Civil Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article takes the teaching method of basic experiment courses in civil engineering as the research object, and proposes civil engineering based on virtual simulation technology. The teaching plan of engineering experiment training courses. Relying on the real system and simulation training center, nine training projects including reinforced concrete simple beam experiment, short column experiment, and shaking table experiment, which are widely used in civil engineering applications, have been constructed. At the same time, a three-dimensional simulation system of the engineering structure experiment center has been constructed. Functions include the overall 3D display of indoor and outdoor scenes in the experimental center, as well as the 3D model, function display and experimental simulation of large-scale experimental equipment and characteristic experimental systems.

articleTitle: Localization Approach for Forced Oscillation Source Based on Synchrosqueezed Wavelet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The localization of forced oscillation sources is of great significance for power system stability. This paper proposes a localization approach based on synchrosqueezed wavelet. First, the wide-area measurement data is processed by synchrosqueezed wavelet to extract oscillation mode parameters. Moreover, the dissipated energy flow of each generator is calculated based on the extracted mode parameters. In addition, according to the direction of dissipated energy flow, the forced oscillation source is localized. Finally, the WECC 240-bus system is used to verified the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Analysis on the current situation of solar energy utilization in Shannan area of Tibet and suggestions for popularization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Tibet is rich in solar energy resources. Through investigation and analysis of the current situation of the use of new energy in 13 primary and secondary schools in Shannan, Tibet, this paper expounds the relevant problems existing in the development and utilization of solar energy in Shannan, Tibet, and puts forward the current situation and problems of the utilization of solar energy resources in Tibet and the planning suggestions for popularization.

articleTitle: Application of big data technology in petroleum engineering intelligent information system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The traditional IE system takes a long time to query petroleum information and has poor information management effect. Based on this, a petroleum engineering information system based on big data technology is designed. In the hardware design, the performance index of the sensor is designed, and the voltage conversion module is set inside the E-ECU(Engineering problem processing electronic control unit) chip. In terms of software design, the petroleum engineering information management module is established to ensure the standardization of system design, integrate big data technology, build petroleum information database, shorten data query time, and then realize petroleum information management. The system test shows that the information query time of the system designed in this paper is less than 0.1ms, the information management effect is better, and it is of great promotion value.

articleTitle: Indoor 220GHz Channel Measurements and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, a related time domain THz channel sounding method is proposed. In the experiment, the carrier frequency is 216 GHz and the measurement bandwidth is 5GHz. Vector Network Analyzer is used to collect impulse response of indoor environment and analyze the characteristics of channel propagation in path gain and delay. The measurement result shows that the path loss is greater than the free space at most frequency points, and there is no significant multipath effect in the measurement due to the high directivity of the horn antenna.

articleTitle: Calculation and Data Analysis of Waste Batteries Recycling Mathematical Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: After the power battery capacity of new energy vehicles decays to a certain level, it will enter the retirement stage. If the decommissioned power battery is not properly disposed of, it will pollute the environment. At the same time, the non-standard storage of power battery will also produce potential safety hazards. Based on the current situation of the industry, this paper combs and analyzes the mainstream business model of waste power battery recycling, calculates and analyzes the economy of ternary power battery recycling. The results show that the content of lithium, cobalt, nickel and manganese in ternary battery is high, which has high economic value of recycling.

articleTitle: Research on Comparison Analysis of Fiber Grating Based Strain Monitoring Sensors in the Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Recently, the state has used fiber Bragg grating (FBG) measuring technology to monitor the safety of large building steel structure detection, power power, traffic road, geological earthquake and other industries. For example, the fiber Bragg grating strain sensor is an important detection equipment for seismic monitoring, and its measurement accuracy should be no less than 0.05% or higher. High-precision strain measuring instruments based on fiber Bragg grating technology have been studied at home and abroad, and the accuracy is required to be better than several microstrains and even reach the level of nanostrain. Therefore, it is of great significance to establish and improve the research on the calibration and measurement traceability of fiber Bragg grating strain sensor in order to adapt to the continuous development of fiber Bragg grating measurement technology and use requirements. Transport highway research institute by combining traffic engineering disciplines, mechanical design, mechanical processing and materials engineering disciplines such as professional knowledge, has carried on the finite element analysis, the analysis of the mathematical model validation, design the laboratory can use online calibration device such as a cantilever beam intensity, finally realizes the comparing the fiber Bragg grating strain sensor testing in the laboratory.

articleTitle: Thermal Power Load Calculation Model and Resistance Analysis Based on Exhaust Pressure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to grasp the available space of unit and solve the problem of insufficient dispatching during the peak load in summer, an analysis method for the output space of the steam turbine generator unit with vacuum is proposed. By introducing the benchmark back pressure (11.8kPa), the back pressure-load calculation model is established to calculate the adjustable output of the unit deviated from the benchmark back pressure or external industrial steam supply, and the model is applied to the online monitoring platform of thermopower units in Shandong Province. Through the display of the unit's residual load, combined with the remote test of the maximum output of the unit in summer, the factors affecting the load of the unit are analyzed. The comparison results of the model and the test data show that the exhaust pressure-based load analysis model can monitor the maximum output capacity of the unit, detect the output obstructive factor in time, optimize the load adjustment space, which is helpful for alleviating the summer load pressure.

articleTitle: Five-axis NURBS Toolpath Fitting Method Based on Shear Leap Characteristic Points
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A five-axis NURBS tool path fitting method based on shear leap characteristic points is proposed to address the problem of generating dense discrete tool data points during five-axis tool path planning of the existing computer-aided manufacturing system. The shear leap degree of each knife position point is calculated using three adjacent points, and the dominant point of shear leap degree is selected as the initial type value point for sample fitting, and the precision-preserving type value point is added in the area where the local fitting deviation exceeds the limit, until the obtained curve meets the accuracy requirement. The simulation results show that the fitting accuracy can be well preserved even if a large number of original discrete tool position data points are removed using the method of this paper, which is of high value for the application in the field of spline CNC programming.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis of green building research hotspots based on bibliometrics big data and cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As a kind of natural and harmonious building form, green building can provide healthy, comfortable and efficient living space, while minimizing the resources, protecting the environment, and reducing pollution throughout the life cycle, and the research of green buildings has become a hot topic in the field. This paper analyzes the influence of green construction literature at home and abroad, is the research hotspot and the prediction evolution trend, which is beneficial to the theoretical progress and the practice optimization. The paper USES the method of measuring and knowledge mapping of cnki and web of science database in 2000, which is a sample of the literature of cnki and the web of science database, and the key words of the research of green architecture are the current area map, and the future research implications of the development of the developing countries, the green construction industry and the design of green buildings are studied.

articleTitle: Application of Comprehensive Utilization Intelligent System of Multiple Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the national strategic goals of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, taking the energy center of a university in North China as an example, the comprehensive utilization of multiple renewable energy and the application of clean peak shaving energy systems in colleges and universities are analyzed. The best fit points for comprehensive utilization of multiple energy sources, such as shallow ground source heat pumps, medium-deep ground source heat pumps, and gas boiler peak shaving, are studied. The key point of using the low investment and high output characteristics of gas-fired boilers as the peak-shaving heat source is put forward. Combining with the law of heat load changes and usage characteristics of colleges and universities, an energy-saving solution for on-duty heating is proposed. The comprehensive utilization of multiple energy sources improves the safety and energy saving of the supply of cold and heat sources in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on a closing and opening manipulator of molded case circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Circuit breaker is an important electrical product for the protection and control of electrical equipment. In order to ensure the safe operation of its closing and opening operation, it is of great practical significance and practical value to explore a more stable and reliable manipulator. This paper provides a closing and opening manipulator of plastic shell circuit breaker, which can not only solve the problem of limited place, but also prolong the service life of the manipulator.

articleTitle: Mathematical evaluation model of financing constraints and R&D innovation from the perspective of big data and cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Big data and fintech are on the rise. It will directly affect the R&D behavior of enterprises, and indirectly affect their R&D input through financing support. In the context of big data and fintech, this paper analyzes the impact of ownership structure and financing capacity on the R&D investment of listed private enterprises through the data of corporate governance and R&D investment of listed private enterprises in the past ten years. Through empirical analysis, it is found that the internal and external financing capacity has a significant positive impact on the R&D investment of listed private enterprises. The equity concentration of private enterprises will also affect the enterprise's R&D investment activities. And the financing capacity has different influence ways on the R&D investment under different equity concentration. Considering the possible path dependence of R&D investment, the lag effect of R&D investment is analyzed by generalized moment estimation of dynamic panel model.

articleTitle: Selection Method and Algorithm of International Benchmarking Objects in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To build a world-class distribution network, we need to pay attention to the role of benchmarking management. This paper focuses on the screening methods of international matching objects of distribution assets. First, the principle of advanced nature and the principles of adaptability of international benchmarking are first proposed. On the basis of that, the criteria for selecting benchmarks for advanced principles and the screening methods of benchmarking objects based on adaptive principles are also presented.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Comprehensive Evaluation Model of Energy Storage Power Station with Full Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Currently, the research on the evaluation model of energy storage power station focuses on the cost model and economic benefit model of energy storage power station, and less consideration is given to the social benefits brought about by the long-term operation of energy storage power station. Taking the investment cost into account, economic benefit and social benefit, this paper establishes a comprehensive benefit evaluation model based on the life cycle of the energy storage power station, and verifies the scientificity of the comprehensive evaluation model by the example of the energy storage power station in Changsha, Hunan Province, which provides a convenient comprehensive evaluation method for the construction of the energy storage power station

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Network Course Virtual Simulation System Based on Digital Media Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In view of the current situation where English teaching is limited to the introduction of popular science concepts, single teaching methods, lack of information visualization learning tools, and difficulty in meeting the needs of learners for the construction of learning situations, we propose the application of virtual reality technology to the three-dimensional construction of college English teaching process Model and optimization. Finally, a virtual reality simulation and control system for English teaching was designed and developed. It supports three-dimensional interaction. Learners can master English immersively, aiming to increase the sense of immersion and entertainment in the learning process, reduce the cognitive load of the learners, and can improve the quality of English teaching.

articleTitle: Coverage Analysis of Conical Beam Antenna for LEO Satellite Relay Terminal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The data relay satellite is located in the geostationary orbit, and uses the favorable geometric position to perform the data relay of LEO satellite TT&C beyond the line of sight of the ground station. Aiming at the requirement of wide beam coverage of relay terminal TT&C antenna, a conical beam antenna is designed in this paper. Using STK simulation software combined with TLE orbital elements information of relay satellites and LEO satellites, the link establishing time and coverage between relay satellites and LEO satellites are analyzed, and the coverage analysis under single/multiple relay satellites is given. The parameters of link simulation include: the number of links that can be established, the shortest communication time, the longest communication time, and the total link establishment time, etc. The simulation results have important guiding significance for the application of LEO relay terminals.

articleTitle: Some thoughts on the application of 3D printing technology in the field of maintenance and support of large construction machinery and equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As an advanced manufacturing technology, 3D printing technology is widely used in the field of large-scale engineering equipment, which is not limited to the research and development of engineering equipment, but also has great application prospects in the field of maintenance and support of large-scale engineering machinery and equipment. By introducing the basic principle of 3D printing technology, this paper focuses on the transformative impact of 3D printing technology on the maintenance and support field of large engineering mechanical equipment from four aspects: improving equipment maintenance and support efficiency, saving equipment maintenance and support cost, changing equipment maintenance and support mode and promoting the ability transformation of equipment maintenance and support talents, Finally, according to the practical problems of 3D printing technology, the prospect of 3D printing technology is prospected, which provides reference significance for the follow-up research of 3D printing technology in the maintenance support of large construction machinery and equipment.

articleTitle: Information Disclosure and Privacy Protection System in Epidemic Prevention and Control under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to effectively solve the conflict and contradiction between citizens' personal information disclosure and citizens' right to privacy protection in epidemic prevention and control, this paper proposes a novel information disclosure and privacy protection system in epidemic prevention and control under the background of big data. The system fully combines the advantages of big data technology and the characteristics of epidemic prevention and control work, and starts from the dimensions of informed consent rules, personal information right, right to know, public interest and personal privacy. Based on this, the system also emphasizes the legitimacy and transparency of the epidemic prevention and control work, as well as the importance of building a sound and efficient accountability mechanism. The results show that the system can effectively solve the contradiction and conflict between personal information disclosure and personal privacy to a certain extent.

articleTitle: A low-power, small area and low manufacturing cost oscillator circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to reduce the area, power consumption and manufacturing cost of the DC power management chip, this letter presents a small area, low power consumption and low manufacturing cost oscillator scheme applied to the DC power management chip. The proposed oscillator scheme applies a new type of reference voltage scheme, which consists of four depletion NMOS transistors and a resistor to reduce manufacturing costs, circuit area, and power consumption. The proposed oscillator scheme has been implemented with 0.18µm process and layout area is 170µm×110µm. At the supply voltage of 1.8-5V, the total power consumption the proposed oscillator is 0.8-3µw and generate a 5.5 kHz square wave.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Online Evaluation of Synthesized Performance of the De-NOx System in Coal-fired Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the online analysis of various key performance indicators of the De-NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> system, an online diagnosis method of the De-NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> system operation is achieved in this paper, which provides intelligent management and control suggestions for the optimization of the De-NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> system operation mode, and therefore serves the high operation efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Engineering Methodology of E-Wisdom Enterprise Service Hub Intelligent Information System & Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the era of information & knowledge economy, the capabilities of IT and knowledge management play a critical role for any enterprise success. In order to solve the challenge issues of inappropriate IT & knowledge capabilities faced by SMEs, in this paper we propose an engineering methodology to build e-wisdom enterprise service hub system, which is utilized to server as a digital business ecosystem for SMEs. A knowledge-intensive management theory is discussed and employed as the basis of shared innovative capability. In addition, the software architecture of the system, coordination methodology of the physical infrastructure and cyber infrastructure system, is designed and investigated to provide the solution of KMaaS (Knowledge-intensive Model as a Service) from the engineering perspective. Our approach supports sociality, knowledge-intensiveness, core capability collaboration, specialization of Enterprise Cloud Computing System for SMEs.

articleTitle: Design and application of substation simulation training system suitable for internet multi-mode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As a training tool to improve the professional skills of substation operation and maintenance personnel, Substation simulation training system plays an irreplaceable role in improving the daily monitoring, normal operation, abnormal and accident handling skills of trainees. This paper describes the development process of substation simulation training system, puts forward the existing problems in the current application, puts forward the substation training simulation system based on “teaching, learning, training, examination, evaluation” multi-teaching mode as one, and introduces the realization of different modes and key technologies in detail. Relying on the “Internet +” intelligent learning platform, we standardize the work flow of substation operation and maintenance personnel, improve trainees' daily monitoring, normal operation, abnormal and accident handling skills, and provide continuous and reliable human resources support.

articleTitle: Study on optimal adjustment of ammonia injection in thermal power units based on deep peak shaving
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the proposal of the goal of carbon peak and carbon neutralization, the thermal power unit has gradually changed from the main power supply to the regulating power supply. Frequent peak shaving of thermal power units will lead to uneven ammonia injection in denitration system, resulting in high ammonia escape rate of units. Based on the problems of ash accumulation and blockage of air preheater caused by high ammonia escape rate of a 350MW heating unit, the denitration optimization is studied through the combination of theoretical research and experimental research. Through denitration optimization and adjustment, it is calculated that the economic benefit brought to the unit is about 443000, and the optimized operation and adjustment contents and precautions are obtained according to the operation experience, so as to provide reference experience for the optimization and adjustment of similar units.

articleTitle: A Recommendation Model of Deeply Fusion Rating matrix and Review Text
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of deep learning technology, some work applies deep learning to recommendation system. In order to further improve the quality of recommendation, we propose a recommendation model of deeply fusion rating matrix and review text. In this paper, the variable convolution neural network is used to process the review text, and the attention mechanism is introduced to extract the representative reviews. The depth neural network is used to process the rating, extract the depth features, and fuse the features to predict the user's rating. In this paper, three real data sets are verified, and the mean square error MSE is used as the evaluation index. The results show that our proposed model can achieve better recommendation effect than multiple baseline models.

articleTitle: Research on Control Mechanism of FAST Nodes Based on Goal Programming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As one of the three major innovations of FAST, the active reflective surface is composed of main components such as the main cable net, reflective panel, pull-down cable, actuator and supporting structure. Its essence is to adjust the reflecting surface in the illumination range to the designated parabolic position in real time according to the position of the observed celestial body, so that the parallel electromagnetic waves emitted by the celestial body will always converge at one point after being reflected by the reflecting surface. Aiming at the problem that the Chinese FAST sky eye reflector panel automatically adjusts the overall shape to the working paraboloid to achieve the best electromagnetic wave reflection effect under the condition of different positions of the measured celestial body, a single target optimization, target planning, single reflector panel and other models have been constructed. With the ideal parabola and actuator adjustment scheme, the reception ratio after adjustment is increased by 5 times. According to the adjustment strategy of the reflective panel obtained by the research, the nodes with a node displacement greater than 0.5m account for 0.14%, and the performance is good.

articleTitle: Research on Treatment of Bus Voltage Sudden Change in Equipment operation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: During the conversion process of the main transformer low-band feeder bus mode, the main transformer power supply of the bus and the reactive power compensation provided by the equipment on the bus may change, which may cause sudden changes in the bus voltage, which cannot be accurately measured by the operator, which affects voltage sensitivity Precision manufacturing can endanger personal safety in serious cases. The article converts the influence of the main gear position on the bus voltage into the influence of reactive power on the voltage, and quickly analyzes the influence of the operation on the voltage mutation from the same dimension, and incorporates the bus voltage mutation into the switch During the operation check, the five preventions are locked to maintain the voltage stability and ensure the safe production of users.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Exploration of the Knowledge-Coin Value System of State Grid School Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As the core platform of online training of State Grid, State Grid School has an important internal implementation and external transformation role in the education and training knowledge and education and training achievements of State Grid. In the context of the existing platform framework, this paper introduces the blockchain technology to deepen the reform of the knowledge-coin system of this system, explore the establishment of a knowledge resource trading system based on the State Grid School and the training cloud service platform, and build an efficient and flexible value system across the internal and external network.

articleTitle: Fuzzy analytic hierarchy process applied in product reputation research through reviews, ratings and big data analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Number of comments praised: “helpful votes” in the title, replaced by the number of comments praised for comments, easier to understand. The reputation of a product largely depends on word of mouth from consumers. With the development of the Internet, online rating reviews have gradually replaced offline communications. Consumers can obtain comprehensive information about related products from the Internet, product ratings and good Of reviews can lead other potential consumers to make rational purchases. However, the ratings and comments on the Internet are not completely credible, the society is developing rapidly, and the quality of reviews is uneven. Therefore, a review voting mechanism was introduced. The more votes received, the more authentic and credible the review. In order to predict the development trend of new products, we measure the quality of products by researching the ratings and reviews of similar competitive products.

articleTitle: Bus peak period scheduling scheme: An improved multi-stage decision model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, we improve the bus departure scheduling model and propose a combined bus scheduling model based on dynamic programming. According to the actual requirements, we use an objective function that combines bus profitability, passenger detention time and passenger comfort, then establish the required state transition equations and bus passenger carrying model. In particular, we add a profitability threshold constraint for off-peak hours and a finiteness constraint on the number of people and vehicles to make the model more general and universal. We use the results to derive some analytical properties and use these findings to propose a solution to the scheduling problem of moving from peak to flat period when passenger flow decreases and then back to peak period.

articleTitle: Multi dimensional disease intelligent detection device for underwater pier column structure through machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The total number of railway bridges in China has exceeded twenty thousand. As an important part of the railway line, the existing railway bridge bears great live load, excessive concentrated force, obvious dynamic effect and high requirements for foundation stability. However, because the underwater structure of Railway Pier is constantly affected by many factors such as water scouring and ship collision during its service, it leads to a variety of diseases such as concrete peeling and exposed reinforcement. These diseases are often hidden in the water, which poses a serious threat to the structural safety of the bridge and the safety of people's lives and property. However, the traditional detection method of underwater structure of Railway Pier is affected by water flow, water quality, water depth and other environment, which has the pain points of high detection risk, low efficiency, poor detection data quality and missing disease location, so it is difficult to effectively detect underwater structure diseases; In this context, a multi-dimensional disease detection device is designed and developed for Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge (both highway and railway). The device includes a fixed module on water and an underwater detection module, which can realize safe and efficient detection under the condition of rapids and deep water, solve the problems that it is difficult for personnel and existing equipment to reach the structure to be tested, and the detection effect obtained by existing detection means is not ideal The detection information is not comprehensive, which is difficult to be used for key problems such as follow-up structural technical state evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on DM Algorithm Based on Association Rules and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, DM technology has attracted extensive attention in the information industry, which is the inevitable result of the contradiction between the rapidly growing amount of data and the increasingly poor amount of information. Systematic and in-depth research on DM technology is the objective requirement of global information development. There are many research fields of DM technology, among which association rules is an important research direction and has extremely important application value. DM is to mine useful information from a large amount of data. Its main goal is to mine valuable information for users from a large database. Facing the situation of “a large amount of data, but little knowledge”, DM technology came into being. This discipline originated in the field of database and artificial intelligence has formed a system and began to play a great role in practical application. This paper is mainly engaged in the research related to association rule DM algorithm.

articleTitle: Exit Decisions Inspired by Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Bounded rationality is one of the key components of human behaviors. Human action normally involves experience accumulation, exploration, and a combination of them. Though it is invisible and difficult to model, in this work, we propose a reinforcement learning-based model and applied it to a particular escaping case to evaluate the behavior of an intelligent agent who wants to optimize its efficiency to escape a typical map. The result resembles the tendency of humans in a procedure of escape including a strong tendency to move out near the exit, randomness when further away from the exit, and some tendency to move near the boundary of the map. Such behaviors are very close to human behaviors which indicates that the decisions made in emergence are mainly based on experience. Such a perception-action model of RL learning can be used in a multi-agent model to investigate collective behaviors.

articleTitle: Stability Evaluation of Deep Foundation Pit Based on RBF-AHP-Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The RBF-AHP-Fuzzy Comprehensive Model is established according to the engineering facts to make a systematic and reliable evaluation of Slope stability of deep foundation pit. Using four calculation methods to calculate the weight coefficient and processing the results comprehensively to make the result more objective. Finally, an engineering example is substituted to prove that the method is effective and has considerable engineering guiding significance.

articleTitle: Effect of geometric parameters on heat transfer performance of square tube wound tubular heat exchanger
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Through the method of establishing mathematical calculation model, this paper obtains the calculation formulas of the distance between two adjacent tubes in the adjacent layer of square tube wound tubular heat exchanger, the cross-sectional area of shell side channel and pipe diameter, layer spacing and pipe spacing. According to the formula, it can be concluded that the larger the pipe diameter, the better the heat transfer performance; the larger the layer spacing, the worse the heat transfer performance; the larger the tube spacing, the worse the heat transfer performance. By establishing a three-dimensional unit physical model, the conclusions are simulated and analyzed from the aspects of pressure loss and total heat transfer coefficient by using flow field simulation software, and then the simulated data are fitted and estimated by using MATLAB software. The results show that the mathematical calculation model is basically reasonable and reliable. This method provides a theoretical reference for the research and optimal design of the influence of square tube wound tube heat exchanger on heat transfer performance.

Author Keywords: square tube wound tube heat exchanger

articleTitle: An optimized particle swarm optimization algorithm is used for Moire fringe signal correction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper presents a moire fringe signal detection and processing system based on improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm, which can effectively improve the subdivision accuracy of photoelectric encoder. Firstly, based on the working principle of photoelectric encoder and the generation mode of Moire fringe signal, the Moire fringe signal is expressed by constructing a mathematical model. And the subdivision error of Moire fringe signal is analyzed, and the correction model of signal error is constructed. By analyzing and comparing different algorithms, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is selected to solve the parameters of the actual moire fringe signal, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is optimized to reduce the number of iterations and speed up the operation speed. By drawing the normal distribution of the number of iterations before and after the improvement, the effect of the improvement of the algorithm can be observed. The designed system can compensate and correct the factors of subdivision error caused by quadrature deviation, DC level drift and sinusoidal error.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Virtual Reality Technology and Artificial Intelligence in Remote Network Course
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With its unique characteristics of full immersion and interactivity, virtual reality technology provides powerful support for the creation of teaching situations and greatly changes the way students learn. The article uses design and development research methods to build a deep learning field model based on virtual reality technology. The author designs an immersive English learning system based on Kinect somatosensory equipment, introduces somatosensory recognition and speech recognition technology into English teaching, and supports virtual scenes with machine dialogue, pronunciation correction, real-time translation, reading training, English games and other functions. It has the advantages of humanized design, easy operation, customizable and strong scalability, and provides comprehensive help for English learners.

articleTitle: Big Data Analyzing Techniques in Mathematical House Price Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The Chinese house market has been flourishing in the past three decades as an increasingly bigger population moves into cities. To keep the rise of house price within a proper range and acceptable to the public, the government has adopted various approaches to bring the price under control. After intermittent fluctuations, house purchasing has become a hot topic for both the media and the public. It is of great significance to study the change of house price considering all the related factors. Some scientists prefer machine learning. Machine learning is a subject which involves many subjects such as probability theory, statistics, approximation theory, convex analysis, and algorithm complexity theory. In this paper, we will discuss the details of the machine learning algorithms, three typical models (i.e., AdaBoost, Linear Regression and KNN) and their strengths and weaknesses. In the future, the growing complexity of all the factors that influence house price will cause more and more trouble for scientists pursuing more precise results. Also, based on its own specialty that computer is still not able to think like a man, machine learning cannot achieve 100% right, which often results in some silly outcomes.

articleTitle: Application of BIM technology and intelligent monitoring system in building quality control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The quality problems of rural buildings are frequent. The information model quality control based on BIM technology is conducive to the decision-making, design, construction and operation and maintenance of the owners, to achieve the real sense of quality control before, during and after the event, and to provide technical support for the safety of rural buildings.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of D-IoT Management Platform Based on Smart IoT Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The D-IoT management platform is an important part of the platform layer of smart IoT management system.
