It provides a unified transmission channel for business data collection, standardizes the unified data collection format and collection communication protocol, and provides a unified and unique data source for the enterprise platform, so as to provide technical support for creating comprehensive state perception, efficient processing of information and convenient application in the ubiquitous power Internet of things scene.

articleTitle: Research on the Image Calculation and Change of Glacier Area in West Kunlun Based on Remote Sensing and Information Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Glaciers can very sensitively reflect environmental changes in a certain area and are one of the important factors commonly used to study climate change. The Kunlun Mountain glacier and its glacial melt water are the most important water resources in western China, and are of great significance to maintaining the fragile ecological balance of the region and the sustainable development of social economy. Based on the remote sensing images of Landsat TM, MSS and Landsat 8 OLI from 1997 to 2017, this paper studies the changes of glaciers in the region over the past 20 years by extracting information from the images. The research results show that the Kunlun Mountain glacier as a whole shows a phenomenon of shrinking glacier area. Based on the analysis of meteorological data, we infer that the changes in the Kunlun Mountain glacier area are mainly caused by the combined effects of average temperature and annual cumulative precipitation. The increase in precipitation from 1997 to 2007 led to an increase in the area of glaciers, while the area of glaciers from 2007 to 2016 increased. The reduction is related to the average temperature.

articleTitle: Punctuality Analysis of Aviation Industry Based on Python Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Computer technology is an important application of today's technology, it has brought great convenience to transportation industry, the air transport industry occupies an important economic position, he led a huge transport system. As an important tool of information construction, data warehouse and data mining technology have unique advantages in dealing with massive data. Application of big data mining algorithm in aviation industry resources shoule be possible. To ensure the punctuality of aircrafr. Based on Python data mining algorithm, this paper solves the problem of low punctuality rate in the aviation industry, and proposes the methods of improving punctuality rate of aviation industry through the analysis of air transport data.

articleTitle: Application of power condition monitoring system in ocean exploration robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of lead-acid battery and combined with the functional requirements of ocean exploration robot, a condition monitoring system of lithium battery is proposed. The main modules of the condition monitoring system are designed, which can effectively detect the current, voltage and temperature signals. The layout of the system is topology. After the system design is completed, it is optimized, which effectively reduces the duty area of the circuit board and significantly improves the heat dissipation performance. According to the test results, the data display is correct, the maximum test deviation is less than 1%, and the equalization effect meets the working requirements.

articleTitle: Fault Identification of Dry-type Potential Transformer Combining Improved Genetic Algorithm and Frequency Domain Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, insulation faults of dry-type potential transformer (PT) occur frequently, which seriously affects the safe and reliable operation of power system. Since insulation failure is one of the main factors causing dry-type PT retirement, it is very significant to perform the insulation condition diagnosis and identification of dry-type PT, which can lay a foundation for reliable operation and maintenance of dry-type PT. In this paper, the frequency dielectric principle of dry-type PT are analyzed deeply. Then the frequency dielectric response measurement system is established to test the frequency dielectric properties of dry-type PT with good insulation and degraded insulation from 10–<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> Hz to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>Hz. Moreover, combined with the improved genetic algorithm, the RC circuit parameters of dry-type PT with good insulation and degraded insulation are identified and analyzed. Finally, based on the RC circuit parameters, the evolution mechanism of frequency dielectric properties of dry-type PT with good insulation and degraded insulation is discussed. This paper can provide technical support and reference for fault diagnosis of dry-type PT and other power equipment.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of the secondary air offset adjustment of the octagonal tangentially boiler on the deviation of the flue gas temperature
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Boilers using fan milling systems usually use octagonal tangential combustion. The angular combustion method of the burner with one angle in the longitudinal direction of each coal pulverizer can easily lead to partial burning of the flame and uneven heat load in the furnace, which in turn leads to deviations in the smoke temperature of the furnace and the temperature of the steam on the heating surface. Through the offset adjustment method of the secondary air at each corner, the combustion deviation can be adjusted more flexibly and quickly. In this paper, the influence law of a 660MW unit's boiler angle secondary air offset adjustment method on the deviation of furnace smoke temperature is studied. The experiment conclusions show that opening the secondary air in the main combustion zone at a certain corner will cause the furnace smoke temperature on the opposite side of the corner to rise, and the furnace smoke temperature on this side to decrease. Under medium and low loads, when the adjustment range of the secondary air damper in the main combustion zone is 15%, the flue gas temperature change range is above 10°C. Adjusting the SOFA wind has little effect on the change of smoke temperature, and the change of smoke temperature after 15% damper adjustment is 0∼5°C. Changing the flue gas flow direction through the over-burning air is not as effective as directly changing the tangent circle position produced by the main combustion zone.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Adjustment of FAST Active Reflector Based on Nonlinear Objective Programming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: FAST is the most sensitive radio telescope in the world. Firstly, in this paper, a bi objective nonlinear programming model is established, considering the factors affecting the adjustment of reflective panel. Using the idea of hierarchical sequence, the sum of the distances between adjacent nodes of the main cable is the main optimization objective, and the radial expansion of the actuator is the secondary optimization objective. The ideal paraboloid equation is determined by linear search algorithm. Then, the coordinate change method is introduced, and it is found that the nodes to be optimized are distributed in a ring and band on the rotating paraboloid. Taking the mean square deviation of the optimized node relative to the ideal paraboloid as small as possible and the variation range of the actual distance between adjacent nodes as small as possible as the optimization objective, through multiple cyclic traversal and variable step search algorithm, we obtain the optimal reflector adjustment scheme. Finally, through the geometric analysis of the number of cable points that the paraboloid can receive the signal, the range of the spherical received signal is determined, and the two are compared with the total value to obtain the reception rate of the feed cabin under the paraboloid and spherical.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization of Instrument Mechanism Based on ADAMS and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the difficult problem of parameter design of an instrument mechanism, the method of digital simulation is adopted to solve it. Firstly, the simulation model is constructed based on ADAMS, and the simulation results are verified. Further, through experimental design, the relationship between stiffness coefficient, damping coefficient and maximum displacement is studied, and the response surface is obtained. Finally, based on response surface, genetic algorithm is used to find the best parameters that meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Simulation Technology in the Teaching of Practical Courses under the Background of Specialty Clusters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the context of specialty clusters, this paper applies virtual simulation technology to the teaching links of practical courses in undergraduate colleges and universities. Through 3D visualization control technology and intelligent network technology, a comprehensive and perceptible artificial virtual environment based on vision, hearing and touch is created, that is, a practical course simulation teaching system. In this way, a curriculum teaching system integrating “teaching, learning, training, and examination” has been formed. The system can alleviate many problems such as the difficulty of the teaching site, the high risk, the large impact of the construction period, the large investment in the training base, and the large consumption of professional training activities in the construction of colleges and universities, so that students' internships can achieve a multiplier effect with half the effort.

articleTitle: Collaborative development of system dynamics model based on cloud computing and big data analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Economy, energy and environment are important factors of regional coordinated development, and coordinated development is an important prerequisite and inevitable requirement of sustainable development. Based on big data analysis, this paper takes Jiangsu Province, a representative province in eastern China, as the research object, and takes 2005-2030 as the research period. With the help of the system dynamics method of studying complex problems, this paper constructs the system dynamics -SD model of economic-energy-environment development, and discusses the realization path of realizing coordinated development in eastern China.

articleTitle: Research on Visualization Technology of Ocean Situation Based on OSG
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the image efficiency and human-computer interaction of 3D ocean situation display, on the basis of summarizing the lighting and dynamic display technologies of previous 3D ocean models, through the analysis of the requirements of ocean situation display and the software architecture mode combined with OSG/QT[1], technical methods such as sea surface fluctuation simulation based on FFT and volume rendering technology for cloud rendering are proposed, A more realistic ocean situation scene is realized. The above research results provide technical support for marine related situation software and build a real, intuitive and distinctive marine situation display effect.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of operating environment conditions on the performance of power lithium battery system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Pressure, temperature and humidity will affect the performance of REESS, and the abuse of environmental conditions will even affect its safety. Therefore, the design of the module fixture should be strengthened so that it is maintained within a suitable pressure range during the charge and discharge process. This can maintain the consistency of the battery cells to improve the cycle life of the system; the battery system should also fully consider the durability of the seal design, And to protect against possible water vapor intrusion, air tightness testing should also be performed after various reliability experiments. In this way, it can cope with the complex and diverse operating environment of electric vehicles and bring a good user experience to users.

articleTitle: Degradation assessment of solar cell array of low orbit satellite in orbit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Solar cell arrays are mostly used as the main power supply for low-orbit satellites. The performance of solar cell arrays will deteriorate under the influence of various factors during long-term operation in orbit. In view of the in-orbit energy management requirements of low orbit satellites, a simplified performance degradation model is proposed, and the peak current of solar cell array is used as its long-term performance measurement index. The applicability of the model and index is verified by analyzing the in-orbit telemetry data of a series of satellites. It can provide reference for the long-term management of low-orbit satellite energy subsystem, the mission planning of on-board payload and the optimization design of solar cell array.

articleTitle: Research on Entity Relationship Joint Extraction Technology Based on Multitask Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology in recent years, entity relationship extraction as a key step of information extraction has been widely concerned. In the past practice relationship extraction technologies, entity identification and relationship extraction were mostly realized as two independent tasks, ignoring the relationship between the two tasks. In this paper, an entity relationship extraction model is proposed. Based on the pre-training model BERT, an entity identification and multi-head selection task model is constructed to jointly extract entity relationships. The model realizes entity identification through CRF, and classifies relationships by taking relationship extraction as a multi-head selection task. The joint extraction model proposed in this paper improves the tasks of entity recognition and relationship extraction. This paper integrates the entity relationship extraction model into the knowledge map management system, labels the entity relationship through the model, verifies the data through domain experts, and establishes the domain knowledge map. At the same time, the verified data is used as training data for incremental training of the model, so as to continuously optimize the model.

articleTitle: Machine Propositional Model Research Based on Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Machine propositions are the research frontier of natural language processing technology, and the core of the technology path is the result of the development of reading comprehension and question answering systems. Machine propositions can help save a lot of manpower and time, especially in the case of the continuous development of the Covid-19, and help the teaching acceptance and learning evaluation of online learning. At present, the simultaneous pursuit of autonomous propositions and precision requirements in the academic field of machine propositions is the research focus and difficulty.

articleTitle: Research on the Accommodation Capacity of Renewable Energy in Power System Based on Holomorphic Embedding Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Renewable energy and other power electronics have access to the power grid broadly, accompanied by the decline of the voltage supportability of the power grid. Aiming at the restriction of voltage problem on the renewable energy accommodation capacity of the power grid, a practical numerical computation technique of renewable energy accommodation capacity in view of holomorphic embedding method is recommended in this paper. Firstly, the holomorphic embedding model considering different power change directions is proposed. And the voltage function is analytically extended by Padé approximant. Then, considering the uncertain characteristics of wind power, the holomorphic embedding method is available on application to the computation of renewable energy accommodation capacity. From the perspective of voltage violation, the probabilistic evaluation of wind power accommodation capacity is performed. The whole process takes the holomorphic embedding model as the core. Compared with the traditional method, it is unnecessary to have a complete Newton iterative process in each step of state deduction, and the computing velocity increases. Finally, simulation results verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of a V-type engine crankshaft based on workbench
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The crankshaft is an important part of the internal combustion engine, and its vibration characteristics have a direct impact on the operation of the internal combustion engine. The crankshaft model of a V-type 8-cylinder diesel engine was established by 3D modeling software SolidWorks. The effects of reciprocating inertia mass of piston group, connecting rod small end and rotating inertia mass of connecting rod big end on natural frequency and vibration mode of crankshaft are considered in modal analysis with Workbench. Adding concentrated mass to the journal surface of crankshaft connecting rod, the first 12 natural frequencies and vibration modes are obtained. Compared with the modal analysis without adding concentrated mass, the accuracy is improved, which provides a basis for further optimization of crankshaft structure.

articleTitle: Systematic Research on Energy and Carbon Emissions Based on SD Model under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As the material basis of national economic development, energy plays an important role. However, the energy consumption process will produce a large amount of carbon dioxide emissions. How to change the development mode, get rid of the predicament of low energy utilization rate and environmental pollution, break the deadlock of the previous rough economic growth mode, and coordinate the harmonious development among economy, energy and carbon emissions has become the main direction of current development. Based on this, this paper takes energy, economy and carbon emissions as a system, and takes Anhui Province as the research object. By constructing a system dynamics model composed of three systems of “energy-economy-carbon emissions”, this paper discusses the new path of healthy and sustainable development of China's economy.

articleTitle: Integrated design of solar photovoltaic photothermal building based on micro heat pipe array
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of overheating technology bottleneck and photovoltaic heat wave cost of solar photovoltaic cell modules, this paper carries out the research and design of solar photovoltaic photothermal building integration based on micro heat pipe array. Using the high-efficiency heat conduction technology of micro heat pipe array, the waste heat and waste heat generated by photovoltaic cells are used to generate building hot water, which not only improves the efficiency of photovoltaic cells, but also provides heating and hot water for buildings. The cooling and heat transfer characteristics of micro heat pipe array are analyzed and studied from the perspective of heat transfer and flow, and the theoretical model of heat transfer and flow characteristics of micro heat pipe array is established, An experimental platform for flow and heat transfer characteristics of micro heat pipe array was built. Study the integrated system model of solar photovoltaic photothermal building, build the photovoltaic cell module based on micro heat pipe array, design the integrated solar cogeneration unit, optimize the system energy control and operation management scheduling scheme, and establish the system microgrid monitoring and control system to provide technical support for the integration of solar energy and building in Tibet, On the basis of energy conservation and emission reduction, give full play to the role of industry driving and industry leading, so as to provide reference for realizing the goal of carbon peak and carbon neutralization.

articleTitle: Study on the Induced Voltage of Concentric High Temperature Superconducting Cable
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: High temperature superconducting (HTS) cable, with advantages such as high current density, low transmission loss and low corridor occupation, has been a cutting-edge research field for electric power transmission. The concentric HTS cable does not need a superconducting shielding layer as the leakage magnetic field is very small. Therefore, concentric HTS cable saves the amount of HTS tapes and is more compact. However, in reality, the three phases in a concentric core could not be absolutely balanced both in physically and in electrically and the induced voltage outside the cable core would exist inevitably. In practice, the grounding methods of the shielding layer and cryogenic pipes are closely related to the induced voltage characteristics as well. In this paper, an analytical electromagnetic model of concentric HTS cable is established based on the Maxwell relations and the 2D axisymmetric model. The characteristics of three-phase imbalance and its induced voltage characteristics generated on the shielding layer and the cryogenic pipes are studied. Since the cryogenic pipes are consisted of two pipe and electrical connected parallelly, the related circulation current and its additional heat load to the cryogenic cooling system are considered. The analysis approach and research result in this paper is not only for designing concentric HTS cable system, but also for referring of other types of HTS cable systems.

articleTitle: Data Analysis and Intelligent Control System of Water Pollutants in Aircraft Hydraulic System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper focuses on analyzing the source, classification and harm of water pollutants in aircraft hydraulic system. Centrifugal oil purifier was selected for many tests, detection, data analysis and research. It has been tested and identified by the authoritative testing department. This paper puts forward the measures to control the water pollutants in the hydraulic oil of the aircraft hydraulic system, and the superficial experience will have practical reference value for improving the reliability and service life of the aircraft hydraulic system.

articleTitle: Stabilization power pedestal for navigation buoys based on Bragg resonance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This project proposes to design a special pedestal for navigation buoys based on the principle of the conservation of wave energy in local waters. The pedestal has two main functional modules, the cushioning module, and the self-generating module. The two are connected by a Bragg resonance module with special shape characteristics, which induces Bragg resonance of the outer sea surface waves of the navigation buoy to make the local sea surface wave energy redistribution of it, and the outer wave energy focus area has strong amplitude and high energy, which supplies energy for the wave energy utilization equipment; the inner amplitude of the resonance plate is greatly weakened, and the non-rigid connection between the damping module and the plate plays a role in stabilizing the navigation buoy. The preliminary benefit analysis shows that the device has good energy saving and emission reduction benefits.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Nickel-Rich Ternary Cathode in Lithium Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Nickel-rich ternary cathode materials have attracted great attentions due to their high specific discharge capacity, high voltage platform, environmental friendliness and rich nickel resources. However, this kind of materials have suffer severe structural irreversible phase transition, interfacial side reactions and poor thermal stability during the charge discharge process, which greatly hindered the industrial development of nickel rich ternary cathode materials, especially LiNi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</inf>Co<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</inf>Mn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</inf>O2 (NCM811)cathode materials. With the deepening of research, the physical and chemical properties of nickel rich ternary cathode materials have been greatly improved. In this paper, the research and development status of nickel rich ternary cathode materials in recent years are reviewed. The existing problems and solutions of the materials are discussed in detail. The future development of nickel rich ternary cathode materials is prospected.

articleTitle: Quantitative Diagnosis of Micro-water in Oil-paper Insulation Transformer Based on Integral Function
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The micro-water content of insulation transformer is one of the important factors affecting its serving life. Based on the theory of depolarization electric quantity and dielectric response, the beginning depolarization electric quantity S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oil</inf> and the terminal depolarization electric quantity S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">paper</inf> of depolarization current are extracted to evaluate the micro-water content of oil-paper insulation transformer. Firstly, the depolarization current curves of insulating oil and insulating paper under different moisture content were compared; Then, the two characteristic vectors S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oil</inf>and S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">paper</inf> are extracted according to the identification results of dielectric response parameters of depolarization current curve. The analysis results show that both S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oil</inf> and S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">paper</inf> increase exponentially with the increase of micro-water content in oil-paper insulation. Finally, an example is given to verify that the proposed characteristic vectors can better evaluate the micro-water content of oil-paper insulation transformer.

articleTitle: The Nonlinear Complementary Function (NPC) BASED Scheme for Elastoplasticity Problem: A Comparison Study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A Nonlinear Complementary Function based method for plasticity mechanics, which shows superiority on efficiency and robustness over tradition algorithm and possess flexibility for multiphysical problem, is presented in this paper. The flexibility is achieved by the introduction of additive strain rate form stress-strain relation and Nonlinear Complementary function. The formulation of the nonlinear constitutive relation allows a fully implicit numerical method that could be extended to higher order difference scheme for dynamic system. In addition, the method get rid of the guess of state that used in traditional algorithm. The generalized Newton method is used and a differential Jacobi matrix is formulated in the numerical algorithm. The superiority on efficiency and robustness over tradition method is showed by 2D and 3D example.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Big Data Technology and Algorithm Optimization in Logistics Distribution Management
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The article designs a smart logistics system that combines the three aspects of “interconnection + IoT + intelligence”. It focuses on the main components and core basic technologies of smart logistics. And based on these foundations, a smart logistics system framework related to the Internet of Things is constructed. At the same time, each component and function of the system is analyzed in detail in this framework. Finally, in the aspect of distribution management, a mathematical model of the e-commerce logistics distribution vehicle routing problem with a hard time window is established. The article uses the genetic algorithm to carry out an example calculation. The calculation results show that the genetic algorithm is a better method to solve the vehicle routing problem with hard time windows.

articleTitle: Development and Comparative Analysis of Humor Intelligent Detection Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on distinguishing humor and irony. In previous research, scientists have used several methods and models to build machines that can produce and detect specific types of humor to identify critical values components for their automatic processing. Although some models have high recognition accuracy for specific sets, humor detection is still a challenging problem in the computer field. The distinction between humor and irony is still far away in reality. What is more, few people do it in languages other than English. However, some scholars have begun to detect humor in non-English languages. Hence, we conclude three classical methods-Feature models, BERT, FMRI-and we make a comparison. Then, we analyze current problems and do some experiments, including humor score detection task and humorous headline detection task. Indeed, we propose several possible solutions to find the appropriate method that can distinguish humor and irony in reality.

articleTitle: Long-Range Contorl of Hybrid Cockroach Robots Carried with Ejectable Microphone
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper presents preliminary stimulus-response relationship based on behavior analysis of cockroach subject to stimulus pulses corresponding to randomly applied right and left turn, and stop commands. We present our stimulus circuit setup designed for precise control and long-range communication. we also build a microphone module to meet the requirements of miniaturization and long-distance control. Furthermore, a micro-rejector is connected to stimulus the microphone circuit module, and then the microphone module receiving commands is ejected. This study paves the way towards the practical applications of cockroach hybrid robots in search and surveillance mission.

articleTitle: A Radius-tapered Algorithm for Indoor Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the indoor positioning system based on Received Signal Strength Indication (RSSI), trilateration positioning algorithm is generally used. However, the accuracy of trilateration positioning decreases when the point of measurement is close to the beacon. In this article, a radius-tapered (RT) indoor positioning algorithm is proposed to improve the positioning accuracy. The simulation results show that the errors decrease after the RT algorithm. The accuracy improvement is 69.96% (95% confidence interval (CI): 36.0–104.0). It shows the potential application prospects in the indoor positioning system.

articleTitle: Nondestructive Testing Technology of Solid Rocket Engine Based on Acoustics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Solid rocket motor (SRM) is the main power device of missile weapon system nowadays. Its structure quality has a great influence on weapon performance. How to choose effective and reasonable nondestructive testing means has been paid more and more attention. Research hotter and application at home and abroad in this paper, the potentiality of nondestructive testing technique based on acoustic (including conventional ultrasonic testing technology, air coupling ultrasonic testing, laser ultrasonic testing technology, the electromagnetic ultrasonic testing technique) were reviewed, this paper expounds the technical principle of the detection method, analyses the applicable objects, and advantages and disadvantages compared.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Parameters of Compressed Air Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the increasing demand for energy in our country, new energy sources with wind power as the main force have been vigorously developed. However, the intermittent and unstable characteristics of wind power generation pose huge challenges to the large-scale grid integration of new energy sources. Compressed air energy storage (CAES) can balance the intermittency and volatility of new energy due to its “peak-cutting and valley-filling” characteristics, and has great development prospects. This article first explains the development status and working principle of CAES, and then establishes a system simulation based on the existing data of a northwest wind power plant. The results show that the temperature of the thermal storage tank and the system work both increase first and then remain stable with the increase of the number of system cycles. The simulation results are in good agreement with the actual situation, which also verifies the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Online Cloud Experience System of Featured Tourism Products Based on Computer Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of tourism informatization to meet the ever-changing passenger needs and massive data processing, a smart tourism cloud solution based on cloud computing is proposed. The solution is based on the cloud computing IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS modes to virtualize tourism resources to build a smart tourism cloud platform, that is, tourism resources are integrated and distributed through IaaS, and tourism resources are reused through PaaS. The tourism resources are customized and rentable through SaaS, and the cloud computing open-source software Open stack and Hadoop are used for architectural design. The study found that a tourism service system that combines regional cultural characteristics, technological advantages, and good online and offline interactions can effectively help villagers improve their lives, highlight ethnic characteristics, and improve service experience.

articleTitle: Research on upstream pulsation of secondary source in hydraulic Pipeline active control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: [Objective] The pipeline active control technology uses the pulsation generated by the secondary pulsation source to offset the original pulsation of the pipeline, which can achieve a better damping effect in the downstream of the secondary pulsation source, but the vibration of the upstream of the secondary pulsation source will increase. so the change of the upstream of the secondary pulsation source is explored and the position of the secondary pulsation source is optimized. [Methods] The hydraulic pipeline active control system was modeled based on Simulink software by frequency domain analysis method. The influence of pulsation frequency, working pressure, position of secondary pulsation source, pipeline components and other factors on the vibration of the upstream secondary pulsation source was explored, and the influence weight of different factors on the upstream pulsation was explored. [Results] The amplitude of pipeline pulsation increased with the increase of pipeline working pressure. As the distance between the secondary pulsation source and pump source increases, the number of peak pulsations increases. [Conclusion] The study shows that the secondary pulsation source should be installed as close as possible to the pump source.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of the New-generation Highly Integrated Vehicle Intelligent Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper studies the key technologies of vehicle management system. By comparing the main technology of the traditional vehicle management system and the new-generation vehicle management system, the node communication technology, processor node locking technology, node time synchronization technology and system member consistency guarantee technology are studied and introduced, providing some reference for the research and application of the new generation of vehicle management system.

Author Keywords: new-generation highly integrated vehicle management system

articleTitle: The Dilemma and Prospects of Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Deep learning algorithms have emerged in many cutting-edge sciences. Its simple structure and high performance make it a valuable object. However, with its application in various fields, its understanding, vulnerability, sample cost, and other issues have also been exposed. For example, in natural language understanding, deep learning could not truly understand the meaning of words. Moreover, in recognition of text and images, deep learning is easily attacked by adversarial samples. Moreover, the problem of sample cost required for deep learning is also revealed. This paper reviews these problems and proposes some possible solutions to the problems in the future. The current dilemma of deep learning research is that there is no clear explanation for the shortcomings of deep learning. The significance of the research on such problems is: whether it is to change the direction or continue to optimize and solve the weaknesses, deep learning can be brought to a new height, making it a straightforward, efficient, and stable tool.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Supporting Force of Auxiliary Members Based on New Code of Tower Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The newly implemented technical code for design of overhead transmission line tower structure (DL / T 5486-2020) revised the value of tower auxiliary material support force. Through the comparison between the new and old specifications and the value of tower auxiliary material support force in European and American standards, the qualitative impact of the implementation of the new specification on the value of tower auxiliary material support force is determined. The results show that the support force of auxiliary materials in the new regulations is generally decreased, and the quality of auxiliary materials is significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Research on the Auxiliary Application of Computer Big Data Technology in the Creation of Literary Works
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The current virtual simulation system mainly revolves around physics, chemistry experiments and mathematical formulas, and there are few simulation cases of literary works. Therefore, currently using deep learning models to process Chinese natural language input is a current research hotspot. The article conducts research on Chinese morphology and syntax, and analyzes the influence of different parts of speech and dependencies on the deep logic of sentences through experiments. We distill the sentences input by people using natural language into main components with words as the unit, and transform them into entities and logical relationships that are easy for computers to understand knowledge. Finally, we designed and constructed a library system based on the SWF generation technology of SWF Tools and the dynamic file preview technology based on Flex paper. The system provides users with a complete reading platform for literary works, and at the same time can share writing experience, so as to create a good reading and communication environment for all kinds of users.

articleTitle: Application and Research of UAV Remote Sensing Technology in Soil and Water Conservation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Soil and water conservation is the prevention and treatment of soil and water loss caused by natural and human factors. It is a long-term, complex and comprehensive systematic project. Traditional soil and water conservation survey methods are easily affected by many factors, such as harsh environmental conditions, measurement equipment errors, human disturbance and so on. The VAV can carry a high-resolution digital camera for rapid shooting, collect and return data in real time, reflecting the advantages of high resolution, good effectiveness and strong operability. The application of VAV remote sensing technology can quickly and accurately obtain the required information and ensure the rationality and scientificity of the project. This paper introduces the advantages and application of VAV Remote Sensing Technology in soil and water conservation, and analyzes the development prospect of this technology in the related fields of soil and water conservation, which provides a reference for the improvement of the scientific and technological system of soil and water conservation.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent home care system based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Due to the increasing aging of the world population, the industries related to the elderly are also developing rapidly. In the face of the huge number of elderly population, how to provide the elderly with a sense of security and care has become a key concern of the country. With the support of the Internet of Things technology, this paper is designed to provide the elderly with a better quality of home care through the design of intelligent home care system and control system, while reducing the pressure of children to support the elderly and creating a healthier and happier life for the elderly. To create a more healthy and happy life for the elderly in their old age.

articleTitle: Research and Application of GIS Partial Discharge Signal Positioning Based on UHF Intelligent Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Partial discharge inspection of the substation GIS and determination of the location of the partial discharge source are important means to discover equipment insulation defects and prevent major accidents. At present, the existing partial discharge source positioning methods are mainly applied to online monitoring devices with high sampling rate and high precision synchronization, which have the problems of high cost, inconvenient deployment and wiring, and high requirements for inspection personnel. Based on the establishment of a GIS partial discharge positioning system and the UHF smart sensors, a UHF smart sensor positioning method has been proposed in this paper. Through the establishment of the topology between space UHF smart sensors and contact UHF smart sensor topology, identify the location of the GIS partial discharge source by the remote online monitoring algorithm. After field application and verification, the partial discharge positioning system can accurately locate the location of the partial discharge source, which proves the feasibility of the partial discharge positioning system based on UHF smart sensors, which can reduce the difficulty of localization of partial discharge for on-site personnel.

articleTitle: An inhomogeneous hidden Markov model for state recognition of lithium battery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Timely state recognition of battery system is significant to prevent safety accidents of electric vehicles. The aging process of lithium battery is a random process, the aging speed is changing with time, and its aging degree is difficult to measure. Therefore, a state recognition model of lithium battery is established by an inhomogeneous Hidden Markov Model (IHMM). In order to further improve the state recognition effect, an IHMM with multiple observation variables is established. By analyzing degradation data of No.5 lithium battery from NASA data set and numerical experiments, the results show that IHMM is superior to Hidden Markov Model (HMM) in the state and state sequence recognition effect. At the same time, the IHMM with multiple observation variables has higher recognition effect.

articleTitle: Evaluation calculation model of overhead transmission line crossover sag based on microclimate environment monitoring data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper selects the influencing factors of sag in important crossing span by analyzing the influencing factors of sag in important crossing span, carries out the dimensional analysis of sag change of important crossing conductor based on the principle of dimensional analysis on the aspects of hydrodynamics, thermodynamics and electromagnetism, and builds the evaluation and calculation model of crossing sag of overhead transmission line based on micro-meteorological environment monitoring data.

articleTitle: Optimal design analysis of wind solar complementary power stations in Tibet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Wind solar complementary power generation system uses the complementarity of wind energy and solar energy to improve the overall energy utilization efficiency, and the optimal design of the system will effectively improve the operation efficiency of the power station. Based on the analysis of the application status and existing problems of wind solar complementary power station, this paper puts forward the design optimization of power station by comprehensively considering energy management, system configuration, collaborative control and load matching, so as to reduce cost, prolong service life and improve energy efficiency. The research results can provide reference for the optimal design of wind solar complementary power generation system in high altitude and cold areas.

articleTitle: Intelligent Face Recognition under Large Pose
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Face recognition beneath pose changes, recently, is a very tough problem and key point in face recognition, a lot of research institutes have tried to figure out the best way to solve the tough problem by producing different method. Recently, as the success development of deep learning in many fields of computer vision, deep learning is also applied to this problem and obtains the state-of-the-art performance. This review is trying to analyze the basic idea and introduce the state-of-the-art algorithms in this field.

articleTitle: Intelligent Screening Method in Oral Drugs by Visual Lamp System Specific Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: According to the relevant provisions of Chinese Pharmacepoeia<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>, Staphylococcus aureus cannot be detected in oral drugs. In this experiment, the optimized LAMP reaction system was used to detect Staphylococcus aureus. Based on the thermostable nuclease gene (NUC) of Staphylococcus aureus. One external primer F3 and B3, and one internal primer FIP and BIP were designed in the conserved region based on the heat resistant nuclease gene (NUC) of Staphylococcus aureus. A visual loop-mediated isothermal amplification method for detection of Staphylococcus aureus was established by adding calcein Mn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> dye into the system; With this method, the specificity of 10 strains preserved in the laboratory was detected; And the sensitivity of the bacterial solution was detected by 10 times gradient dilution; Finally, the optimized LAMP reaction system was used to detect the commercial oral drugs, and the sensitivity of oral drugs contaminated by Staphylococcus aureus. The optimized lamp system was used to detect the specificity of 10 strains. The result was that the staphylococcus aureus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Streptococcus pneumoniae systems turned green, while the other systems were brown-yellow. At the same time, the results were verified by glue running Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Streptococcus pneumoniae showed trapezoid stripe in the UV Gel imaging system, and the rest had no stripe, with a specificity of 77%. The gradient diluted Staphylococcus aureus was detected based on lamp reaction, and the detection rate of the system was <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4.6 \times 10^{1}\ \text{CFU}/\text{mL}$</tex>; The system was used for visual lamp detection of oral drugs sold in the market and not tested by the food and drug administration, and no Staphylococcus aureus was detected. However, visual LAMP detection of oral drugs artificially contaminated with S. aureus showed trapezoidal bands in experimental results, and the detection limit of s. aureus color in oral drugs detected by the system was up to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$5.3 \times 10^{2}\ \text{CFU}/\text{mL}$</tex>. Conclusion: the visual lamp detection system of Staphylococcus aureus can be used to screen oral drugs containing Staphylococcus aureus.

articleTitle: Digital Marketing 4.0 Visualization System Based on Smart Buildings under the Background of Aging and Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article focuses on the analysis of the application of intelligent decision support system in the visualization system of intelligent building digital marketing 4.0. First of all, starting from the Internet, propose the discussion background of the subject of this article. Next, it describes the development status and development trend of smart building and digital marketing 4.0 visual system based on the background of aging and intelligence. Finally, the article uses the real estate-related graphics, images, and attribute data collected by the system and uses virtual reality modelling technology to program to realize the Smart Building Digital Marketing 4.0 visualization system based on Arc objects. The technical methods for rapid modelling of the area where the real estate is sold are studied, and the indoor and outdoor virtual simulation environment of the real estate is established. Using geographic information system tools to realize the space management and simple query analysis of the virtual simulation environment.

articleTitle: Intelligent Online Evaluation Model of WFGD System Performance Based on Gas-liquid Mass Transfer Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, an online method was invested to evaluate the WFGD performance based on gas-liquid mass transfer analysis. According to the real-time analysis of the SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas-phase mass transfer coefficient Kg, i of each spray layer of the limestone-gypsum WFGD system, online evaluation of the performance of the WFGD system can be realized, and the core reference basis for the subsequent online fault diagnosis of the WFGD system operation can be provided.

articleTitle: Research on Trustworthiness Evaluation Based on Web Service Composition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The loose coupling and distributed nature of service-oriented architecture (SOA) can easily lead to trustworthiness problem of service composition. The current Web service composition trustworthiness evaluation method is biased towards the service provider itself, while ignoring the trustworthiness of the service discoverer and user. This paper mainly studies a multi-angle Web service composition trustworthiness evaluation method, comprehensively considers the three aspects of Web service composition, and uses the service finder to expand the service center. The experiment proves that this kind of trustworthiness evaluation method of Web service composition can improve the accuracy and comprehensiveness of trustworthiness evaluation.

articleTitle: A Brief Introduction of the Text Classification Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Text classification is basically to categorize text data into different groups. Text classification has been applied in various domains, including news filtering and organization, document organization and retrieval, opinion mining, and email classification and spam filtering. However, in the Era of Big Data, in which text data is generated every second, it is almost impossible to classify text manually. This paper will briefly talk about common task classification methods with greater emphasis on DL classification models, CNN and RNN. CNN is good at extracting word pattern of the text. A classification is done by detecting particular words' presence and location. RNN converts the text into a word embedding vector and processes the vector as a sequential data. It makes a classification by a series of computation based on the word sequence. This paper will also analyze several research papers which further explore the nature of CNN and RNN classification models. Finally, it will address the problems that current text classification models face.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Internet Technology and Cloud Computing in the Intelligent Information Management Database of Students
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the era of rapid development of the Internet, student education management will face more difficulties and challenges. How to achieve effective educational results is related to the stability of the university student population, the implementation of university management policies and the development of subject education. All aspects are closely related. In view of the problems of waste of resources, occupies a large amount of storage space, troublesome query and statistics in the current management mode of paper-based university archives; this system adopts the B/S mode combined with the synergy test of each module to realize the saving of development and the maintenance cost also reduces the workload of the client. In the end, a system with reasonable design, clean interface, simple operation and complete functions is obtained. This plays an important role for modernized file management in colleges and universities and has high practical value. We use the network platform as the core. This article establishes a differentiated student management database that records different types of students' thoughts, behaviors, and psychological characteristics, systematically conducts scientific analysis and processing, and develops different educational management methods, and then we teach Carry out student education management.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Big Data Technology in Physical Electricity Experiment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article uses 3D Max, Vitriols and other software tools to design and develop junior high school physics simulation experiments based on the above-mentioned curriculum design. The development process, key technologies and module architecture are introduced in more detail. Finally, the article tests, evaluates and improves the simulation experiment developed.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Information Systems Based Multi-Dimensional Classroom Computer Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The conventional evaluation methods pay much attention to test scores and artificial participation, and lack of objective indicators in teaching process and classroom. In this paper we study the evaluation mechanism of classroom participation rate, and propose a new multi-dimensional classroom participation evaluation mechanism based on artificial intelligence. This mechanism evaluates classroom participation of students from the dimensions of attendance rate,head up rate, expression and eye recognition, and statistics of students who answers questions, which saves time and energy of both teachers and students, expands the objectivity dimension of teaching evaluation, and makes the overall evaluation more stable and reliable.

articleTitle: The Relationship Between Depth and Broadness Based on Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Deep learning is the main focus of the machine learning field. However, it is noticeable that some researchers utilize broad learning to efficiently solve some problems in this field. Under such conditions, even though deep learning has obtained some breakthroughs, a comprehensive learning system is still valuable. Comparing the advantages and disadvantages of these two methods is difficult to achieve a general conclusion. However, outcomes about the performances of models are possible for a particular problem or data set. In this article, all the experiments are based on MNIST data set, using Multilayer Perceptron models to test the differences of broadness and depth. Nevertheless, the result of experiments shows it is tough to choose the best from these models. This may derive from the complexity of model structures.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent supply control method of nutrient solution based on fuzzy neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The key technology and system integration of automatic monitoring of nutrient supply for planted aerosol cultivation is the core technology of plant factory construction. With the in-depth development in recent years, various related technologies have been broken through, but the low intelligence, high cost and the lack of maturity of some key technologies such as nutrient solution supply control technology still restrict the development of plant factories in China. This paper proposes and develops a key technology and system for automatic monitoring of nutrient solution supply in fog cultivation based on fuzzy neural network. This system mainly collects various data related to plant growth through the on-site control system and the fuzzy neural network control algorithm of nutrient solution supply to realize the automatic adjustment and supply of nutrient solution, and realizes the efficient and intelligent management of fog cultivation through the combination of on-site control and remote control.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Sports Big Data Informatization Construction Comprehensive Intelligent Information System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article is based on the computer artificial intelligence algorithm for the design of a comprehensive planning system for sports athletes' physical fitness indicators monitoring big data informatization construction. At the same time, we build a conceptual structure model of the athlete's physical index monitoring system database. From the aspects of system hardware control, software design and database design, the article optimizes the design of the system design and implementation plan, so that the designed system meets the actual application requirements. We realize real-time monitoring of high-intensity sports and health level testing based on the monitoring results. The simulation results show that the designed high-intensity sports load state monitoring system has high accuracy in monitoring exercise parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Economic Control of Microgrid Group
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of microgrid, microgrid group becomes a tendency. Inspired by the interconnection of microgrid group is able to effectively improve interconnection areas comprehensive benefits and supply reliability. Based on the installation costs, operating costs and environmental benefits of the microgrid group system and the influence of uncertainty on wind, PV and load, this paper builds a dynamic economic optimization dispatch model. And the MCS-PSO is used to solve the model. With the analysis of the interconnection system optimization dispatching results, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is validated by the example system simulation. And it discusses the influence of the confidence level on multi-microgrid dynamic economic dispatch results.

articleTitle: Research on Ocean Technology and Engineering Electronic Information Transmission Model Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on a comprehensive investigation of the existing ocean information platform, this article proposes an ocean platform electronic information system architecture model. The model has the characteristics of energy self-protection, wide application range and strong mission system carrying capacity. The article studies the signal multipath fading characteristics of the ocean information platform, analyzes the change characteristics of the signal bandwidth at different frequencies, and analyzes the influence of random noise on the transmission signal and bit error rate. The study found that the channel characteristics have more similarities with the underwater acoustic channel. This conclusion broadens the research ideas for improving the transmission performance of the XCTD channel.

articleTitle: Research on Campus Convergent Payment System Model Based on Blockchain Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the campus network billing system, in addition to online authentication, real-time monitoring of traffic and fees, network fee recharge is also an extremely important functional module. However, the traditional Internet fee recharge method has problems such as users need to line up at a designated place to recharge, the processing speed is slow, and the time for receiving the account is not timely. In response to the above problems, the article combines the actual network environment of colleges and universities with the specific needs of the campus integrated payment system model, and designs and develops a campus integrated payment system based on the blockchain architecture. The system uses blockchain technology based on the Fabric architecture, uses asymmetric encryption algorithms, Byzantine algorithms and other technologies to design and develop a campus-converged payment system with security, reliability, and decentralization. Practical application shows that this method has better feature resolution ability for blockchain distributed big data fusion. The high integration of campus payment and social payment is another practice of “Internet+” campus application, which will play a positive role in promoting the construction of campus informatization.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on abnormal causes of lightning impulse test of 500kV transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Lightning impulse test of transformer is an essential item of equipment delivery test, and it is also to assess the bearing capacity of transformer insulation under lightning impulse. Taking an abnormal lightning impulse test of 500 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{kV}$</tex> transformer as an example, the background and method of lightning impulse test are described, and the treatment of lightning impulse anomaly is described in detail. In the process of abnormal cause judgment, the approximate location of the fault is preliminarily judged by repeating the test and changing the pressurization position, further disassembly and inspection shall be carried out to find out the discharge trace left on the device and determine the discharge path, then accurately judge the cause of the fault, At the same time, a complete solution to the internal discharge problem is provided, and the test is carried out again to verify the rationality and effectiveness of the conclusions and treatment measures.

articleTitle: Multi-spectral registration fusion based on laser point cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Airborne laser scanning and ranging technology (Light Detection And Ranging, LiDAR) can reliably and quickly directly obtain the three-dimensional coordinate point cloud of the measured object. It is the research and application of typical tree species identification and ranging positioning of transmission line corridors One of the important technical means. Completing the precise geometric registration of multi-spectral images and LiDAR point clouds is an important foundation for subsequent work such as power line extraction, tree species classification, and tree crown extraction in related research applications. This research focuses on the related research content of the geometric registration of lidar point cloud and multispectral image of transmission line corridor, and carried out the research of image/point cloud geometric registration technology based on the idea of minimizing the distance between the intersection point of photogrammetry and the surface of the laser point cloud. The precise registration of multi-spectral image and LiDAR point cloud data has been completed.

articleTitle: HC-GSA Identification Method of Bad Data Based on Gap Statistical Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, the importance of data in the safe operation of thermal power units has become increasingly prominent, and the identification of bad data is urgent. The current identification method for bad data has poor universality, and identification results have no reference basis and low identification accuracy. Therefore, an HC-GSA identification method for bad data is proposed. Firstly, the Partitioning Around Medoids algorithm is optimized by using the aggregation hierarchical clustering algorithm combined with the model evaluation method of unknown real Index. An HC-Center clustering algorithm that can be used to calculate standard historical data is proposed. Secondly, the gap statistics algorithm is used to compare the calculation results of the data to be measured with the results obtained by the HC-Center clustering algorithm. The identification of bad data is realized based on the mean square deviation value of the class. Finally, the simulation experiment is carried out by using the relevant equipment data in the combustion system of the thermal power unit. By comparing the algorithms of the same type, the HC-GSA identification method's excellent applicability and high accuracy for the bad data are verified.

Author Keywords: the combustion system of thermal power units

articleTitle: Facenet: A Cloud-Based Application Framework for Social Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the fast development of social media, the social relationship between people becomes more and more complex, and the social network becomes bloated. In this work, motivated by the six degrees of separation theory and with the help of cloud database, a social network model called facenet is built, which clearly represents the social relationship between people. First, a mathematical model is designed to estimate the diameter of one specific social network, leading to a random sparse graph. On this basis, a unique social platform is established. It has cutting-edge augmented reality (AR) functionality, allowing users to easily find the shortest social connection between themselves and any stranger in the world. Furthermore, an application framework is designed to illustrate the software architecture of the facenet and the relationship between various modules. Users can create their own cloud-based AR applications through this framework. Experimental results in the real world show that the proposed face recognition model achieves a recognition accuracy of 91.2% and great potential and extensibility.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Artificial Intelligence and Computer Big Data Technology in the Individualized Nursing Care Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the DINO model, this article develops a separate multi-level scoring cognitive diagnosis model (P-DINO model) and uses a combination of Monte Carlo simulation and empirical research to discuss the performance and effectiveness of the new model. At the same time, we design a depression detection software based on voice signals, including an analysis system based on deep learning and user terminal software based on the iOS platform, to provide a new way for early screening of depression and to reduce depression detection to a certain extent the cost of. The results show that in the evaluation of depressive symptoms, the performance of the P-DINO model is better than that of the DINO model and the traditional evaluation of depressive symptoms.

articleTitle: Designing and analysing an annular multiple-electrode GER fluid damper on shear-flow mode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A novel giant electro-rheological fluid damper is designed and manufactured, which works on a shear-flow mixed mode, and the Bingham mode has been used for the damping force modelling. To better study the characteristics of this damper, many measurements for damping force has been conducted, which shows that the damper we offered has higher damping force. To verify it, we continue to conduct a vibration suppression experiment, which clearly proves that the damper we presented has an excellent performance: when the applied electric field only at 0.27kV/mm, the attenuation is highly at 87%.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Supervision System of Flower Greenhouse Based on Embedded Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the improvement of economic level, people pay more attention to the improvement of living standards after solving the problem of food and clothing. The flower industry is developing rapidly. Flower greenhouses can be seen everywhere in the suburbs of major cities, and their sales are rising year by year. However, the traditional flower planting methods completely rely on manual management. For most flowers, especially some precious flowers, flower farmers often need to take care of them all day, and it is difficult to accurately judge the flower growth status and environmental conditions only by manual judgment, which is easy to cause the famous flowers to wither and cause great economic losses. In order to solve the above problems, this paper studies an embedded flower greenhouse supervision system. The system collects the temperature, humidity and light intensity in the greenhouse in real time through the sensor, and generates the curve for display in the user interface. At the same time, the pictures in the greenhouse are taken by the camera and displayed on the user remote interface. The image recognition is carried out through the deep learning algorithm to obtain the growth state of flower species, give environmental conditions and planting suggestions, and solve the problem of insufficient experience of flower farmers.

articleTitle: Research on bending toughness calculation of steel fiber reclaimed concrete based on finite element analysis software
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the finite element analysis software-ABAQUS, the random distribution of steel fiber in concrete specimens is realized in this paper. First of all, setting up five kinds of volume fractions (V=0%, 0.5%, 1%, 1.5%, 2%) and establishing the steel fiber models with four random distribution characteristics with the same volume rate are established by the finite element analysis software. Then the steel fiber model is integrated with the concrete model by embedding. Finally, by using software to simulate the steel fiber reinforced concrete (SFRC) four-point bending test, the load (P)- mid-span deflection (δ) curves of SFRC with different volume ratios were collected. The results show that, under the same volume rate, different fiber random distribution characteristics have little influence on the bending toughness of SFRC. With the increase of volume rate, the bending toughness of SFRC gradually increases. When the volume rate is 2%, SFRC has the best bending toughness and bending resistance.

articleTitle: Researchon Linear Demodulation Method of Doppler Radar Vital Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the Doppler radar vital detection system, the linear demodulation of the Doppler phase is one of the key technologies for correct target identification. At present, to demodulate the Doppler phase linearly, the Doppler phase had to meet the standard of the small phase, which greatly limits the wide application of the Doppler radar detection system. Based on the Doppler effect theory, this paper analyses the factors affecting the linear demodulation of the Doppler phase from the perspective of the mathematical model of radar vital signal. Based on an orthogonal dual-channel radar vital detection system, the extended differential and cross-multiply algorithm(DACM) is proposed to demodulate the Doppler phase. The algorithm is applied to targets with different motion states. The results show that if the motion state of the target only causes the micro-Doppler phase, the similarity between the signal demodulated by the extended differential-difference algorithm and the original signal is 0.9999. If the target has both Doppler phases caused by radial motion and micro-Doppler phase caused by periodic motion, the similarity between the signal demodulated by DACM and the original signal is 0.9916. This result is of great significance for the application of Doppler radar in target recognition, vital detection and surveillance, engineering measurement, etc.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent System of Computer Big Data Technology to Guide Athletes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article is based on computer big data technology and uses a single LPMS-B2 nine-axis attitude sensor to design a swimming sports competition guidance competition system. We obtain the nine-axis attitude data through the Bluetooth connection and use Python to reduce the noise of the data. At the same time, data such as swimming style, number of strokes and frequency are calculated. The backend uses Java and Python, and the front-end App displays data. Use = somatosensory equipment to obtain various motion trajectories in the human body movement in the virtual swimming environment and realize the three-dimensional human body model to move in the virtual fitness scene.
