articleTitle: Research on Smart Analysis System of E-commerce Trade Based on Computer Big Data and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article designs a cross-border e-commerce website system based on computer big data method research. The system uses spring + spring + mybatis as the development framework, uses MySQL 5.7 database, Tomcat 7.0 server, and Redis caching technology to realize the interconnection between users and merchants, providing a prototype reference for the design and development of cross-border shopping platforms.

articleTitle: Optimization of dual NURBS curve fitting in five-axis machining
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the curve tool track chord error generated by CAM software in 5-axis machining is out of the given tolerance, this paper proposes a method based on three times double NURBS curve fitting optimization. After the initial fitting of NURBS curve for the tool center point and tool axis point, the curve segments with excessive chord error are detected and the insertion of control nodes is used to ensure that the fitted curve segments meet the given requirements. The simulation of a set of data points illustrates the effectiveness of the method, which can effectively solve the problem of excessive string errors and improve the machining quality of complex free-form surfaces.

articleTitle: The Research on Underground Safety Inspection and Gas Methane Detection Based on Industrial Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: By using industrial Internet technology and integrating coal mine safety monitoring system, UWB underground personnel accurate positioning system, MIS system data, electronic watermark, etc., it is realized to strictly restrict underground security inspectors from carrying out safety inspection at the specified time and place. To realize the authenticity and uniqueness of underground safety inspection and gas inspection data, we can use the digital watermark of inspection place, inspection time and inspector's name which is added to the picture by using the photographing function. And prevent missed inspection and data fraud, so as to ensure the safety of underground production and avoid accidents.

articleTitle: Research on Active Monitoring System of Power Supply Service Demand Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the improvement of the overall service level of society, people's requirements for power supply services are getting higher and higher. In order to improve the quality of power supply service, reduce the risks in power supply business activities, improve the business efficiency and management level of enterprises, build a unified audio and video monitoring system, and achieve a three-level management model of centralized supervision at the provincial level and local monitoring at the city and county levels. The main requirements function of the customer appeal information management system of the electric power company include the acceptance and review of appeal information, the appeal return visit and response information management function, the responsibility determination function, the monitoring and reminding function, the work order query function, the case information maintenance management function and the software system Operation and maintenance management functions. The thesis outlines the overall software design and database logic scheme of the information system on the basis of demand analysis, and further discusses the relational data model of database tables and the design of main business processes. On the basis of the system design, the program implementation and testing of the main modules of the system are completed.

Author Keywords: power supply service demand active monitoring system

articleTitle: Computer assisted design and test of gas leakage simulation device for underwater structure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: When gas leakage occurs in underwater structures, jet noise will be generated due to the turbulence effect of gas, and the noise has a certain frequency band width and directivity. At the same time, the jet noise presents different spectrum characteristics and sound source level under different conditions such as internal pressure, opening size of leakage point, pipe joint material and structure. Based on the relevant theory of gas leakage of underwater structures, a device for simulating gas leakage of underwater structures under high pressure is designed, and experiments are carried out in the laboratory and lake. The results show that the leakage simulation device can truly simulate the gas leakage of underwater structures, which provides a design basis for the development of gas leakage monitoring system of underwater structures.

articleTitle: Development of ‘Space Cloud Orbit’ Operation Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At present, China's train system is in the stage of rapid development. To help the development of the train system, this paper introduces and develops the simulation system; Firstly, this paper discusses the train simulation system. Secondly, it introduces the main functions and functions of the system. Finally, it introduces the computing system based on the platform and its simulation results. The simulation results show that the digital model simulation is feasible and meets the requirements of practical use.

articleTitle: Quasi-PR multi-layer photovoltaic grid-connected control based on frequency feedback
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to reduce the harmonic components of grid-connected current and reduce the cost in the process of photovoltaic grid connection, this paper proposes a photovoltaic grid-connected inverter control strategy using frequency feedback Quasi-PR with harmonic compensation control strategy under LCL type filter. Compared with the traditional dual PI control, the algorithm proposed in this paper only needs to control the PV inverter system under the stationary coordinate frame. The control structure is simple and the feed-forward decoupling control under the rotating coordinate frame is omitted. At the same time, the control strategy proposed in this paper can track the power grid frequency in real time which can stabilize the power factor of the system better. Finally, the superiority of the proposed control method is verified by Matlab/Simulink model.

articleTitle: Research of Passenger Vehicles in Battery Rental Model Based on Mathematical Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At present, many car companies consider the use of battery rental model in the sales process in view of the problem that the price of new energy vehicles (NEVs) is higher than that of internal combustion engine vehicles (ICEVs) of the same level. NIO has implemented the BaaS model of battery rental in swappable vehicles. However, the current market of NEVs accounts for a larger proportion of the unswappable vehicles, so it is of great significance to study the economy of unswappable vehicles under the battery rental model. In this paper, by comparing the total cost of ownership for consumers to buy ICEV, NEV with whole vehicles, and NEV with battery rental model, we can get the best rental pricing range for both consumers and battery operators. Rental pricing, battery cost, maintenance and operation costs, battery residual value, body scrap ratio, and battery rental model sales all have an impact on the economy of battery operators. In this paper, the mode of “battery lease + cascade utilization” is proposed considering that the utilization of the back-end step can further improve the residual value of the battery, save the cost of recycling the battery and improve the recovery rate.

articleTitle: Novel Multi-pattern Reconfigurable Horn Antenna Made of Pure Water
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A reconfigurable horn antenna made of pure water is described in this paper. The proposed horn antenna uses pure water layer instead of the metallic wall of a conventional horn antenna. High gain and wide band should be obtained when dimensions of the horn are well chosen. The proposed water horn antenna achieves a bandwidth of 68.4% (from 2.6 GHz to 5.2 GHz). By taking advantage of the fluidity of water, pattern reconfigurability can be achieved. Simulated results show that the proposed horn antenna can work in four different states: E-plane horn, H-plane horn, pyramidal horn and leaky-wave antenna, which indicate different radiation patterns.

articleTitle: Research on anti-jamming technology of missile-borne radar seeker in complex electromagnetic environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the upgrading of electronic countermeasures, the anti-jamming technology of radar seeker is required in modern war. Based on the background of complex electromagnetic environment, this paper summarizes the working principle of radar seeker anti-jamming technology in time domain, space domain, frequency domain and polarization domain, and prospects the development trend of radar seeker anti-jamming technology in the future.

articleTitle: Research of China power industry software application analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Development of power industry software is a long-term system engineering, which is very important for China to maintain the leading level of power industry in the world and realize the digital transformation of Energy Internet. This paper combs the category of power industry software, establishes concept of Power Design and Simulation Software, investigates application scenarios, summarizes some problems exposed in the process of Power Industry Software development and application, and puts forward development suggestions of power industry software.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Virtual Reality Technology in Sports Simulation Training
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article will combine ergonomics with arts and crafts and organize volleyball players' ergonomics data. Using computer virtual reality technology to accurately describe the craftsmanship data of the athlete's human body and the three-dimensional model of volleyball. At the same time, we imported the human body model from Pro/ENGINEER into Visual Studio, and used OpenGL animation simulation to control the three-dimensional entity model to simulate various blocking actions of volleyball players. The research results show that the system can quickly make various human models by modifying the parameters, simulating athletes with different movement characteristics, and can effectively assist the volleyball team in blocking training.

articleTitle: Application of Color Management System in BOM Configuration and Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Today, with the rapid development of information technology, the degree of enterprise information construction determines whether an enterprise can stand firm and develop at a high speed in the changeable business sea. BOM is the governance core of enterprise information construction, the foundation of any governance system and the main line running through various information systems. BOM governance is the main content of enterprise technology governance informatization. Moreover, in the whole product life cycle, different parts will have different requirements for BOM. These requirements can be mainly divided into design BOM EBOM, planned BOM pbom and manufacturing BOM EBOM.

articleTitle: Detecting dynamical parameters in evacuation behavior via deep convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the collective behavior of evacuation, the heterogeneous information will cause deviations to the optimal choice. It is observed in the real world and can be described by mathematical models. In this study, we implement a deep learning approach to detect the crucial dynamical parameter in a cellular automaton(CA) model describing the evacuation affected by heterogeneous external environments. The well-trained deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) accurately predict the dynamical factor from a short video generated by the CA model. Moreover, the 2-hidden convolutional layers neural network has a remarkable generalization performance in a different initial setup. In summary, this framework provides us with a chance to determine the important dynamics quantitatively in such a complicated collective behavior.

articleTitle: Deep learning technology for re-identification of people and vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article contains and explains the deep learning, especially different kinds of re-identifications. Deep learning which is contained in this article including vehicle re-identification, pedestrian re-identification and facial completion. This article defines these three kinds of re-identifications, and also explains and compares the methods which uses to actually do re-identifications. It also introduces some algorithms, it talks about how the algorithms come out, how to use it, and what problems do different algorithms have, what kind of future goals can be made, and what needs to be developed. Although the field of recognitions has already achieved some goals recently, there are still many challenges need to be solved.

articleTitle: An enhanced TDR and multi-ratio measuring method for locating long-distance distribution cable joints
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Traditional time domain reflectometry (TDR) is difficult to detect cable joints on a long-distance distribution cable. In this article, an enhanced TDR and multi-ratio measuring method are proposed for locating long-distance distribution cable joints. At first, the relationship between reflection factor and cable joints location is analyzed in theory. Next, the relationship is verified by a simulation using MATLAB/Simulink. Then an enhanced TDR circuit and a multi-ratio measurement system are designed. In the end, a cable joints location experiment is carried out and the result of experiment shows that enhanced TDR and multi-ratio measuring system can locate cable joints on a long-distance cable accurately and the location relative error is 0.24%.

articleTitle: Remote Network Pharmacology Course Reform through Artificial Intelligence and Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Pharmacology is a main course in higher vocational colleges, and it is also a required course for medical and pharmacy majors. According to the characteristics of the students in higher vocational colleges, the classroom teaching and practical teaching of pharmacology are reformed, and the practicality is more prominent by combining the innovation of teaching methods with concrete cases, promoting the cultivation of technical and technical talents in higher vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Numerical prediction based on sub-beam decomposition for magnetic deflection in MRI-guided proton therapy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Magnetic resonance image (MRI) guidance for proton therapy is an advantageous choice to improve the targeted dose accuracy, while the MRI magnetic field causes the Bragg peak lateral deflection and longitudinal retraction, eventually leading to dose deviation. Considering the energy spread of the proton beam, this deflection effect is more pronounced, which was demonstrated using Monte Carlo (MC) method in this study. We proposed a Ray-tracing-based numerical equivalent method to rapidly predicate the beam trajectory, by decomposing the beam with a certain energy spread into multiple sub-beams and characterizing it by a mono-energetic proton beam with appropriate energy. The equivalent relation was determined for the numerical algorithm and verified by MC simulations. The results show that the numerical prediction of the deflection trajectory is consistent with the MC simulations in sub-millimetric accuracy and each prediction was performed within 0.1s.

articleTitle: Current Situation Analysis of Echelon Utilization of Traction Battery for New Energy Vehicle Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The recycling of traction batteries of new energy vehicles is related to environmental protection, safety, resources and other issues, which has been highly concerned by the national government and the public. This paper analyzes the development status of China's traction battery echelon utilization industry from three aspects of policy, technology and industry. According to the analysis results, it is proposed that the echelon utilization industry should strictly implement the requirements of national government management policies, attach importance to key technologies and upstream and downstream cooperation of industrial chain, realize the green development of new energy automobile industry and help the realization of the national “double carbon” strategic goal.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Network System Security Risk Evaluation Oriented to Geographic Information Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the advent of the Internet era, all walks of life in our country have undergone earth-shaking changes, especially the drone and geographic information industries, which have developed rapidly under the impetus of the Internet of Things era. However, with the continuous development of science and technology, the network structure has become more and more complex, and the types of network attacks have varied. UAV information security and geographic information data have appeared security risks on the network. These hidden dangers have contributed to the progress of the drone and geographic information industry. And development has caused a great negative impact. In this regard, this article will conduct research on the network security of UAV systems and geographic information data, which can effectively assess the network security risks of UAV systems, and propose several solutions to potential safety hazards to reduce UAV networks. Security risks and losses provide a reference for UAV system data security.

articleTitle: Development and Research of Document Intelligent Information Systems in Library Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As the interactive interface of the library automation system ultimately facing users, OPAC (Online Public Search Catalog) is the most important window for the library to communicate with readers, and it plays a role in communicating readers and collection resources, readers and resource services. The article chooses Windows NT as the network environment to realize online retrieval of campus literature information. The design content of the campus document information online retrieval system includes system objectives, system composition and environment, system principles and functions, database design and types, and user interface design. The study found that the application of this system has greatly improved the efficiency of document retrieval in academic libraries.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Stock Prediction Model with Mathematical Statistics and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As we look into the financial markets, or more straightforwardly, the stock market, the unstable stock price is always a problem existing in the stock market. Whether the price will go up or down and by how much, has always been an unavoidable issue for the investors. Although the price is relatively unstable, many people come up with methods to predict the future stock prices in order to make the price more predictable and hence make a huge number of profits. A relatively successful prediction on the stock price can help you earn a large amount of money from it, increasing the attention and motivation to find different methods of predicting price. The objective of this paper is to summarize and review some of the popular methods of stock price forecasting both in a traditional statistical method and the machine learning or deep learning methods as well as the more favored approach adopted today and the relevant research on them.

articleTitle: Research on fault detection technology of autonomous underwater vehicle navigation system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability and high precision of AUV integrated navigation system in the complex Marine environment, the strap-down inertial navigation system is adopted as the reference system of AUV integrated navigation system, and the Doppler velocity sonar and global positioning system are used as the auxiliary navigation system to form the integrated navigation system In order to solve the problem that the classical residual chi-square fault detection method is difficult to detect the gradual fault, a residual fault detection method based on vector normalization is proposed The simulation results show that the residual fault detection based on vector normalization is more timely than the residual Chi-square fault detection method in detecting gradual faults, which is conducive to the timely isolation and processing of the autonomous underwater vehicle navigation system and improves the reliability of the navigation system.

articleTitle: An Improved Method to Train the Model Rapidly for the Classification of Ceramic Tiles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the production line of ceramic tiles, different types of tiles need to be classified with the algorithm of image classification. For most of common image classification tasks, the classification precision and inference time are our focus results which represent how effective the method proposed is. However, the time of training the model is also important in the image classification of ceramic tiles due to the need of no much time of waiting the model to be trained. In this paper, we propose a method to meet the requirements of training the model rapidly and high classification precision. The method is mainly based on the matrix features from traditional image processing algorithms and classifier from Artificial neural networks (ANN). The output feature is the combination of HSV model and Gray-level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM). The classifier is the AngleLinear classifier which is usually used to in combination with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The experimental result shows that our proposed method performs better than other common methods in accuracy under the constraints of only a few minutes of training time, especially on the image datasets that exhibit high similarity in the feature of color and texture.

articleTitle: Design of multi-channel transcranial DC stimulator based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In view of the stress of people's life in modern life, they frequently suffer from mental illness, such as depression, autism, mental illness and a series of problems. A design of an embedded real-time controllable multi-channel transcranial DC stimulator system based on STM32 is proposed. The DC stimulator is controlled by the STM32 microcontroller, which integrates the power supply module, communication module, impedance monitoring module, etc. Intelligent algorithms are used to optimize human-machine interaction in software design. The user can adjust the treatment parameters through the relevant control interface and intelligent treatment through a combination of treatment channels and treatment modes.

articleTitle: Optimization of reflecting surface adjustment of FAST radio telescope based on improved Harris Hawk Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: FAST is the world's largest single-aperture radio telescope with the highest sensitivity, which was designed and built independently by China. This paper establishes an active reflector optimization model based on the structure and working principle of the active reflector of FAST, and investigates the ideal paraboloid equation and the expansion and contraction of the relevant actuators for different orientations of the observing object to optimize the working paraboloid parameters in order to obtain the best reception efficiency of electromagnetic waves after reflection from the paraboloid.

articleTitle: Mathematical Analysis and Assessing Video Games' Competitive Structures in Terms of Nonzero Sumness
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Nonzero sumness is widely observed in cooperative video games. This paper assesses the video games' competitive structures in terms of nonzero sumness first. To analyse how the real-life imitations of the identified competitive structures, five non-zero cooperative interactions between groups are examined. It concludes that there can be an overall broader sharing of social benefits from the blended style of gaming if a win-win outcome can be achieved.

articleTitle: Ideal Construction of Chatbot Based on Intelligent Depression Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Depression detection usually describes the task of recognizing the depression level or tendency from certain articles, posts, or even consult. Such a technique might be widely used in the diagnosis when the psychologists or consulters are present. However, when such a type of diagnosis or service comes online, there would be many types of challenges, such as detection through some amounts of words, detection through pictures or video streaming of patients, and in some cases, how depression could be solved without the participation of a real doctor. This article generally discussed some common methods to solve these challenges and some construction designs that might help depressed patients. Currently, depression detection is still an innovative field to be explored, and many techniques do not seem to be mature. According the investigation on the techniques related to the construction of depression chatbots, we recognized that some tasks-based function can be realized, it would be quite difficult for such chatbot to really understand feelings and emotions, and consequently the chatbot will have many difficulties to produce neither therapies for the patients nor a meaningful conversation to offer assistance. In the future, more advanced methods will come out which can capture more details of the mental movements of the patients, and one day it will no longer be impossible for a computer to understand humans' subtle internal.

articleTitle: The Application of Virtual Simulation Technology and Artificial Intelligence in Network Vocational Course
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Virtual simulation experiment teaching is an important element of the construction of vocational education informationization and experimental presentation teaching center, and it is the results of the deep combination of rules and information technology. In the form of simulation, the situation, process, and results have a sense of reality, so that learners can get a real experience. The current clinical skill training is mostly “simulation” rather than “virtual”. Based on the Internet technology platform, it makes learning at anytime, anywhere. This article aims to discuss the features of virtual simulation experiment presentation teaching and the application of its technology in vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Information System Construction of Online Class Based on Computer Big Data and Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In view of the current situation of decontextualized or weak-contextualized teaching mode in college English class, the paper proposes to employ big data technology to construct an ecological teaching context in online English class to enhance language immersion. Guided by the theory of situational cognitive learning, the situational elements of ecological teaching in college English class are analyzed and designed, and the big data virtual situation creation system is realized.

articleTitle: Research on product force enhancement model based on genetic algorithm and nonlinear programming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the score of product power, this paper establishes an optimization model of product power score improvement based on genetic algorithm. Firstly, customers who did not purchase cars were selected, and then nonlinear programming was established to minimize the improvement of satisfaction (customer purchase). Then, the constraint conditions are determined and the equations are established by using the genetic algorithm toolbox of MATLAB. The minimum values of customer satisfaction are obtained as follows: 6.5, 9.6 and 4.2, and corresponding schemes are formulated according to the results. Finally, we evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of the model, and discuss the future of the model.

articleTitle: An intelligent software testing method for online advertising strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of Internet technology, Internet products have penetrated into People's Daily life and become an indispensable part of people's life. With the continuous development and innovation of modern artificial intelligence, big data and Internet information technology, the profit model of the Internet is also constantly updated, entering the vision of most researchers. Among them, the income brought by Internet advertising [1] is particularly prominent. So how to quickly test a kind of online advertising strategy has become the main problem facing at present. As for Internet online advertising strategies, the main research direction of major Internet companies is to design different strategies for different groups of people and businesses, and each strategy needs to go through a series of testing procedures to ensure that there will be no serious problems before a certain strategy goes online. However, Whether a real online advertising strategy can meet the established target groups and target businesses, as well as how to really bring revenue to the company can only observe the corresponding results after the online advertising strategy.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of Full-Ocean-Depth Manned Submersible Based on Experimental Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The motion simulation of manned submersible plays an important role in the whole submersible development. During the actual operation of manned submersible, it is affected by the factors such as deep ocean current, model uncertainty and unmodeled dynamics, which make the traditional simulation results differ greatly from the actual results. Taking “Fen Douzhe” manned submersible as the research object, the kinematic and dynamic models were established, and the system disturbance was estimated by using long and short term memory neural network, and the model was verified by simulation calculation with the experimental data of “Fen Douzhe”. The effectiveness of the simulation method is verified by comparing the simulation results with the actual experimental data.

articleTitle: Research on Scientific Sports Training System by Computer Big Data Technology and Intelligent Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The main method of sports biomechanics research in track and field events is to use high-speed image analysis system to monitor the training process, and obtain kinematic information through special or general analysis software. The system uses flexible array sensors to obtain contact interaction information during the run-up process, and uses dedicated analytical software to process kinematic parameters integrated, and provides real-time biomechanical parameters such as step length, speed, stride frequency, and jump force during exercise.

articleTitle: Current Status, Hot Spots and Trends of Media Exposure Research—Based on the Visual Perspective of CiteSpace (2000-2020)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article uses 1849 media exposure papers published in 2000-2020 involve the core database of the Web of Science database as a research sample, uses bibliometrics to analyze the distribution of research papers by age, and uses the citation network analysis tool CiteSpace to study media exposure. The literature data was analyzed quantitatively, and the authors of the literature were drawn. The institution distribution, keywords clustering and research hotspot distribution analyzes the hot spots and cutting-edge trends of media exposure research, hoping to provide reference for media exposure research and social practice.

articleTitle: Study on supply and demand interaction strategy of load aggregator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the quasi - real - time electricity price, first from the perspective of power users, electricity satisfaction and satisfaction. In order to achieve the highest satisfaction, the ideal load curve is obtained by reverse calculation. Under the premise of given electricity price, the quantization of expected load curve is creatively realized. Then from the point of view of load aggregator, the ideal price strategy is designed. Furthermore, in the case of multi-load aggregators, the limitation of single-load aggregators is broken through, and the optimal evolutionary game strategy considering users and other competitive aggregators is designed. Finally, the simulation of green construction zone in Changzhou shows that the algorithm described in this paper can take account of user satisfaction, load aggregator income and balance between supply and demand.

articleTitle: Research on Multidimensional Electronic Behavior Portrait Technology of Electronic Archives Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Blockchain, as the underlying logic of digital technology, has been widely used in many fields of economy and society. The characteristics of blockchain technology, such as tamper-proof, decentralization, privacy protection, multi-node consensus, traceability and verification, deeply fit the needs of credible storage, collaborative sharing, traceability verification, and confidentiality of electronic archive management, and are extremely important for the whole life cycle management of electronic archives. In this paper, by collecting and labeling key electronic behavior information of electronic archives, forming an unstructured labeling system of multidimensional electronic archival behavior information. Using cluster analysis and Hardtop/Spark-based data processing platform, building a multidimensional electronic behavior portrait model based on blockchain. Based on the model, key information of electronic archive collection and arrangement, appraisal and utilization, statistical verification, etc. is stored on the alliance blockchain, so as to build a credible and reliable business application and a process tracking system. The application and system could help to ensure the standardization, intelligence and specialization of archive management under the premise of archive security, and solve the current problems that electronic archives are easily to be tampered with, unstable in storage, high management cost, and difficult to be shared by cross-organizational collaboration.

articleTitle: Review and Enlightenment of Foreign Auxiliary Service Cost Allocation Mechanism in Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The current ancillary service cost allocation mechanism in China does not consider the incur responsibility and benefit degree of ancillary services. This paper studies the ancillary service cost allocation mechanism of Texas, the United Kingdom, Australia and Northern Europe. On this basis, combined with the actual situation in China, suggestions on the design of China's ancillary service cost allocation mechanism are put forward.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of low-temperature protective clothing based on target planning and heat transfer modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of society and technology, more and more people are choosing to travel as a way to relax after work, and making travel itinerary planning is a very important issue. Twenty-nine scenic spots in the Yangtze River Delta region were selected as the study objects, and travel time was set for travel route planning. The route planning was obtained for three travel scenarios: considering only time, considering only price, and considering both time and price. The problem is transformed into a TSP problem with conditional constraints, and the optimal routes and expenses for the three scenarios are obtained using a simulated annealing algorithm..

articleTitle: Research on FPGA-based modulation algorithm for directional sound sources
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The directional sound source system can transmit the sound beam in a directional manner to achieve high directional sound propagation, which has a wide application prospect in the fields of public security, armed police, maritime surveillance and fishery administration, military, airport bird repelling, civil disaster relief department, border control, etc. The basic principle is to use the nonlinear characteristics of ultrasonic waves propagating in the air, and to self-demodulate the frequency-dependent audible sound signal during the propagation process. In this paper, the algorithms related to signal modulation and air nonlinear demodulation are studied, and the algorithms are derived using bilateral and single sideband modulation, respectively. The working principle of the digital control oscillator is described, a soft IP core is used to design the digital control oscillator, the waveform generation algorithm of the digital control oscillator is analyzed in detail, the phase addition jitter technique is introduced, and a high precision digital controllable sine wave is generated after simulation. The top-level documentation of the directional sound source system has been designed to facilitate modular applications. The system functions have been simulated to achieve the desired goal of bilateral band modulation and single sideband modulation.

articleTitle: Improvement of Plant Growth Model Based on Particle System and Its Computer Simulation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article proposes a modelling method of virtual crop organs based on particle system. Combining this method with the measured data obtained during crop growth can better simulate the shape and dynamic growth process of crop organs in three-dimensional space. Using computer graphics technology, the dynamic growth of crop organs is realized through VC++.net and OpenGL.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology and Intelligent Monitoring System in Pharmacological Lab
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: By analyzing the characteristics of signals in biomedical pharmacological experiments, this article introduces the design of four data acquisition methods in pharmacological experiments and the realization of the calibration, sampling, and scale transformation of experimental parameters. The system includes the selection of sensors for various physiological signals, the design of corresponding pre-amplification filter circuits, and the realization of LabVIEW-based PC measurement software through NIUSB6008. The system can better avoid analysis errors caused by signal variation and external interference, and is especially suitable for real-time monitoring and analysis of experimental animal ECG parameters in physiological, pharmacological, and toxicological tests.

articleTitle: Structural design and finite element analysis of underwater gas leakage intelligent monitoring array
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The underwater structure gas leakage monitoring system designed by passive acoustics has the characteristics of long detection distance, no obstruction and the influence of seawater turbidity, and can reach a detection distance of hundreds of meters. Based on the principle of passive underwater acoustic positioning and the actual needs, this paper designs the hydrophone array and the array frame for installing the hydrophone array, analyzes the overall layout of the array frame, and establishes the finite element model of the array frame. The calculation shows that the strength and stiffness of the array frame meet the design requirements under the hoisting conditions of 30 °, 45 ° and 60 °. Finally, through the actual static hoisting test, the feasibility of the scheme is verified, which lays a foundation for the next test of underwater structure gas leakage monitoring system.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Pipeline Layout in Mechanical and Electrical Installation of BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the vigorous development of my country's economy, the process of large-scale urbanization has brought unprecedented demand for new construction. In the face of increasing complexity of project design, short design cycle and tight construction period, traditional computer-aided design methods have encountered multiple difficulties. This article uses literature search method and comparative analysis method to compare CAD technology and BIM technology, studies and analyzes the problems of traditional construction, and summarizes the advantages of BIM technology in traditional construction, and then analyzes the results based on the case. Shows that the use of BIM technology can save expenses and reduce construction period.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Signal in Chaotic Background in Physical Inverse Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The article first establishes an inverse filter and reconstructs the phase space from its output, and then uses the duffing equation to minimize the relative singular value of the output signal in the embedded space for local singular value decomposition to realize parameter estimation. Finally, the article establishes a chaotic system based on Duffing oscillator to detect weak sinusoidal signals under the background of colored noise. The simulation results of the model parameters and the frequency estimation of the sinusoidal signal verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Design of Mobile Internet Platform and Information Visualization Based on Furniture Display and 3Dmax
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Like other works of art in ancient China, furniture in the Ming and Qing Dynasties not only has profound cultural and artistic heritage of the Chinese nation, but also has elegant and practical functions, which makes people have endless aftertaste. It represents the peak of Chinese traditional furniture manufacturing. This paper designs a mobile Internet platform based on the furniture display culture of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, which displays the furniture culture of the Ming and Qing Dynasties from multiple angles and all directions from the aspects of technology, history and entertainment, and brings those furniture flowing all over the world together. In the implementation process, we mainly use Unity3d for Android development and 3Dmax for model production. Through this platform, we can understand the development of furniture in the Ming and Qing Dynasties and learn history and culture interestingly and cultivate humanistic feelings. We can not only appreciate the style of furniture in the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but also spread China's excellent traditional culture and contribute to the development of China's cultural industry.

Author Keywords: Furniture in the Ming and Qing Dynasties

articleTitle: Research on Interactive Genetic Color Matching Design Based on User Cognitive Noise
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to understand the user's recognition of interface color matching design and effectively improve the efficiency of interface color matching. In this paper, the interactive genetic algorithm is introduced into the process of user recognition and fatigue, and the user cognitive noise model is constructed. Then the color value and evaluation value of color scheme are used to calculate the cognitive noise function. The process of interface interactive genetic color matching design is proposed. Taking the interactive interface as an example, this paper analyzes the user cognitive characteristics, and verifies that the user cognitive background is the influencing factor of the color scheme evaluation change of the interface.

articleTitle: Intelligent On-line Monitoring Systems of Process Stability in Lapping Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In response to the lack of on-line monitoring of process stability in the traditional lapping process, the limit device of the workpiece was retrofitted to reflect the process stability in the lapping process by monitoring the trend of the friction force during the lapping process in real-time. The relationship between the stability of the workpiece removal rate and the stability of the friction force was investigated by lapping K9 glass on the modified lapping machine. The results show that the friction between the workpiece and the lapping plate can qualitatively reflect the stability of the lapping process without the need to repeatedly measure the profile of the workpiece during the lapping process and that the lapping process can be guided by real-time observation of strain changes, which is important for improving the certainty and controllability of the lapping process.

articleTitle: Sparse nonlinear dimension reduction algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: After we go into the big data age, the scale of data sets becomes more and more massive. The dimension of the data is also higher. For a task, there are a huge number of features in the ultra-high-dimensional data set that are irrelevant to the learning task. Manifold learning is proposed to reduce the dimensions of high-dimensional data sets and to use a manifold and other geometric tools to extract features from the data sets to obtain valid features and eliminate invalid features. However, the traditional manifold learning algorithms still have some unresolved problems by themselves. At present, the classic manifold learning algorithm can not deal with some large scale data sets. The main reason is that the cost of memory is very high during the algorithm construction. Therefore, this article makes some improvement for the basic manifold algorithm and proposes a sparse algorithm to reduce the memory cost and the time complexity. In experiments, we are using three sets of combinational data sets for comparative experiments. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm has obvious advantages in terms of time consumption.

articleTitle: Research on color enhancement of interior design renderings based on perceptual optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the contrast of multi-regions, the interior design drawing has visual errors and poor color effect. This paper proposes a color enhancement model of interior design drawing based on perceptual optimization. Establish the detection model of prominent targets in low-light images under multi-area care contrast, realize the color perception of interior design renderings by combining local and global significance detection methods, adaptively select the optimal visual features by the entropy information of feature maps, compensate and adjust the darkness by combining the significance analysis of global contrast and color difference contrast, and extract effective visual features to represent interior design low-light images under multi-area care contrast by perceptual optimization control. By detecting the average gray value of neighboring pixels, using the methods of optimal correlation superpixel pairing and entropy function detection, the significant values of all superpixels can be measured to generate the final significant map of interior design effect under multi-area care contrast, and realize the color enhancement of interior design effect map under multi-area care contrast. The test shows that the color enhancement performance of interior design renderings designed by this method is better, the output peak signal-to-noise ratio is higher, the color difference significance is effectively suppressed, and the design effect is improved.

articleTitle: Design of High Power Density DC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: High power density is the development trend of power electronic equipment. Increasing the switching frequency can significantly reduce the volume of the converter, but traditional silicon devices will produce higher losses at high frequencies, resulting in lower power efficiency. The third-generation wide-bandgap semiconductor device gallium nitride (GaN) has a breakthrough in performance compared to traditional silicon devices. It has the characteristics of low loss and fast switching speed, and shows great advantages in the high-frequency field. At the same time, the choice of small size, high integration, and small leakage inductance planar transformer is beneficial to improve the power density and efficiency of the converter. This article uses gallium nitride devices and planar transformer technology to design a high-power density DC/DC converter at a higher frequency, and simulates the design through LTspice software, and finally produces a 30W experiment The prototype verifies the rationality of the design.

articleTitle: Research on Mathematical Statistics Method Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The software measurement model under computer big data is based on the measurement value of the software engineering project (such as the size of the project team) for the future software engineering to predict the target software measurement value, such as the software development workload and error rate statistics. Obviously, building such a software measurement model requires the use of data samples from similar projects in the past. However, there are often missing data in these data samples. The determination of which measurement variables to choose as independent variables in regression modeling is likely to be based on intuition or empirical assumptions. After the model is established, empirical hypotheses are rarely tested after the fact, so it is easy to produce redundant measurement variables and increase unnecessary complexity. For this reason, the article mainly considers the processing methods of discrete variables. Introduce a more common method of dummy variables. Finally, the article uses the method of case analysis and uses computer big data R, SPSS, Java and other languages and programs to complete the simplification of the software measurement data model under the absence of data.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Design and Application of Internet-Based SPOC Blending Courses Using Big Data and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, big data and cloud computing technology, blending teaching comes into being. As an online education scheme, blending teaching makes use of online teaching methods such as MOOCs, micro-lecture and flipped classroom. Through setting interactive teaching situation, blending teaching deeply combines traditional teaching with online teaching, and makes reform and innovation on the original theoretical knowledge and practical teaching content of English major. It is of great significance to improve the English major teaching status quo and maximize the utilization of resources and classroom efficiency. This paper first accurately defines the concepts of blending teaching and SPOC, and then deeply analyzes the construction foundation, construction principles and overall framework of SPOC blending teaching in English major courses, and puts forward the operation process and matters needing attention in the process of application in order to solve the problems existing in the traditional teaching for English majors and provide a reference for the better reform of English major teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Big Data Technology in Generative Countermeasures Network Security Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to make up for the shortcomings of the current network security situation assessment system, this article proposes a network security situation quantitative assessment algorithm based on the offensive and defensive confrontation environment. Based on in-depth analysis of various factors affecting the security situation, this method combines traditional risk assessment with environmental factors such as network protection status and asset security characteristics, extracts multiple quantitative indicators, and conducts a quantitative assessment of the security situation according to the attack category. The case analysis shows that the method is in line with the actual confrontation network environment, and can accurately predict the attack time and reasonably quantify the attack threat.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization of Helicopter Composite Main Blade Production Line Based on DELMIA/Quest
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The production process of helicopter composite main blade is complex, with many procedures and large difference in process time. It leads the production line to run unevenly while the production capacity may not meet the delivery requirements. In order to solve this problem, the process of composite main blade is analyzed and the current production data is collected. On this basis, the production line of helicopter composite main blade is modeled and simulated by using simulation technology of production line based on DELMIA/Quest software. Key factors such as capacity, equipment utilization and bottlenecks of the production line are analyzed. In order to solve the problems found in the simulation, the improvement scheme is proposed from the perspectives of production shift, process and equipment configuration and verified by simulation. The simulation results provide the basis for the evaluation and optimization of composite main blade production line.

articleTitle: An enhanced Siamese Recurrent Model with Word Importance for Learning Sentence Similarity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: We propose an enhanced Siamese Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model with word importance for learning sentence similarity. The framework inherits from the MaLSTM model in [10], which employs LSTM to the word vectors learned separately from a large corpus. Additionally, our framework learns an importance weight for each word in the corpus, along with the LSTM procedure. The importance weight assigned to each word measures its influence on the semantic meaning of the whole sentence. The experimental results demonstrate the addition of the word importance factor to the original MaLSTM model in [10] brings near 0.5% performance enhancement of the test accuracy.

articleTitle: A Novel Heart Disease Classification Algorithm Based on Fourier Transform and Persistent Homology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Classification and prediction of heart disease is a significant problem to realize medical treatment and life protection. In this paper, persistent homology is involved to analyze electrocardiograms and a novel heart disease classification method is proposed. Each electrocardiogram becomes a point cloud by sliding windows and fast Fourier transform embedding. The obtained point cloud reveals periodicity and stability characteristics of electrocardiograms. By persistent homology, three features including normalized persistent entropy, maximum life of time and maximum life of Betty number are extracted. These features show the structural differences between different types of electrocardiograms and display encouraging potentiality in classification of heart disease.

articleTitle: UAV Electric Patrol Path Planning Based on Improved Ant Colony Optimization-A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Due to the control accuracy and the complexity of three-dimensional path planning, it is difficult for multi rotor UAV to locate accurately according to point cloud data. In order to overcome these problems, according to the control accuracy of UAV and taking the minimum how much the energy is consumed as the objective function, an improved ant colony-A* optimization algorithm based on UAV performance and wind speed constrained path planning model is established in this paper. The improved ant colony-A* algorithm is used to find the approximate optimal trajectory on the premise of covering all shooting points. The simulation results show that compared with the air transmission line UAV patrol image shooting manual, the how much the energy is consumed of the improved algorithm is greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's level classification by 3D PMNet using PET/MRI multi-modal images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The accurate diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) has an important impact on early treatment. Positron emission tomography (PET) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are popular imaging methods and are used to facilitate the identification and evaluation of AD. In this paper, we proposed a VGG-style 3D convolutional neural network (3D CNN) model, which is named 3D PET-MRI Net (3D PMNet), and it uses DiffGrad optimizer to speed up the convergence of the model and Focalloss function to improve the classification performance of unbalanced data processing. The multi-modal feature information of 3D MRI and PET images can be extracted using the 3D PMNet model, which provides convenience for AD diagnosis. Tenfold cross-validation was performed on the data of each patient in the data set to determine the group classification. The results showed that the proposed method achieves 97.49%, 81.25%, and 76.67% accuracy in the classification tasks of AD: NC, AD: MCI, and NC: MCI, respectively. Our PMNet reached 72.55% accuracy in AD: NC: MCI three group classification, which is significantly better than the other reported network models.

articleTitle: Research on Data Security Sharing in Blockchain: Challenges and Prospects
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of blockchain technology, data sharing has been widely studied in academia and industry in recent years, and a series of important achievements have been made. At present, there is a security problem of data sharing in blockchain technology. Firstly, it summarizes the data security sharing. Then, the data security sharing is divided into three aspects: confidentiality, integrity and availability, and the existing challenges and corresponding solutions are analyzed. Finally, the development status and trend of data security sharing in blockchain are summarized, and the important research directions in the future are prospected.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches on Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Sentiment analysis aims to uncover people's sentiment based on some information about them, often using machine learning or deep learning algorithm to determine. The importance of such a technique heavily grows because it can help companies better understand users' attitudes toward things and decide future plans. Considering the maturity of sentiment analysis on a single modal such as text and image and the advancement of social media, which allow users to post with text and image simultaneously, novel methods are designed for multimodal sentiment analysis. Because of the infancy of this field, new methods are sometimes inefficient, unstable and lack robustness and still need further study. One big challenge on the multimodal sentiment analysis is to find a proper way that can overcome heterogeneous gap between different modalities, which implies that researchers should develop a method of combining various modalities properly to get higher efficiency and accuracy. Although much research has been performed and many new models are implemented, related summary is still lacking. This paper mainly introduces four interesting and relatively novel methods of solving the links among diverse modalities. First it briefly introduces some basic definitions and terminologies in sentiment analysis, followed by several popular and common datasets on multimodal sentiment analysis. After that it gives some evaluation index to assess one model's competence. Then it shows four models and compares pros and cons among them, showing the potential trend of future study in multimodal sentiment analysis. Finally, it proposes future challenges and opportunities.

articleTitle: Research on Tourism Network Marketing Mathematical Strategy Model under Mobile Internet Plus and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the transformation of Chinese tourism from sightseeing to leisure and entertainment, and then to vacation experience, the key points of tourism marketing have also changed from channel and brand to content, with essential changes. With the arrival of the era of “Mobile Internet Plus Big Data”, and the combination of virtual reality technology and network technology, the traditional tourism marketing methods are difficult to meet the needs of the development of the new era. Therefore, in the era of “Mobile Internet Plus Big Data”, tourism marketing needs to develop with new ideas, make full use of the Internet and big data technology, and vigorously develop the new tourism network marketing, so as to realize the high-quality development of tourism. Starting from the era background of the Internet and big data, on the basis of defining and clarifying the concepts of Internet +, big data and tourism network marketing, this paper deeply explores the main channels and advantages of tourism network marketing in China, and then puts forward some countermeasures of tourism network marketing in the new era.

articleTitle: Short Sale Attack: A PoW-blockchain-aimed attacking model via short sale
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The 51% attack was generally considered to occur at a very small probability when it was first proposed. However, there are more 51% attacks happening recently. With the market price of cryptocurrencies continues to hit a new record recent years, we should also pay attention the higher potential risks accompanied. In this paper, we introduce a new kind of potential 51% attact risk using short sales on PoW-based blockchains and cryptocurrencies. We come out with a model to estimate the upper limit price for a certain cryptocurrency. In particular, we consider the influence of marketing fluctuation and introduce ARIMA to amend the model. Moreover, we discuss some more threatened scene using this kind of attack. Finally, based on the model, we conduct experiments to estimate the price limit and the risk of cryptocurrencies circulating in the current market. Results show that whether large blockchain system(like Bitcoin) or small one (like Ravencoin), they all have varying degrees of risk of being attacked.

articleTitle: Image Style Transfer Using Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Image style transfer is an increasingly popular technology that can learn the style of an existing picture through neural network algorithms and apply this style to another picture. It is widely used in the field of art, such as oil painting, cartoon animation production, image season conversion and text style conversion. Meanwhile, deep learning methods are attracting more and more attention both in research and applications in various areas. In this paper, we give an overview on current research progress and results of image style transfer using deep learning methods. The deep learning methods are categorized into Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). As for CNN methods, we mainly talk about models based on VGG; and in terms of GAN methods, conditional GAN, Cycle GAN, and cartoon-GAN methods are contained. Finally, we summarized the shortcomings of the current results and the future study direction.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv5 in Remote Sensing Slender and Rotating Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Although the deep-learning based object detecting methods for remote sensing imagery have achieved very high accuracy on most of the targets, the slender and rotating targets in remote sensing images, such as bridges and harbors, are exceptional. The problem is that the predefined anchor boxes usually cannot well cover these targets. Thus, in this study an improved YOLOv5 model is proposed to better detect the slender rotating targets in remote sensing imagery. Firstly, the size of input images is doubled to maintain the integrity of the target. Secondly, the deformable convolution (DCN) is applied in the backbone net-work during feature extraction to increase the coverage of the feature and decrease the interruption by the background while extracting the slender rotating targets. Finally, besides length and width of a bounding box, the aspect ratio of the bounding box is also added to the loss function to emphasize the im-portance of the uniqueness of the slender rotating targets and to improve the prediction accuracy subse-quently. The three modifications have been applied to the YOLOv5 model respectively and together on DOTA dataset. The results show that the proposed method can better detect slender and rotating targets in remote sensing images and the accuracy for bridge and harbor has been improved to 52.1% and 75.16% respectively.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Literature Mining and Analysis Research
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: By 2019 COVID-19, since the epidemic, the number of relevant documents exponentially level rise. Faced with a large amount of literature, this research provides convenience for exploring the connection between research topics and fields and quickly understanding relevant literature information. We pass on the data set after data cleansing using the LDA(Latent Dirichlet allocation) methods, and Berts and K-means modeling method extracting topic keywords. Use knowledge graph tools to output relevant visual graphics and systematically extract adequate information. Through text mining of biomedical research papers related to COVID-19, the improved model is used to analyze and make recommendations to respond to and prevent the COVID-19 pandemic. This research can support the rapid and in-depth analysis of a large number of relevant documents and can be used in future research to support real-time scientific disease research.

articleTitle: Intelligent Classification for Emotional Issues by Deep Learning Network on EEG Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Identifying the risk of emotional issues is of great significance to the development of adolescents. Electroencephalography (EEG) signals can reflect brain activities, and imply the emotional status, therefore can be used to identify emotional issues. In this study, we designed an experimental paradigm for high school adolescents by displaying emotion-inducing pictures as stimuli and recorded their EEG signals simultaneously. The EEG signals was preprocessed and analyzed. In this paper we applied a convolutional network EEGNet to classify four emotional issues in adolescents: depression symptom, manic symptom, anxiety symptom and the control group. The results showed that the classification accuracy of the four groups can reach 94.24%. In addition, this paper explored using different types of picture stimuli on the classification and reached a result above chance level. This work extended the previous work on the classification of emotional issues to four categories, and achieved a good classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Applications in Remote Data Acquisition, Data Analysis and Disease Early Warning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Under the realistic situation of China's aging population and home-based elderly care, the health management needs of Chinese families for the prevention and control of chronic diseases of the elderly are becoming more and more urgent. Robot technology and artificial intelligence can play a great role in remote physiological data acquisition, data analysis and disease early warning. However, science and technology projects with high cutting-edge advanced technology often face an insurmountable gap in the process of achievement transformation and industrialization, and the project survival rate is low. In practice, Suzhou Daoao technology intelligence Co., Ltd. has explored a development path suitable for the implementation of scientific and technological projects as soon as possible and the smooth transformation and industrialization of scientific and technological achievements. The formation of this development path comes from the work accumulated by the founders of the company for many years in the investment practice of scientific and technological innovation incubation, the transformation and operation of scientific and technological achievements and the theoretical research on the cultivation of hard science and technology enterprises. The core of this path is to build mature technical capabilities into exportable products and services in the early stage, enabling traditional enterprises to achieve the dual goals of rapid entry into the market and enterprise survival at the same time; In the later stage, more cutting-edge and advanced technologies are continuously transformed to connect the existing subjects in the field and create an ecological closed loop. Relying on this development model, Daoao has built an integrated solution for chronic disease prevention, control and health management of the elderly, including the packaging module of pulse monitoring technology, the health data analysis system based on artificial intelligence algorithm model, the R & D, production and sales of home-based elderly care service functional equipment and telemedicine detection equipment, It has become the leader in the industry segment.

Author Keywords: transformation of scientific and technological achievements

articleTitle: Big data analysis of the influence of ambient temperature on electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Under the restricting policy of number plate and traffic in first-tier and second-tier cities, more and more electric vehicles with green number plate appear in our field of vision. Especially with the rapid development and maturity of electric vehicle technology, automobile consumers have gradually begun to accept the electric vehicles, and the market share of electric vehicles is also rapidly increasing. However, the environmental temperature adaptability of electric vehicles has also become a pain point for some consumers. For example, in northern areas, the environmental temperature is very low in winter, and the charging time of electric vehicles is prolonged, the power performance is degraded, the accuracy of cruising range estimation is lowered, and accuracy of cruising range estimation is greatly reduced, which causes some users to complain. In this paper, through the objective test of nine mainstream electric vehicles in the market, the influence of low temperature weather in winter on all aspects of electric vehicles' performance is verified. At the same time, combined with the engineering project experience, the reasons for the influence of low temperature weather in winter on all aspects of electric vehicles are analyzed, and the corresponding optimization and rectification suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Intelligent Detection Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The advancement of technology and the diversification of payment forms have resulted in the emergence of financial fraud, with credit card fraud being more prevalent. In financial fraud detection, there are currently two approaches: 1) Rule-based methods and 2) Machine learning-based methods now. Although both approaches are relatively well developed and have been tested well, there still need human involvement to drive the experiments. Besides, the limitations of the data set can affect the predictive effectiveness of the models. Therefore, combining different strategies is needed to improve prediction performance. This paper summarizes new approaches that have been proposed recently, including the combination of spatial-temporal attention mechanism and GNN, the combination of DNN and spectrum coordinates, the combination of semi-supervised learning and GNN and the hybrid of supervised learning and semi-supervised learning. Some of the challenges faced in financial fraud detection are also addressed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Construction Method of Knowledge Graph in Electric Power Operation and Maintenance Field Based on Few-shot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the application of artificial intelligence technology in electric power industry, knowledge graph will play an important role in power grid dispatching, intelligent operation inspection, customer service question and answer, etc. The problem of low resources is very common in the construction of knowledge graph in the field of electric power operation and maintenance in real application scenarios. How to extract effective information from large-scale, small or even unlabeled power data, fully explore the value of field data, promote the efficient use of information resources, and build a knowledge graph in the power field with high efficiency and low cost is the main concern in the field of knowledge graph in the power field.
