Based on the knowledge graph construction method in the field of power operation and maintenance with a small sample, this paper proposes a FLAT-based entity relationship joint extraction model and an active sampling strategy based on meta-learning. The problem of knowledge graph construction in the sample domain is to realize the automatic construction and dynamic update of the knowledge graph construction in the power operation and maintenance domain.

articleTitle: Research on Model and Algorithm for Uncertain RCPSP with Job Reworking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To address the problems, that are the extension of project duration and the waste of idle resources, caused by changes which job reworking bring to the schedule, this paper constructed a mathematical model with objective function, the minimum sum of total project duration and deviation between planned starting time and actual starting time of jobs, and proposes a kind of reactive scheduling algorithm to solve the problem. Firstly, as the unqualified job is supposed to be restored, the reworking job is inserted after it and a new project network is formed of reworking job and unexecuted jobs. Secondly, in order to reduce the idle waste of resources, the parallel SGS algorithm based on the job combination is used to arrange the jobs and obtain the feasible scheduling plan. Then, the scheduling result is further optimized by improved cuckoo search algorithm with adaptive step-size. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm was tested on sets of benchmark instances of different scales from PSPLIB. The instance verification shows that the algorithm proposed in this paper has obvious advantages in optimizing project duration compared with other algorithms, and the resource utilization rate of project can reach to 90.64%.

articleTitle: Attention Network with PMI Value for Medication Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Medication recommendation plays an essential role to help doctors make diagnose in real clinic events more efficient with more and more EHR data in our daily life which contains rich information. Given the patients' medical data such as diagnosis, procedure and medication, we propose a novel model APVAN to utilize the medicine background knowledge and the patients' historical records in this work. Point-wise Mutual Information value is introduced to construct a medicine graph to illustrate the co-relationship of each medicine. Attention mechanism is adopted to design a new query method to combine different kinds of medical data. Raw data will be embedded first and then use the RNN module to temporally encoding; next, the medicine graph and historical module are combined with a novel query module to make a prediction. A little trick multi-label margin loss is used to solve the label imbalance between the positive and negative samples. Through the experiments, our method achieves the best performance 0.6879, 0.6072, 0.4483 on metrics including, PR-AUC, F1 score and Jaccard.

articleTitle: Study on effective bonding conditions calculation and data analysis for the field joint of pipelines by intelligent accurately controlling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The bonding conditions for hot-melt adhesives used for field joint coating were studied based on the rheological behavior and wettability of adhesives on the substrates. The wettability and viscosities of six hot-melt adhesives detached from a heat-shrinkable sleeve (HSS) were investigated with temperature. The wettability was characterized by the contact angles of the hot-melt adhesives on primed and polyethylene (PE) substrate surfaces at temperatures up to 200°C in the heating period of 20 min. To verify the effective bonding of the adhesives, peeling tests were performed on the HSS installed system, which was prepared in conditions corresponding to the contact angle measurement. The results showed that the suitable application temperature of HSS was controllable within the range from the intersection temperature (Ti) to the stabilization onset temperature (To) based on the viscosity-temperature curve (η- T). The optimal application temperature for effective adhesive-substrate bonding was between the wetting temperature (Tθ) and To. The effective bonding of hot-melt adhesive can be realized by accurately controlling the substrate's preheating temperature and the hot-melt adhesive temperature.

articleTitle: Research frontiers of pre-training mathematical models based on BERT
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Natural language processing (NLP) is a popular technology after the rise of big data and machine learning in recent years. With the development of deep learning, the field of natural language processing has also undergone a landmark transformation, including the emergence of the BERT large-scale language training model. The emergence of this model makes text mining a qualitative leap, meets more practical needs, and solves the related problems of feature vectorization of unstructured data. This article will sort out the connotation, task application, and main optimization and improvement methods of the BERT pre-training model released by Google, and provide a reference for subsequent related research and development based on BERT.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Recommendation Algorithm Based on User Interest Evolution and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article aims to study the recommendation algorithm of financial wealth management products based on the Internet. Through the item information of fund wealth management products, it mainly includes wealth management products issued by banks and fund products issued by fund companies as well as user behavior information, combined with traditional collaborative filtering algorithms to obtain a recommendation list, and then add a time series model, consider the seven-day annual interest rate and other time-sensitive attribute factors to improve the accuracy of the recommendation, and finally introduce the current more cutting-edge DIEN model algorithm to get the recommendation result, which integrates the sequence The model is used to simulate the change process of user interest over time, and the attention mechanism is introduced to improve the recommendation effect, thereby providing users with better product choices.

articleTitle: A Real-Time and Convenient Taxi Assistance Mini Program for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At present, the visually impaired are inconvenient to go out because they cannot get outside information. Moreover, relying on others’ help or guiding dogs to go out will also hurt their self-esteem, so they need a tool to help them go out independently. The most popular way to go out in modern times is to take an online taxi. However, there is no relatively mature auxiliary software to guide the visually impaired to find the online taxi he or she has booked. In order to solve this problem, we used a lightweight WeChat Mini Program and computer vision technologies to create a taxi assistance software. It can recognize the vehicle ahead and license plate, track the target vehicle in real time, provide the real-time location of the target vehicle for the visually impaired, and help the visually impaired take a taxi independently.

articleTitle: An algorithm optimization IEGS model considering P2G operation characteristics using particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Integrated electricity-gas system is a feasible way of achieving full use of surplus power from wind and solar energy. In this paper an integrated electricity-gas system scheduling model considering the characteristics of carbon trading and power to gas operation was proposed. The carbon trading mechanism based on the baseline method was considered in the scheduling model. Beside the relationship between the electrical power consumed in hydrogen production and the flow rate of hydrogen production in proton membrane exchange electrolysis technology were considered in the power to gas unit model along with the process flow of hydrogen gas methanation. An improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the model. The results show that the model considering P2G operation characteristics can well reflect the limited climbing characteristic of the unit in actual operation, and the carbon trading can strengthen the coupling of power and gas systems and thus reduce the carbon emission.

articleTitle: Pupil Dilation Reflecting the Characteristics of Attention Networks of Patients Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Attention is the basis of high-level cognitive functions of the human brain. The attention network consists of three networks: alerting, orienting, and executive network. Different type of epilepsy affects different brain regions, which could influence attention function differently. We created a computer-based automatic attention function evaluation platform with eye-tracking, which was adapted from the attention network test (ANT). Through this platform, we compared the pupil activation patterns of epilepsy patients (29 patients with frontal lobe epilepsy and 37 patients with temporal lobe epilepsy) and healthy controls (n = 29) in three networks. Participants had different patterns of pupil dilation under the three network conditions. Eye-tracking data showed that compared with the healthy control group, patients with frontal lobe epilepsy had a worse executive function, and temporal lobe epilepsy affected the patients' alerting and orienting network. Our study showed that the characteristic analysis of pupil activation curves of three networks could assist in the location of epileptogenic lesions in patients with epilepsy.

articleTitle: Research on Guangxi Yulin's Poverty Return Identification Based on Integrated Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: 2020 is the end of the poverty alleviation exit effectiveness inspection. To consolidate the achievements of poverty alleviation, promote the Rural Revitalization Strategy, and prevent poverty return will be its key means and important guarantee. At present, although many experts and scholars have studied the related fields of dynamic monitoring of poverty return, most of them focus on macro policy content, and the research on poverty return identification for the poor is still relatively lacking. At the same time, the in-depth mining and application of the accumulated large-scale targeted poverty alleviation data is insufficient. This paper finds relevant literature and combines China's achievements in precise poverty alleviation work and the construction of precise poverty alleviation systems, using Yulin's poor household record-keeping data as the research object. The three integrated learning algorithms, XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost, were used to identify poor households in three categories, out of poverty, poor and returning to poverty. The results show that the XGBoost algorithm model achieves optimal results, with an overall accuracy of 95.55% for three classification recognition, and can better identify the poor categories of the poor population. At the same time, the model's feature importance ranking can reveal the importance of poverty-causing characteristics of poor households in Fuping County. By analyzing the current work flow of helpers, it is clear that good dynamic monitoring of poverty return should achieve the needs of dynamic updating of data, dynamic feedback of results and dynamic adjustment of countermeasures.

articleTitle: Power Line Engineering Computer Investment Prediction Model Based on SVR-PCA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's national economy, the demand for electricity in the whole society is increasing day by day, which leads to the increasing demand for investment in China's power grid. Accurate and effective power grid investment demand forecast can not only reasonably arrange the investment of power grid construction funds, reduce the cost of funds, but also effectively improve the operating conditions of power grid enterprises and ensure the stable development of power grid enterprises. Power grid line project occupies a large part of the power grid investment, so accurate prediction of power grid line project investment is particularly important. This paper first reviews the research status of domestic and foreign scholars on power grid line engineering investment demand forecasting, data mining technology and prediction technology, and then on the basis of literature review, from the three aspects of infrastructure standards, material prices and plant construction costs, this paper preliminarily selects the influencing factors of power grid overhead lines and cable lines investment, and uses principal component analysis to identify the key factors of power grid line engineering investment. The input vector of the model is obtained, and then the support vector machine regression is used to predict the investment of power grid line engineering. In this paper, data mining is used as a mean to propose the SVR-PCA prediction method to predict the investment in power grid line engineering. Through empirical research, it is proved that the model is effective, applicable, and superior in predicting the investment in power grid line engineering, which provides a new method for predicting the investment in power grid line engineering.

articleTitle: Research on the analysis and visualization of the transfer network of China's new energy vehicle technology based on patent information
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At present, China's new energy automobile industry has entered a new stage of independent innovation and high-quality development, and has entered a critical period of “large to strong” transformation. Although China's new energy vehicle technology has developed rapidly and has achieved certain results in this field, its core technology innovation and R&D capabilities are still insufficient, key technologies are controlled by others, and the disconnect between innovative activities and industrial demand has become a major challenge restricting the development of new energy vehicles. Therefore, it is urgent to explore the technology transfer network in this field of China's and analyze its time evolution characteristics. This article constructs a technology transfer network by studying the main technology classifications of the International Patent Classification (IPC) and the relationship between the patent assignor and the assignee, and analyzes and analyzes the time evolution of the network. The results show that the network density of China's new energy vehicle field is increasing year by year, and the scope of technology transfer is gradually shrinking, presenting a “small world” structure. Balanced development between innovative activities and industrial needs.

articleTitle: Intelligent Music Style Classification System Based on K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm and Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Nowadays, open network resources allow people to freely search and enjoy all kinds of music products. Music classification plays an important role in music information retrieval. It can quickly find users' favorite music varieties in massive network resources and recommend them to enjoy. The music style classification system selects the most popular pop music, uses Python library for audio processing, and uses GTZAN data set to find out the similarity of different music and classify it based on the K-nearest neighbor algorithm (KNN) and artificial neural network (ANN), so as to form ten different styles. Machine learning and problem identification become the key, which is also the innovation of this project: in addition to the original network database of the system, users can upload their favorite or adapted and original music sound to the system. The system automatically identifies the music style label and can be incorporated into the database to establish their favorite “song list. “Innovation and development is the theme of the times. Technology is blurring the boundary between music consumers and creators. I hope that the development of this system can make more people love music, not only as music consumers, but also music creators who can realize their own innovative ideas. If so, people's creativity will have an exhibition stage combined with entertainment, the innovative spirit will be held high, and the music cultures will prosper and bloom in its various varieties. The display of creative talent and the cultivation of innovative spirit are the ultimate goal of the system.

articleTitle: Intelligent interactive test system for the human-machine interface function of electric vehicle charging piles based on computer vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, the market share of new energy vehicles has been increasing, so the number of electric vehicles charging piles put into use has been rising. Therefore, the inspection work of the charging pile before leaving the factory is very important. The human-machine interface function is a necessary test item, the current testing method of which is still mainly manual, with low efficiency, high error rate, high cost, and the problem of easy electric shock. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes an intelligent interactive test system for the human-machine interface function of electric vehicle charging piles based on computer vision to replace manual labor. The system consists of three parts: the interface perception module, the robotic arm control module and the cloud platform. This paper also puts forward the key technologies in the interface perception module, including the multi-task network that completes the interface positioning and text detection, and the parallel multi-model text recognition network. The system has been verified by twenty devices in the quality inspection workshop of the State Grid of China, which can well complete the quality inspection of charging piles. The paper also provides the comparison results with other quality inspection algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration of diesel-storage micro-grid vehicle considering PV uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the high proportion penetration of random fluctuation photovoltaic, the safe operation of the system is threatened. Diesel energy storage micro-grid vehicle can not only stabilize photovoltaic fluctuations and improve the acceptance capacity of renewable energy, but also supply power in case of emergency to meet the load demand. Therefore, a capacity allocation model of diesel energy storage micro-grid vehicle considering photovoltaic uncertainty and typical load scenarios is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the uncertainty of photovoltaic is described and analyzed, and the photovoltaic is treated in the form of interval. Then, a typical load scenario is constructed based on the scenario method. Then, the capacity configuration model of diesel energy storage micro-grid vehicle is constructed. By solving the model, the capacity and location planning results of diesel energy storage micro-grid vehicle are obtained. Finally, an IEEE-14 power system example is established to calculate and analyze the model, and the results show the effectiveness and correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of a novel lower limb assisted smart robot technology: Evaluation of human-computer interaction based lower limb assisted robot design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A new type of intelligent, natural and comfortable lower limb muscle assist robot based on daily operations. It can represent the most cutting-edge design innovation at this stage with minimizing the stress on the body and providing the most valuable technical solution in daily design and operation work. At the same time we have to develop the design and evaluation of human-computer interaction based lower limb assistive robot design with the help of scientific technology. This paper focuses on four research direction areas. a) Aesthetically, the four-piece design of the new lower extremity muscle-assisted robot (i.e., mechanical structure, belt, leg brace, and walking boot) looks more like sports equipment than a wearable robot. b) Inspired by the human body, it combines soft and hard components and a mix of materials for the robot that reflects the body's own muscles, tissues, and bones. The layer closest to the body is made of soft, stretchable fabrics (i.e., neoprene and fly stitch). c) To increase strength, the outer layers become progressively stiffer toward a robotic limb made of carbon fiber, thereby maximizing strength while minimizing weight. d) Intelligent. By being equipped with sensors, it can dynamically capture the user's movement trend to make dynamic adjustments, providing precise assistance and force enhancement effects. Data as well as positioning information can be viewed in the accompanying APP. The validation of this solution is through the use of advanced technology where the new lower limb muscle assist robot is symbiotic with the wearer. The combination of machine learning, force and position micro-sensors within the fabric layer, and slim yet powerful axial flux motors at the body's natural rotation points, allows for seamless coordination between body and machine. One of the most innovative solutions and the future of the industry, the design and optimization of the new lower limb muscle assist robot technology is demonstrated by physical operation cases that are applicable and forward-looking in the future.

articleTitle: Differentiated Attention with Multi-modal Reasoning for Video Question Answering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: It is extremely challenging to infer the answers for long questions and complex videos. Video question answering not only needs to capture clues from questions but also reasonably infer the certain clip or frame in videos. In the paper, we propose a novel method to understand the entire video and reasonably infer the answer to the question. We utilize a traditional attention mechanism combined with the multi-head structure to construct a differentiated attention module. Different from existing methods, our method is dedicated to obtaining differentiated features. Videos on our method are split into a few video clips, and there is a great overlap between video clips. Thus, simple using the self-attention mechanism to aggregate features will lead to excessive redundancy in the captured features. To tackle this issue, we propose a differentiated attention module consists of traditional attention mechanism and multi-head structure to focus on the core semantics and decode different clips or phrases. In addition, we also apply the differentiated attention block on question aggregation and video clues reasoning. We use different query attention loss (DQALoss) to solve the problem of question requiring stronger differentiation. Meanwhile, we propose to utilize the multi-modal factorized bilinear pooling method to solve multi-modal features reasoning and interaction. Our experiment shows that the proposed method outperforms existing methods on TGIF-QA datasets by large margins. The experimental results show the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Optimal PMU Configuration in Distribution Networks Based on Fault Diagnosis Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the distribution network, the fault features are not obvious and easy to be affected by noise and transition resistance, making faulty line section detection very difficult. The two-way power flow caused by high proportion participation of renewable energy further threatens the accuracy of fault diagnosis system. A faulty line section detection method based on multi-source information (node unbalanced current and insufficient power flow) is proposed, the convolutional neural network is used because of its excellent generalization analysis ability, PMUs are optimally configured based on their fault diagnosis capabilities, a series of configuration methods are given for flexible choices. The method is based on clear physical characteristics, and simulations verify the effectiveness of faulty line section detection and the flexible configuration of measurement devices in the distribution network.

articleTitle: Application scheme and strategy of electronic archive four-attribute automatic detection based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Blockchain technology has strong applicability when applied to the four-attribute detection of electronic archives, but there is no real large-scale and deep application yet. The article adopts SWOT method to analyze the advantages, weaknesses, opportunities and threats of applying blockchain to the four-attribute detection of electronic archives, design the overall business scheme of the four-attribute detection based on blockchain, propose the specific application path and methods of function realization, and point out the control strategy, which includes building BaaS service covering the whole system architecture and constructing a continuous inspection system covering the whole life cycle. These could help to complete the detection of authenticity, integrity, availability and security of electronic archives better, and to provide reference for the long-term development of the practice.

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Application of Human-Computer Interaction Media Based on Digital Trading Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The need to support the development of digital transactions based on the diversification of online digital trading platform activities is attracting more and more research. Facing the field of interactive operation and personalized service of interactive pages, how to effectively promote the digital transaction mode of human-computer interaction media design and development has become increasingly difficult. Based on the network digital transaction platform, this paper adopts the interactive digital transaction method of multimedia technology to realize the sharing of high-quality digital transaction resources between digital transactions. Through the overall design of the system, three subsystems including digital video interactive system, digital transaction management system and media design system are obtained. The experiment carried out in-depth design and selection of field equipment. Through the conversion of corresponding network communication modules, the problem of converting field analog signals into digital signals and connecting to the local area network was solved. Finally, in the example design of interactive applications, the function of SMIL language is used to achieve a 97.6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> success rate of synchronous playback of multimedia objects, and the error of the interactive interface is reduced to 0.031, which effectively promotes the application of human-computer interaction network technology in the construction of digital trading platforms.

articleTitle: LFM-D2GAIN: An Improved Missing Data Imputation Method Based on Generative Adversarial Imputation Nets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: For improving the accuracy of missing data imputation in data completion task and making the imputed data further obey the real distribution law, dual discriminator generative adversarial imputation nets pre-trained by latent factor model has been proposed. LFM makes each training step transition coherently and reduces the reconstruction error of missing data. Combined with the design idea of D2GAN, another discriminator has been added into the standard GAIN. The loss function in the network has been designed for the data completion task, so that multi-modes of real data could be captured in training process to avoid the mode collapse of data after completion. By comparing multiple baseline on multiple open data sets, the results obtained by LFM-D2GAIN show that RMSE decreased 32% and global KL divergence decreased 16% on average. It shows that the proposed method has excellent performance and can provide a positive impact on subsequent data mining tasks.
